items.description_ja: Jupiter Hell Classic is a old-school true Roguelike shooter with turn-based tactics, permadeath, procedural levels, and 90s sci-fi carnage in its purest form. Rip and Tear!
items.title: Jupiter Hell Classic

items.description: Mycelium: The Silent Contract is a co-op/single player extraction horror set in a haunted liminal forest. Your contract is simple: get mycelium and extract. But in this forest, nothing is what it seems. So what did you sign, exactly?
items.description_ja: 『Mycelium: The Silent Contract（マイセリウム：沈黙の契約）』は、呪われたリミナルな森を舞台にした、協力／シングルプレイヤー対応の脱出ホラーゲームです。あなたの契約はシンプル。「菌糸体を採取して脱出すること」。しかしこの森では、見かけ通りのものは何一つありません。では、あなたは一体何に署名してしまったのでしょうか？
items.title: Mycelium: The Silent Contract

items.description:
The ultimate 2D horror is back! Dive deep into the diverse world of horror movies! 
Nothing can prepare you for the R-rated challenges you will face!
items.description_ja:
The ultimate 2D horror is back! Dive deep into the diverse world of horror movies! 
Nothing can prepare you for the R-rated challenges you will face!
items.title: Lakeview Cabin 2

items.description: West Hunt is a 1-8 player social deduction game set in the Old West! Among the hardworking townsfolk hides an Outlaw or two causing mischief and mayhem across town. Luckily, there are eagle-eyed Sheriffs ready to sniff them out! No matter what role you play, you're sure to have a hog-killin' time!
items.description_ja: West Hunt is a 1-8 player social deduction game set in the Old West! Among the hardworking townsfolk hides an Outlaw or two causing mischief and mayhem across town. Luckily, there are eagle-eyed Sheriffs ready to sniff them out! No matter what role you play, you're sure to have a hog-killin' time!
items.title: West Hunt

items.description: A squirmy, bouncy shooter filled with lovely sights and horrible places. Careen across the planet, blast yourself to new heights, and discover the dark tunnels and deep places of a world beneath our own.
items.description_ja: 低レベルのアメリカを舞台にした、高速モードガン風ゲーム。ゴブリンの大統領を憑依させ、イエロー・サンの美しいメダルを獲得し、鮮やかな人生の色彩に身を任せよう。
items.title: goblinAmerica

items.description: Play as Sam and fish to your hearts content, sell fish you've caught, collect better gear, and use it to explore the depths of the mysterious lake, but be warned as no one knows what lies at the bottom. Wretched Depths is a PSX-style horror fishing game created by students at the University of Utah.
items.description_ja: Play as Sam and fish to your hearts content, sell fish you've caught, collect better gear, and use it to explore the depths of the mysterious lake, but be warned as no one knows what lies at the bottom. Wretched Depths is a PSX-style horror fishing game created by students at the University of Utah.
items.title: Wretched Depths

items.description: Guide vampires through centuries of emotional baggage, decades of delusions and the odd bout of self-loathing with real cognitive behavioral therapy concepts and become a Vampire Therapist! Even vampires need a shoulder to cry on when a neck to bite just won’t do.
items.description_ja: 何世紀にもわたる感情的な荷物、何十年にもわたる妄想、そして奇妙な自己嫌悪を抱えたヴァンパイアたちを、本物の認知行動療法のコンセプトで導いて、ヴァンパイア・セラピストになろう！ヴァンパイアだって、首を噛まれるのが嫌なときは、泣く肩が必要なのだ。
items.title: Vampire Therapist

items.description: Toree Saturn is a speed based 3D Platformer featuring a round bird with sunglasses and a backpack!
items.description_ja: Toree Saturn is a speed based 3D Platformer featuring a round bird with sunglasses and a backpack!
items.title: Toree Saturn

items.description: Sunset Motel: Prologue is a free motel management game. Ensure customer satisfaction, renovate interiors, design entertainment spaces! Manage your motel in your own style and provide travelers with unforgettable experiences!
items.description_ja: サンセットモーテル プロローグは無料のモーテル経営ゲームです。顧客満足度を確保し、内装を改装し、エンターテイメントスペースをデザインしましょう！自分のスタイルでモーテルを経営し、旅行者に忘れられない体験を提供しましょう！
items.title: Sunset Motel: Prologue

items.description: Break a Leg is a series done over YouTube shorts where the top comment got the next addition to the game. Break a Leg is a game where your primary goal is to break your leg. Once you do, you did it. You won. Therefore, there's no more reason to keep playing this game.
items.description_ja: Break a Leg is a series done over YouTube shorts where the top comment got the next addition to the game. Break a Leg is a game where your primary goal is to break your leg. Once you do, you did it. You won. Therefore, there's no more reason to keep playing this game.
items.title: Break a Leg

items.description: Skibidi Gyatrooms is a 1-4 player co-op horror game. You and the homies just fell into the Backrooms, you must out-GYAT the Skibidi Toilet with max rizz or get flushed. Expect cursed levels, and brainrot that’ll keep you on edge.
items.description_ja: Skibidi Gyatrooms は、1～4人で遊べる協力型ホラーゲームです。あなたと仲間たちはバックルームに落ちました。最大限の魅力で Skibidi トイレに勝たなければ、流されてしまいます。呪われたレベルと緊張感を保つ脳の疲労に備えてください。
items.title: SKIBIDI GYATROOMS

items.description: Toy mayhem unleashed! Arrange, combine, and craft the wildest toy army inside your desk, then crash into chaotic cartoon brawls across the tabletop!
items.description_ja:
やばい！おもちゃが暴走中！
不思議なデスク空間で、おもちゃたちを整理整頓して、たくさんのおもちゃを合成しよう！
いろんなクールなおもちゃ軍団を組み合わせて、ダッシュ！ぶつかる！飛び出す！
超ハチャメチャなデスクバトルが、君を待ってる！
items.title: Toy Smash Kaboom!

items.description: Lead adorable warriors to form an adventure team to work and adventure on the computer desktop. Defeat the warriors to save the world. Rich nurturing and collection elements, idle and slack off to earn money and fight monsters!
items.description_ja: 可愛い勇者たちを率いてデスクトップ上で仕事や冒険を！魔王を倒して世界を救え。育成と収集要素が豊富で、放置しながらお金を稼いでモンスターと戦おう！
items.title: Book of Fei

items.description: An incremental unfolding game about feeding fuel into a reactor. Combine elements to produce energy, unlock exotic technologies and explore a strange galaxy.
items.description_ja: An incremental unfolding game about feeding fuel into a reactor. Combine elements to produce energy, unlock exotic technologies and explore a strange galaxy.
items.title: Feed the Reactor

items.description: Experience liminal horror like never before. Inspired by the Backrooms, FailRooms traps you in an endless world of absurd architecture, broken spaces, and things that should never have been built. Laugh while you can. Can you escape a place that was never designed to make sense?
items.description_ja: かつてないリミナル・ホラーを体験せよ。「The Backrooms」にインスパイアされた『FailRooms』は、不条理な建築物、崩壊した空間、そして絶対に造られるべきではなかったモノたちが無限に続く世界へとあなたを閉じ込める。笑えるうちに笑っておけ。そもそも理にかなうように設計されていないこの場所から、あなたは逃げ出すことができるだろうか？
items.title: FailRooms

items.description: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.
items.description_ja: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.
items.title: Dementium II

items.description: Misericorde: Volume One is the first part of a series of mystery visual novels set in a convent in 1482.
items.description_ja: Misericorde: Volume One is the first part of a series of mystery visual novels set in a convent in 1482.
items.title: Misericorde: Volume One

items.description: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' Avoid the fanatical cultists and survive dangerous rituals to escape the Black Woods with your life in this 90’s anime inspired visual novel!
items.description_ja: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' Avoid the fanatical cultists and survive dangerous rituals to escape the Black Woods with your life in this 90’s anime inspired visual novel!
items.title: Sucker for Love: Date to Die For

items.description: 🌴👩‍🍳🍔 A stress-free cooking game that lets you relax! Cook up burgers for mecha cats and aliens. Play solo or with up to 7 friends!
items.description_ja: ♨️👩‍🍳🍔のんびり楽しめるストレスフリーな料理ゲーム！メカ猫や宇宙人に美味しいバーガーを振る舞おう。一人プレイはもちろん、最大8人でのマルチプレイも楽しめます！
items.title: Galaxy Burger

items.description:
Penguin × Exit 8 : A unique combination
Escape from the endlessly looping hallway.
If you find an anomaly, choose YES PEN.

If there is no anomaly, choose NO PEN.
All anomalies contain penguin elements.
Penguins are after you.
items.description_ja:
ペンギン×８番ライク　異色の組み合わせ
無限にループする廊下から脱出しよう。
異変を見つけたらYES PEN。 
異変がなかったらNO PEN。
異変はすべてペンギン要素が含まれている。
items.title: PEXIT 8

items.description: You wake up in a strange cabin deep in a mysterious forest, axe in hand, with only one way forward—through. Chop trees, sell logs, purchase and upgrade gear, and uncover the secrets hidden deep in the forest.
items.description_ja: You wake up in a strange cabin deep in a mysterious forest, axe in hand, with only one way forward—through. Chop trees, sell logs, purchase and upgrade gear, and uncover the secrets hidden deep in the forest.
items.title: Lumberjacked

items.description: Vacuum your way through a massive junk pit in search of a lost hard drive worth millions. Suck, sell, upgrade, and uncover absurd items, pop culture relics, and unsettling secrets in this dangerously addictive, satirical dig-'em-up.
items.description_ja:
数百万ドルの価値がある 失われたハードドライブ を求めて、巨大なゴミの穴 を掃除機で進め。
吸って、売って、強化して、この 危険なほど中毒性がある 風刺的ディグゲームで、奇妙なアイテム、ポップカルチャーの遺物、不穏な秘密を発見しよう。
items.title: One Man´s Trash

items.description: Gospodar's Tales is a Romanian folk horror game set in 2009. Explore a rural village, uncover a dark story of greed, guilt, and betrayal, and face the consequences of a past that refuses to stay buried.
items.description_ja: Gospodar's Tales is a Romanian folk horror game set in 2009. Explore a rural village, uncover a dark story of greed, guilt, and betrayal, and face the consequences of a past that refuses to stay buried.
items.title: Gospodar's Tales

items.description: Arcadia Cafe  - domestic horror in early 2000s. Work the night shift as a student at a roadside cafe. Meet bizarre guests, get cash for your job, but beware — homecoming may be much more horrible than you expect.
items.description_ja: Arcadia Cafe — 2000年代初頭を舞台にしたドメスティック・ホラー。学生としてロードサイドのカフェで夜勤をこなそう。奇妙な客を迎え、報酬を稼ごう。だが用心せよ。帰宅の道は、想像以上に恐ろしいものになるかもしれない。
items.title: Arcadia Cafe

items.description: Have you ever wanted to be a snail? Now you can be! Explore the vast Snearth with snail friends! Join monthly Snail Parties! MMOS (Massive Multiplayer Online Snails)! BECOME a snail (in a simulation)!
items.description_ja: Have you ever wanted to be a snail? Now you can be! Explore the vast Snearth with snail friends! Join monthly Snail Parties! MMOS (Massive Multiplayer Online Snails)! BECOME a snail (in a simulation)!
items.title: Snail Simulator

items.description: Sandbox with a vampire priest in the leading role. Destroy shatanists and turn the devil's village into an oasis of christianism.
items.description_ja: Sandbox with a vampire priest in the leading role. Destroy shatanists and turn the devil's village into an oasis of christianism.
items.title: Priest Simulator: Heavy Duty

items.description: Before The Night is a horror action adventure game based on a macabre twist to a fable. Survive in the tiny, cute animal village! Your animal friends will literally turn rabid at night! Uncover the secrets of the world where animals keep human pets. Join the cute pet human "Lisa" on her adventure!
items.description_ja: ウサギたちが夜に食べるものは何でしょう…？ 『Before The Night』は残酷な童話がモチーフのホラーアクションアドベンチャーです。町の可愛い動物たちが夜になると狂気の怪物に一変！ 「リサ」を操作して、 動物たちがペット人間を飼う奇妙な世界の秘密を探りましょう。
items.title: Before The Night

items.description: Use the specialized equipment at your disposal to locate & log as many paranormal events as possible. Decipher the ingredients needed for your ritual and try to exorcise any demons within. Any incorrect ingredients and you may never leave! 1-4 Players
items.description_ja: 超常現象をできるだけ多く発見し、記録するために、特殊な機器を自由に使ってください。儀式に必要な材料を解読し、中にいる悪魔を祓おう。材料に間違いがあると、その場を離れられなくなるかもしれません！1-4 プレイヤー
items.title: DeathWatchers

items.description: Get out of the building via the stairway. Observe the levels carefully for a successful exit.
items.description_ja: Get out of the building via the stairway. Observe the levels carefully for a successful exit.
items.title: Stairway

items.description: MoonMiners is a cooperative survival simulator of miners in space, in an alternative dystopian future. You take on the role of space miners working for an evil corporation far from home, and it will be much easier for you to die than to do your job.
items.description_ja: MoonMinersは、ディストピア的な未来を舞台にした、宇宙で働く鉱夫たちの協力型サバイバル・シミュレーターです。あなたは故郷から遠く離れた悪の企業のために働く宇宙鉱夫となり、仕事をするよりも死ぬ方がずっと簡単です。
items.title: MoonMiners

items.description: A story-rich psychological horror inspired by real-life experiences. Follow Emily, 23, as she moves to Brooklyn for a fresh start, but finds herself drawn into a slow spiral of obsession and control. Featuring voice acting, this atmospheric and grounded experience is deeply unsettling.
items.description_ja: 実体験にインスパイアされた、ストーリー性豊かな心理ホラー。23歳のエミリーは、新たなスタートを切るためにブルックリンへ引っ越してきたが、次第に執着と支配の渦に巻き込まれていく。
items.title: Once Upon A Mind - A Little Too Friendly

items.description: Wise Guys is a ruthless, high-stakes social deduction game where trust is a weapon and betrayal is just survival. Up to 12 players race against time to clean up their criminal operation and get out before the raid hits. Meanwhile, a Rat is quietly sabotaging the crew at every turn.
items.description_ja: Wise Guys is a ruthless, high-stakes social deduction game where trust is a weapon and betrayal is just survival. Up to 12 players race against time to clean up their criminal operation and get out before the raid hits. Meanwhile, a Rat is quietly sabotaging the crew at every turn.
items.title: WISE GUYS

items.description: There's been a murder aboard the Reuss Express, and you're the suspects! Prove your innocence in this comedy 'point n' click' murder mystery - packed with twists, laughs, and larger-than-life characters!
items.description_ja:
Reuss Expressで乗客が殺され、アナタが第一容疑者に！
スリリングな謎を解き明かし、アイテムベースのパズルを解いて、無実を証明しよう！
命がけのサプライズ、衝撃の急展開、そしてインパクト大なキャラクターたちが登場するドタバタアドベンチャー！
items.title: Loco Motive

items.description: "Seal: WHAT the FUN" is an omniverse multiplayer party royale game that allows up to 10 players to enjoy a range of compact plays in 10 minutes. Players can customize their characters with variety of effects and features, making the game more interactive and unpredictable.
items.description_ja: "Seal: WHAT the FUN" is an omniverse multiplayer party royale game that allows up to 10 players to enjoy a range of compact plays in 10 minutes. Players can customize their characters with variety of effects and features, making the game more interactive and unpredictable.
items.title: Seal: WHAT the FUN

items.description: A starving castaway on a deserted island discovers that a fast food restaurant appears once the sun goes down. As if beckoning him inside in his most desperate hour of need, this stranded soul will have to work for his meal...and for his life!
items.description_ja: 月のでない夜、無人島に取り残された漂流者の前に、突如ファストフード店が現れる。足を踏み入れたが最後、彼は最悪の運命に巻き込まれていく...！喰うか喰われるか、果たしてあなたは生き残れるか？！
items.title: Manny's

items.description: Witches, curses, and fairy tales meet horror in this classic walking sim with an eerie atmosphere and well-paced jumpscares.
items.description_ja: Witches, curses, and fairy tales meet horror in this classic walking sim with an eerie atmosphere and well-paced jumpscares.
items.title: Befriended Curse

items.description: Defend humanity's last surviving metropolis from mysterious alien machinations in this challenging base-defense arcade shooter. Featuring rapid upgrade progression, procedurally generated attack waves, dark humor and laser-sharp aesthetics.
items.description_ja: Defend humanity's last surviving metropolis from mysterious alien machinations in this challenging base-defense arcade shooter. Featuring rapid upgrade progression, procedurally generated attack waves, dark humor and laser-sharp aesthetics.
items.title: Utopia Must Fall

items.description: A psychological horror anthology inspired by disturbing real-life cases. In No Witnesses, a simple road trip turns into a brutal fight for survival when two sisters cross paths with a ruthless serial killer stalking the highways at night.
items.description_ja: A psychological horror anthology inspired by disturbing real-life cases. In No Witnesses, a simple road trip turns into a brutal fight for survival when two sisters cross paths with a ruthless serial killer stalking the highways at night.
items.title: Tales Beyond The Tomb - No Witnesses

items.description: Take on the hard yet fair world of Bloody Trapland. Jump, slide, dash and dodge your way through the many deadly levels. Find secrets, solve puzzles, unlock mysteries and unravel the story. Go at it alone or bring your friends along for a co-op experience like no other. 1-4 players online and/or splitscreen.
items.description_ja:
「ブラッディ・トラプランド」 の過酷ながらも公正な世界に立ち向かえ。
危険なレベルで飛び越えたり、滑ったり、ダッシュしたり、避けたりしましょう。
秘密を見つけ、パズルを解き、謎を解き明かし、物語を進む。
1~4人のプレーヤーがオンラインまたはスプリットスクリーンでプレイできます。
items.title: Bloody Trapland 2: Curiosity

items.description:
For every action, there is a reaction... For every choice, a result...
Dive deep into your subconscious as you wander the halls of The Testing Chamber & join hundreds of thousands of other players in one of the biggest & most successful social experiments ever performed.
items.description_ja:
For every action, there is a reaction... For every choice, a result...
Dive deep into your subconscious as you wander the halls of The Testing Chamber & join hundreds of thousands of other players in one of the biggest & most successful social experiments ever performed.
items.title: The Testing Chamber

items.description: A slow-burn atmospheric horror game about managing a toast shop in a desolate location in Central Anatolia, Turkey. Make toasts for customers, cash in, buy more ingredients, and witness strange events unfolding.
items.description_ja: A slow-burn atmospheric horror game about managing a toast shop in a desolate location in Central Anatolia, Turkey. Make toasts for customers, cash in, buy more ingredients, and witness strange events unfolding.
items.title: Tostchu

items.description: You will answer questions that will reveal things deep within. Some will be uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Test, and are you SURE you want the answers you seek? For it is time to once again unlock "Secrets of the Soul..."
items.description_ja: You will answer questions that will reveal things deep within. Some will be uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Test, and are you SURE you want the answers you seek? For it is time to once again unlock "Secrets of the Soul..."
items.title: The Test: Secrets of the Soul 2

items.description: A unique platforming experience where the protagonist, story, and mechanics are constantly changing. Take control of legendary warriors, giant worms, greedy kings, and lazy demons, each with their own purpose.
items.description_ja: 『俺が勇者！？』は、ひと味違うアクションアドベンチャーゲームです。プレイの中で物語の視点やゲーム体験、さらには操作するキャラクターまでもが次々と変化していきます。複数の視点が交差する中で、あなたはこの物語の真実にたどり着けるでしょうか？
items.title: The Warrior

items.description: Lead the world to apocalyse with lemonades! Price affects demand, but take into account the cost of each lemonade when selling. Upgrades reduce cost and increase demand. Invest in a factory, and eventually control the politics of the world to increase climate's temperature and beverage consumption.
items.description_ja: Lead the world to apocalyse with lemonades! Price affects demand, but take into account the cost of each lemonade when selling. Upgrades reduce cost and increase demand. Invest in a factory, and eventually control the politics of the world to increase climate's temperature and beverage consumption.
items.title: Lemonade Apocalypse: First Squeeze

items.description: Pilfer from pirates, conspire with cardinals and perform miracles with an incompetent magician. The Procession to Calvary is a Pythonesque adventure game made from Renaissance paintings, and a spiritual successor to the critically acclaimed Four Last Things.
items.description_ja: 海賊の持ち物をくすね、枢機卿たちと結託し、無能な手品師とともに奇跡を起こそう。『The Procession to Calvary』は、ルネサンス期の絵画で作られたシュールな冒険ゲームにして、評判作『Four Last Things』の精神を受け継ぐ作品。
items.title: The Procession to Calvary

items.description: A metrics-obsessed AI will monitor, profile, and entertain you as you progress through over a hundred genre-bending puzzles in this delightfully satirical adventure.
items.description_ja: この痛快な風刺的アドベンチャーでは、プレイヤーがジャンルを超える100以上のパズルを解き進める中で、データに取り憑かれたAIがプレイヤーの監視とプロファイリングをして楽しませます。
items.title: Lab Rat

items.description: Explore the halls and travel deeper into the Vincent estate, but beware what lurks there. Father is coming home.
items.description_ja: Explore the halls and travel deeper into the Vincent estate, but beware what lurks there. Father is coming home.
items.title: Dead Seater

items.description: SCP: Observer is a frightening experience in which you'll play the role of a maintenance engineer trapped inside a security room. Survive by managing the emergency power supply, monitoring the facility's camera system for threats and blocking the paths of oncoming horrors.
items.description_ja: SCP: Observer is a frightening experience in which you'll play the role of a maintenance engineer trapped inside a security room. Survive by managing the emergency power supply, monitoring the facility's camera system for threats and blocking the paths of oncoming horrors.
items.title: SCP: Observer

items.description: 《SUFFOCATE》is a realistic 3D first-person survival horror game. The plot revolves around family relationships, cult, and the greed that permeates human nature. The game doesn't shy away from violence, gore, and faith in this one-of-a-kind survival horror experience, Taiwanese style.
items.description_ja: 《窒愛SUFFOCATE》 は、リアルな雰囲気がある一人称視点の3Dサバイバルホラーゲーム。ストーリーは現代を舞台に、家族の関係、謎の宗教、人間の欲を軸に展開していく。本作はグロ、暴力、信仰、エロ等の要素を取り入れており、これまでにないような台湾式のサバイバルホラーゲームに仕上げられている。 探索、謎解き、潜伏を行うことでストーリーは進んでいく。主人公と共に一家を中心に巻き起こる恐怖の物語を味わってみよう。
items.title: SUFFOCATE

items.description: KILLBUG is a fast-paced, first-person movement shooter set in an endless arena. Slash and shoot your way through hordes of ravenous insects, mastering fluid aerial movement mechanics as you fight for glory on the leaderboards.
items.description_ja: 『キルバグ』は、エンドレスアリーナを舞台にしたペースの速いファーストパーソンシューティングゲーム。貪欲な虫の大群を切り裂いて撃ち、リーダーボードでの栄光を目指して戦いながら、滑らかな空中移動メカニズムを習得しよう。
items.title: KILLBUG

items.description:
On your way home on the train, you weren't paying attention. Until you realised the train had been stopping at the same station over, and over again. Watch out for anomalies, and avoid the Anomaly Exit!
Made for singleplayer and 2-6 co-operative multiplayer.
items.description_ja: 帰りの電車の中で、あなたは気を取られていませんでした。気づくまで、電車が何度も同じ駅で停車していることに気づきませんでした。異常に注意し、異常出口を避けてください！シングルプレイヤーと2〜6人の協力マルチプレイヤー向けに製作されました。
items.title: Anomaly Exit

items.description: Topple Tactics is a physics-based multiplayer tower defense game where one huge player controls the map by placing towers and using abilities, whilst the little players level up their stats and equipment to reach the end of the map and defeat the huge player!
items.description_ja: Topple Tactics is a physics-based multiplayer tower defense game where one huge player controls the map by placing towers and using abilities, whilst the little players level up their stats and equipment to reach the end of the map and defeat the huge player!
items.title: Topple Tactics

items.description: Ducks like to race, even in their own cars! Earn money by delivering food to fellow ducks in the city, then use this money to upgrade your vehicle. The better the vehicle, the better chance you have to win the race at the end of the day!
items.description_ja: Ducks like to race, even in their own cars! Earn money by delivering food to fellow ducks in the city, then use this money to upgrade your vehicle. The better the vehicle, the better chance you have to win the race at the end of the day!
items.title: Ducks Can Drive

items.description:
You are an Earworm.
You are an underworld contractor who hacks memories for a living. 
Dive into the memories of your victims in order to unlock the security questions to their bank account.
items.description_ja:
You are an Earworm.
You are an underworld contractor who hacks memories for a living. 
Dive into the memories of your victims in order to unlock the security questions to their bank account.
items.title: EarWorm

items.description: Save the feuding kingdoms!
items.description_ja: 抗争に苦しむ王国を救ってください！
items.title: Grim Legends 2: Song of the Dark Swan

items.description: In this immersive sci-fi thriller, you will experience the atmosphere of classic 3D games as you solve puzzles, follow an intriguing non-linear storyline, and engage in battles with monsters.
items.description_ja: In this immersive sci-fi thriller, you will experience the atmosphere of classic 3D games as you solve puzzles, follow an intriguing non-linear storyline, and engage in battles with monsters.
items.title: ZERO PROTOCOL

items.description: KUNKUN Defender is an FPS + tower defense game where players need to resist zombie invasions in different regions affected by a virus outbreak until a helicopter comes for rescue.
items.description_ja: KUNKUN Defender は、プレイヤーがウイルスの発生地域でゾンビの侵略に抵抗し、ヘリコプターが救助に来るまで戦うFPS + タワーディフェンスゲームです。
items.title: KUNKUN Defender

items.description:
Navigate through challenging platforming levels, testing your feline reflexes and determination — all to find your way back home.
Falling is never the end; place beds to use as checkpoints, which you may return to whenever you please.
items.description_ja:
Navigate through challenging platforming levels, testing your feline reflexes and determination — all to find your way back home.
Falling is never the end; place beds to use as checkpoints, which you may return to whenever you please.
items.title: Curiosity: A Cat Climbing Game

items.description: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must survive. Drag yourself through the hallways of an infested arcship, fight off twisted eldritch creatures, craft vaccines and ammunition, and escape to civilization.
items.description_ja: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must survive. Drag yourself through the hallways of an infested arcship, fight off twisted eldritch creatures, craft vaccines and ammunition, and escape to civilization.
items.title: Endoparasitic 2

items.description: You’re just trying to get home. It’s only a quarter mile. One street. What could go wrong.
items.description_ja: You’re just trying to get home. It’s only a quarter mile. One street. What could go wrong.
items.title: Make Good Choices

items.description: You're trapped in an endlessly looping art gallery — familiar, yet uncanny. If you can notice the changes, maybe you can find your way out.
items.description_ja: あなたは無限にループする美術館に閉じ込められています。どこか見覚えがあるのに、どこかおかしい。もし些細な変化に気づければ、脱出できるかもしれません。
items.title: Twisted Gallery 异馆

items.description: Drive into a world where a Bluff and a Bomb are separated by only a small wire, tied up by a psychopath in chairs with bombs strapped to their chests, play games, vote for losers and must cut a wire, risking instant death. Test your skill. Outsmart the imposter to be the survivor.
items.description_ja: 一本のワイヤーが生死を分ける、究極の心理戦へ。あなたたちは狂気の殺人鬼に椅子へ縛り付けられ、胸には爆弾が仕掛けられている。ゲームをプレイし、敗者を投票で決め、命を懸けてワイヤーを切れ。間違えれば即死！仲間を出し抜き、Imposterを見破って最後の生存者を目指せ。
items.title: Cut That Wire

items.description: A relaxing and humorous idle god simulator that stays at the bottom of your screen or on a second monitor while you do other things. With physics-based dragging interactions, it feels just like playing with desk toys.
items.description_ja: **『だらだら村』**は、デスクトップで遊べる放置ゲーム。仕事中にこっそりサボるための最強ツールです！神様になって、モンスターを召喚し、勇者を育てて、建物をアップグレード。仕事しているフリをしながら、こっそり遊べます。物理演算でのドラッグ操作は、デスクの上の小さなおもちゃで遊ぶ感覚そのもの！サボりたいなら、これで決まり！
items.title: Loafing Town

items.description: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.
items.description_ja: 「マシン・パーティー」は、失敗が死に直結する、危険なパーティーゲーム集です。仲間を集め、命懸けの極限状況に挑み、自分だけが生き残る価値を示しましょう。生還は望めない。
items.title: Machine Party

items.description: "FEED" is a bite-sized retro point-and-click puzzle game. It features multiple puzzles and a touch of cult horror.
items.description_ja: "FEED" is a bite-sized retro point-and-click puzzle game. It features multiple puzzles and a touch of cult horror.
items.title: FEED

items.description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.
items.description_ja: 巨大なリヴァイアサンが迫り来る小さな村で、老人 Petro の最後の日々を体験してください。避けられない運命、孤独、そして行く場所も去る理由もない一人の男を描く、実存的ホラーゲームです。
items.title: Leviathan: Rhino

items.description: Use light to survive a nightmare: each creature reacts differently to it. Explore, solve puzzles, and evade the horrors in the dark. You are in the skin of Ana Lúcia.
items.description_ja: 光を使って悪夢を生き延びよう――クリーチャーごとに光への反応が異なる。探索し、謎を解き、闇に潜む恐怖から逃れろ。あなたはアナ・ルシアとして行動する。
items.title: Asleep: Act 1

items.description: You are a lone Ukrainian military drone operator battling Russian occupation forces. Hidden deep behind enemy lines, you operate your drone to seek and destroy tanks and armored vehicles, shatter communication lines, and recover stolen goods. Slava Ukraini!
items.description_ja: "Death From Above"で、ウクライナ軍のドローンオペレーターとして敵陣の背後に回り込もう。多才なドローンを操縦し、エリア内の侵略者の排除や地雷原の撤去、補給部隊の迎撃を行い、イースターエッグが大量に隠されたサンドボックス満載のマップを探索しよう。より良い明日のために戦おう！ウクライナに栄光あれ！
items.title: Death From Above: A Ukrainian Drone Warstory

items.description: An adventure game based on the Russian folktale "Vasilisa the Beautiful". A scary story about the journey to the mistress of the forbidden forest for magical powers.
items.description_ja: ロシアの民話「うるわしのワシリーサ」を題材にしたアドベンチャーゲーム。 魔法の力を求めて禁断の森の女主人を訪ねる旅についての怖い話。
items.title: Vasilisa and Baba Yaga

items.description: Horror Roguelike characterized by an experimental artstyle and storytelling, strategic gameplay and deep mysteries
items.description_ja: Horror Roguelike characterized by an experimental artstyle and storytelling, strategic gameplay and deep mysteries
items.title: NO-SKIN

items.description: Raise Your Own Ghost Girl+Deckbuilding+Zuma-Style Match-3!Exorcism Agency is an innovative roguelike that finds joy in thrills.Ghosts are back,the human world is like hell,and you,as a top-tier exorcist,will venture into ghost-infested zones,using all kinds of mystical techniques to capture ghosts
items.description_ja: 女鬼育成＋デッキ構築＋ズーマ三消！『除霊事務所』は、スリルを楽しむ新感覚ローグライク。怪異復活、人間界は地獄。君は除霊師として女鬼の巣窟を探索し、法術で悪霊を制し、奇怪な事件を生き延びれば――後宮が開かれる！
items.title: Exorcism Agency

items.description: An unknown actress takes a job at Uncle’s Motel to make ends meet. She’s running from trouble but peace is the last thing she’ll find here. A blend of cozy simulation, horror, and psychological depth, wrapped in a dark, noir-tinged atmosphere.
items.description_ja: 夢を追いかけ続けた女優崩れが、家賃を払うために叔父のモーテルで働き始める。問題から逃げてきたはずなのに、ここで彼女を待っているのは「平穏」なんかじゃない。シミュレーション、ホラー、心理的深淵が混ざり合う、ノワールな世界。
items.title: Creepy Shift: Uncle Joe’s Motel

items.description: Classic DS horror reborn. Awaken in an abandoned hospital with no memory, no escape and unspeakable horrors lurking in the dark. The horror classic Dementium: The Ward returns, enhanced for 4K display and Steam Deck Verified, where every shadow hides a new threat, and every corridor a new nightmare.
items.description_ja: Classic DS horror reborn. Awaken in an abandoned hospital with no memory, no escape and unspeakable horrors lurking in the dark. The horror classic Dementium: The Ward returns, enhanced for 4K display and Steam Deck Verified, where every shadow hides a new threat, and every corridor a new nightmare.
items.title: Dementium: The Ward

items.description: A horror-romance visual novel following the trials of a dysfunctional friend group thrust back into the wish-granting wonderland of their youth. Either they face the issues plaguing them or risk dying in horrific ways again… and again… and again.
items.description_ja: A horror-romance visual novel following the trials of a dysfunctional friend group thrust back into the wish-granting wonderland of their youth. Either they face the issues plaguing them or risk dying in horrific ways again… and again… and again.
items.title: Our Wonderland

items.author: rixcod
items.description: Do Nothing Live More
items.title: Do Nothing

items.description: Team up with up to 8 friends online to explore the haunted, randomly generated depths of these dusty attics. Find and repair the objectives, flip the master switch and escape before the ghastly ghoul that lurks in the darkness catches up to you. Play through the career mode or explore free play!
items.description_ja: Team up with up to 8 friends online to explore the haunted, randomly generated depths of these dusty attics. Find and repair the objectives, flip the master switch and escape before the ghastly ghoul that lurks in the darkness catches up to you. Play through the career mode or explore free play!
items.title: Handy Harry's Haunted House Services

items.description:
Dodge bullets to the rhythm and take down everything that moves!
A rhythmical danmaku action game.
items.description_ja:
音楽のリズムに合わせて弾をかわし、動くものを全てしばき倒せ！
リズミカルな弾幕アクションゲーム。
items.title: Yoiyami Dancers: Twilight Danmaku Dancers

items.description: "Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines" - In this short story from the Endless Monday, Penny, a mild-mannered corporate grunt, spends a weekend at the office in an effort to finish her project on time while overcoming distractions from coworkers, space aliens, imaginary friends, and herself.
items.description_ja: 「Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines」はEndless Mondayから派生した短編です。温厚な会社員のペニーがオフィスで週末を過ごし、同僚や宇宙人、イマジナリーフレンド、さらには自分自身からの妨害を乗り越えて、仕事を締め切りに間に合わせようと奮闘します。
items.title: Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines

items.description: Battle a sinister corporation in this story-rich RPG! Survive fast-paced, turn-based battles and conversations where cringe damage can be deadly. Fight the evils of capitalism with your trusty pig sidekick and join the revolution, old man!
items.description_ja: 『Hermit and Pig』は世間との関わりを避けて暮らすじいさんとトリュフ狩りが得意のブタが主役のターン制アドベンチャーRPG。このとても主役に見えない人と動物は、探索し、採取し、戦い、時に自分の残念な欠点をがんばって克服し、邪悪な企業の陰謀に隠された謎を暴いていきます。
items.title: Hermit and Pig

items.description: It's run or die in a killer car infested city. Dash from dumpster to park bench and don’t make a wrong move. Ice cream trucks, snowplows and dodgy vans all want you dead. Decimate Drive, an indie game, is terrifyingly fast-paced and drenched in atmospheric horror.
items.description_ja: It's run or die in a killer car infested city. Dash from dumpster to park bench and don’t make a wrong move. Ice cream trucks, snowplows and dodgy vans all want you dead. Decimate Drive, an indie game, is terrifyingly fast-paced and drenched in atmospheric horror.
items.title: Decimate Drive

items.description: Hunt monsters in the gothic city!
items.description_ja: ゴシックの街でモンスターを狩ろう！
items.title: Grim Legends 3: The Dark City

items.description:
A retro-inspired PSX survival horror game set in the mysterious Noiret Mansion.
Explore a cursed estate, solve puzzles, uncover the fate of the Noiret family, and survive the horrors lurking within its walls.
items.description_ja:
ノワール邸を舞台にした、レトロなPSX風サバイバルホラーゲーム。
呪われた屋敷を探索し、パズルを解き、ノワール家の運命を解き明かし、屋敷の奥に潜む恐怖から生き延びましょう。
items.title: VESSELS: Noiret Mansion

items.description: An orphan returns to the house of the deceased fortune-teller to uncover the secret of his family's death. He must accept his legacy and become a prognostic before supernatural madness engulfs people of his town.
items.description_ja: An orphan returns to the house of the deceased fortune-teller to uncover the secret of his family's death. He must accept his legacy and become a prognostic before supernatural madness engulfs people of his town.
items.title: Prognostic

items.description: In an isolated lab beneath the earth, a childhood friend is resurrected. Amidst sealed walls, a spree of killings unfolds. In a godless abyss, parallel worlds entwine like a maze. Where does one find the path to the sole universe of bliss?
items.description_ja: 世界と隔絶した地下の研究施設、蘇生したかつての幼なじみ、閉鎖環境での連続殺人。神の気配もない深淵、迷路のごとく交錯し拡がる平行世界。幻のような幸せへの扉、何処にあるでしょうか。
items.title: Kanna Maze

items.description: "The Stalked 2" is a standalone horror sequel to "The Stalked", where you play as Rachel, an avid hiker. What begins as a relaxing hike to a cabin turns into a nightmare filled with eerie interactions and unsettling events. Will you survive?
items.description_ja: The Stalked 2はThe Stalkedの独立した続編です。あなたはレイチェルという熱心なハイカーとなります。ある山小屋へのリラックスした散策はやがて奇妙な交流や不穏な事態に満ちた悪夢へと変わります。あなたは生き延びられるのでしょうか？
items.title: The Stalked 2

items.description: Use your mouse to balance a cake that slides with every step in this horror game. Escape twisted beings and overcome dangerous traps, uncover the mystery behind the cake, and see the story through to its conclusion.
items.description_ja: 歩くたびにグラグラ揺れるケーキを、マウスでバランスを取りながら運ぶホラーゲーム。異形の存在や危険な仕掛けを乗り越え、ケーキに隠された謎と物語の結末を見届けよう。
items.title: Don't Drop The Cake

items.description: Lily was an ordinary teenager in 2004, and you just found her laptop. Read her diary, message her friends, and piece together what happened to her before it’s too late. But you're not the only one with access to her computer… A fourth wall-breaking psychological horror experience featuring LilyPichu
items.description_ja: リリーは2004年にティーンエイジャーだった普通の女の子。あなたはリリーのノートパソコンを見つけた。日記を読み、リリーの友達にメッセージを送り、リリーの身に何が起きたのかを突き止めよう。そのパソコンにアクセスできるのはあなただけではない…現実と物語の壁が崩壊するサイコロジカルホラーゲームをご堪能あれ。
items.title: lily's world XD

items.description: Regular Human Workshop is a 2D physics simulation sandbox. There are no predefined goals or objectives. Simply throw objects into the world and interact with them in various ways.
items.description_ja: Regular Human Workshop is a 2D physics simulation sandbox. There are no predefined goals or objectives. Simply throw objects into the world and interact with them in various ways.
items.title: Regular Human Workshop

items.description: Explore the mysterious operating system Crossʀoad OS. Adventure through its decaying programs, solve puzzles, collect items and meet strange creatures.
items.description_ja: Explore the mysterious operating system Crossʀoad OS. Adventure through its decaying programs, solve puzzles, collect items and meet strange creatures.
items.title: Crossroad OS

items.description: A short, unique survival-farming-base-building-tycoon-horror game where you must survive through washing dishes. Explore mysterious depths, manage resources, and unravel a cryptic narrative. In DWS, a chore becomes a journey to freedom.
items.description_ja: A short, unique survival-farming-base-building-tycoon-horror game where you must survive through washing dishes. Explore mysterious depths, manage resources, and unravel a cryptic narrative. In DWS, a chore becomes a journey to freedom.
items.title: Dishwashing Simulator

items.description: Experience a sneak peek of YIIK I.V! Step beyond Alex Eggleston's story and become the Nameless Child, a young girl pushed from a mysterious tower. Guide her through a surreal dimension where she must find a way to save both the Good Brother and the Bad Brother.
items.description_ja:
「YIIK: A Postmodern RPG」を大胆に再解釈し、発展させた「YIIK I.V」を体感しよう！
物語はアレックス＝エグルストンを離れ、謎の塔から突き落とされた少女「名もなき子」へ。
この世のものとは思えない世界を彷徨う少女を導き、「良いお兄ちゃん」と「悪いお兄ちゃん」の2人を救う方法を見つけなければならない。
items.title: YIIK Nameless Psychosis

items.description:
This is a small free prequel to the Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?. 
An old cabin deep in the dense forest, a strange computer, and a game that's trying to kill you!
items.description_ja:
This is a small free prequel to the Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?. 
An old cabin deep in the dense forest, a strange computer, and a game that's trying to kill you!
items.title: Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? Preface

items.description: You wake up in a house, alone with two beautiful girls... But no one is allowed to leave until one of you DIES. Why is this happening? What is the purpose of this “killing game”? But most importantly...WHO SHOULD DIE?!
items.description_ja: 目覚めると、美少女ふたりと見知らぬ家の中… ただし、ひとりが死ぬまで誰も出られない。なぜこんなことに？　この「デスゲーム」の目的は？　だけど何より…誰が死ぬ！？
items.title: Yet Another Killing Game

items.description:
Speak not of love untouched by passion's fire, as it's a torturous journey.
 If lovers would remain faithful evermore,On Peony Pavilion’s road they’ll meet for three lives more.
Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond is a Chinese horror puzzle game, and the 7th title of the Paper Bride series.
items.description_ja:
風流無き者語る勿れ 渺渺たるや情の一字
相思い合い背かずは 二世の契り結ばれん
『紙装束7 死の絆』は中国民俗怪談アドベンチャーゲーム『紙装束』シリーズの第7作目です。
今回は新たな主人公とともに、謎に満ちた両間口村で恋人の魂を探し求めます。物語の中には『紙装束3 愛の咎』の申墨卿や王娇彤、他にも懐かしの人物が多く登場します。
items.title: Paper Bride 7 Lethal Bond

items.description: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!
items.description_ja: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!
items.title: We Steal From Old People: The Game

items.description: An experimental 2D-shooter with the elements of a horror game. D'lirium brings together some mechanics back from 90s classics. Non-linear levels, search for the keys, violence and a lot of other things. Including the colourful ponies.
items.description_ja: ホラー要素のある実験的な2Dシューティングゲーム。D'liriumはノンリニアなレベル、鍵の探索、バイオレンス、それにカラフルなポニーなど、90年代のクラシックゲームから多くの要素を取り入れています。
items.title: D'LIRIUM

items.description: Branching dialogue! Hard choices! A cemetery's worth of phantoms, wraiths, and poltergeists lookin' for love in all the blight places.
items.description_ja: Branching dialogue! Hard choices! A cemetery's worth of phantoms, wraiths, and poltergeists lookin' for love in all the blight places.
items.title: Speed Dating for Ghosts

items.description: Become a tiny ZX8000 robot and begin your journey through a beautiful, pixel-art world inspired by games iconic to the platformer genre. Follow a cute story, upgrade your skills, beat challenging levels, and compete with other players for the fastest speedrun!
items.description_ja: 小さなロボット「ZX8000」を操作し、数々のプラットフォーム系ゲームの名作にインスパイアされた、美しいドット絵の世界へ旅立とう。お茶目なストーリーを進めてスキルを磨き、激ムズステージのクリアタイムをほかのプレイヤーと競え!
items.title: BZZZT

items.description: "The boy made up his mind to face a cruel world." The new special edition of the psychological horror-adventure game "Angels of Death", which has also been made into an anime. The past of B4 floor master Eddie is revealed...
items.description_ja: 「少年は決意した――残酷な世界を前にして」アニメ化もされて話題を呼んだサイコホラーアドベンチャーゲーム『殺戮の天使』新作特別編。B4フロア主・エディの過去が明らかになる──。
items.title: Angels of Death Episode.Eddie

items.description: "ZAKO NO AHIRU" is an exasperating climbing action game where you aim for the summit with a peculiar-behaving duck while being taunted by the cheeky girl, Sugaki Mary.
items.description_ja: 『ざこのあひる』は、生意気なメスガキの須垣メアリーに煽られながら、クセの強い挙動のあひるで踏破を目指す、イライラ登山アクションゲームです。
items.title: ZAKO NO AHIRU

items.description: In this physics-based co-op platformer, you and a friend must carry your short-tempered king through deadly medieval courses. Dodge traps, maintain balance, and work together to reach the throne room. One wrong step, and the king might crown you with his rage!
items.description_ja: 王様が谷間に落ちた！ここから2人で王を担ぐ“搬送”アドベンチャーが始まる！息を合わせて担架を操作し、王様を落とさず王座まで運び切れ。道中は危険だらけ。バランスを崩せばすぐ転ぶ。失敗は派手で笑える。成功は努力と実力への褒美。親友を誘って二人きりの抱腹絶倒の時間を過ごそう。
items.title: Hold Your King

items.description:
You are trapped in the observatory of a star-obsessed professor atop Mount Clearveil.
Plan your survival during the day, confront the darkness of the basement at night.
Can you break the ritual and uncover the mystery?
items.description_ja:
あなたは星に取り憑かれた教授の天文台に閉じ込められてしまった。
昼は生き残るために計画を立て、夜は地下の闇に立ち向かえ。
儀式を止め、謎を解き明かすことができるか？
items.title: Life & Shadow: Celestial Call
