items.title: The Night of the Scissors

items.description:
Someone has to protect this realm... is it you?
Become a guardian spirit and raise your very own Hero to stand against the Dark Lord.
items.description_ja: 王国を守れるのはキミしかいない？ 守護霊となって勇者を育てあげ、闇の王に立ち向かえ！
items.title: Yolk Heroes: A Long Tamago

items.description: Hans is a physics-driven, parkour adventure. Ascend to the sky with our lonely watermelon hero. Navigate treacherous platforms, defy physics by slowing down time, try not to fall and chase the dream of reuniting with humanity. No saves. Bounce, fail, adapt, and bounce again.
items.description_ja: ハンスは物理演算を重視したパルクールゲーム。孤独なスイカのハンスと一緒に空を飛びましょう。危険なプラットフォームをナビゲートし、物理学に逆らって時間をスローダウンさせ、落ちないようにして、人類との再会の夢を追いかけよう。セーブはありません。ジャンプして、失敗して、適応して、またジャンプしよう。
items.title: Hans

items.description: Outside the door is a mystic visual novel set within one office. You are about to figure out the stories of a few visitors without having a single memory of yourself.
items.description_ja: ドアの外には、一つのオフィスを舞台にした神秘的なビジュアルノベルが広がっている。あなたは自分の記憶を何一つ持たないまま、数人の訪問者たちの物語を解き明かそうとしている。
items.title: outside the door

items.description: Explore a frozen, mysterious land in this top-down survival adventure. Gather resources, craft tools, and fight to stay alive as you uncover a story of memory and redemption. Try to escape The Hollow.
items.description_ja: 氷に閉ざされた謎の地を探索するトップダウン型サバイバルアドベンチャー。資源を集め、道具を作り、記憶と贖罪の物語を解き明かしながら生き延びろ。Hollow からの脱出を試みよう。
items.title: ANGST: A TALE OF SURVIVAL

items.description: 『Letters of Bernard Thorne』 is a story-driven psychological horror game about trauma. Take a seat in Bernard's motorized wheelchair. Roam around the old man's house. Discover his scarred past. Flee from his sins. Climb up the attic.
items.description_ja: 『バーナード・ソーンの手紙』は、トラウマをテーマにしたストーリー重視の心理ホラーゲーム。バーナードの電動車イスに座り、この年老いた男の家の中を探ろう。バーナードの傷ついた過去を暴き、罪から逃れ、屋根裏へと上がろう。
items.title: Letters of Bernard Thorne

items.description: Think you're smart? Prove it by stepping into Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz—an educational experience for clever kids and curious minds! Just don't disappoint Mr. Pompy.
items.description_ja: Think you're smart? Prove it by stepping into Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz—an educational experience for clever kids and curious minds! Just don't disappoint Mr. Pompy.
items.title: Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz

items.description:
Winion Virus is a pixel-art visual novel horror game.
It features adorable and charming graphics paired with a dark fairy-tale story full of unexpected twists.
As a point-and-click adventure, your task is to fix the errors occurring within the computer.
items.description_ja: 『ウィニオン・ウイルス』は、プレイヤーのコンピューター内で起こる出来事を描いた独特な心理的恐怖のビジュアルノベルゲームです。コンピューター内の小さな存在「ウィニオン」を育てながら、心理的な恐怖とスリリングな冒険を体験します。かわいいキャラクターたちと過ごす穏やかな時間の中に突然の出来事が発生し、不安と興奮の渦に巻き込まれます。
items.title: Winion Virus

items.description: A claustrophobic anomaly-horror game where you can only turn, blink, and decide: is it real or not? Survive five endings and uncover Mike’s story.
items.description_ja: 閉所恐怖を感じさせるアノマリーホラーゲーム。回転し、瞬きし、そして決断するだけ──これは現実か否か？ 5つのエンディングを生き延び、マイクの物語を解き明かせ。
items.title: The Floor Above

items.description: Ever wanted to step in the compact shoes of everyone's favorite TWITCH streamer, Jerma985 and spend your hard earned BIG BITS on a slot machine? Well now is your chance!
items.description_ja: Ever wanted to step in the compact shoes of everyone's favorite TWITCH streamer, Jerma985 and spend your hard earned BIG BITS on a slot machine? Well now is your chance!
items.title: JermaSlots

items.description: Meet colorful characters, discover mysterious secrets, and reassemble the fractured remains of an ethereal crystal as you explore a series of abstract worlds based on dreams, nightmares, and the places in between.
items.description_ja: Meet colorful characters, discover mysterious secrets, and reassemble the fractured remains of an ethereal crystal as you explore a series of abstract worlds based on dreams, nightmares, and the places in between.
items.title: Hypnagogia² 無限の夢 Boundless Dreams

items.description: A spot the difference -type of puzzle horror game about monitoring live surveillance camera footage and spotting anomalies. Anomalies range from furniture movement to intruders. Fix anomalies by filing reports. You will need sharp eyes and good memory. The goal is to survive the entire night.
items.description_ja: A spot the difference -type of puzzle horror game about monitoring live surveillance camera footage and spotting anomalies. Anomalies range from furniture movement to intruders. Fix anomalies by filing reports. You will need sharp eyes and good memory. The goal is to survive the entire night.
items.title: I'm on Observation Duty 4

items.description: I made this first-person single player ghost hunting simulation game, trying to take an authentic approach at investigating ghosts. Use essential paranormal tools to help your community alleviate their concerns and put their minds at ease.
items.description_ja: I made this first-person single player ghost hunting simulation game, trying to take an authentic approach at investigating ghosts. Use essential paranormal tools to help your community alleviate their concerns and put their minds at ease.
items.title: Conrad Stevenson's Paranormal P.I.

items.description:
A terrifying multiplayer horror experience with social deduction elements.
Trapped in the Backrooms, up to 12 players must try to work together to survive and expose the shapeshifting Skin Stealer hiding among them before it’s too late.
Who will you trust?
items.description_ja: ソーシャル推理要素を盛り込んだ、恐ろしいマルチプレイヤーホラー体験です。 密室に閉じ込められた最大12人のプレイヤーは、協力して生き残り、自分たちの中に紛れ込んだ変幻自在のスキン・スティーラーを、手遅れになる前に暴かなければなりません。 最後まで生き残るために、誰を信じますか？
items.title: BACKROOMS: APPREHENSION

items.description: Terry wants to launch himself into space using his new car. Doing something this cool and reckless will surely make him the talk of the town. Run, drive and glide through this small journey of big discoveries as Terry works towards achieving this goal.
items.description_ja: テリーは新しい車に乗って宇宙に飛び出そうとしている。そんなに無謀でかっこいいことをやってのけたら町じゅうでウワサになるに違いない。大きな発見が待ち受けるささやかな旅路を走り、運転し、飛び回りながらテリーは目標に向かって進んでいく。
items.title: Tiny Terry's Turbo Trip

items.description: Cast into an ancient crypt, survive the horrors that dwell below, and ascend from despair with your unexpected companion in this short 2D puzzle platformer. Take risks to evade the petrifying gaze from beyond the dark.
items.description_ja: Cast into an ancient crypt, survive the horrors that dwell below, and ascend from despair with your unexpected companion in this short 2D puzzle platformer. Take risks to evade the petrifying gaze from beyond the dark.
items.title: We're Tethered Together

items.description: After every night comes a new dawn, filled with hope and light. As the adventure of our heroes continues, let’s discover what lies ahead!
items.description_ja: After every night comes a new dawn, filled with hope and light. As the adventure of our heroes continues, let’s discover what lies ahead!
items.title: My Furry Protogen 2 🐾

items.description: Christmas Nightmare is an atmospheric horror game about New Year's Eve.
items.description_ja: Christmas Nightmare is an atmospheric horror game about New Year's Eve.
items.title: Christmas Nightmare

items.description: For 3-8 Players and an Audience of thousands! Your phones or tablets are your controllers! The gut-busting, say-anything, no-rules party game!
items.description_ja: For 3-8 Players and an Audience of thousands! Your phones or tablets are your controllers! The gut-busting, say-anything, no-rules party game!
items.title: Quiplash

items.description: An absurd backyard bomb-building simulator. Raise funds, plan your approach, hunt down rare parts, and assemble your atomic masterpiece while staying calm and avoiding suspicion from nosy neighbors and federal agents.
items.description_ja: な裏庭での原子爆弾作成シミュレーター。資金を集め、アプローチを計画し、希少な部品を探し、冷静さを保ちながら原子力の傑作を組み立て、好奇心旺盛な隣人や連邦エージェントから疑いを避けましょう。
items.title: How to Make an Atomic Bomb in Your Garden

items.description: Hitler Waifu 2 - is a parody third-person 3D shooter with satire and black humor
items.description_ja: Hitler Waifu 2 - is a parody third-person 3D shooter with satire and black humor
items.title: HITLER WAIFU 2

items.description: A slacker stick figure named Bota moves onto your desktop. An idle app where you sneak peeks between tasks as he idly mutters to himself to match the time of day and the day of the week. He won't get in your way. Sometimes he talks to you. That's the whole app.
items.description_ja: あなたのデスクトップに、さぼり魔の棒人間「ぼう太」が住み着く。時間帯や曜日に合わせてゆるく独り言をこぼすのを、作業の合間にそっと覗き見る放置アプリ。じゃまはしてこない。たまに話しかけてくる。それだけのアプリ。
items.title: Sill Sticks

items.description: A nostalgia-infused pixel clicker in a comedy wrapper.
items.description_ja: ユーモアあふれるノスタルジックなピクセルクリッカー
items.title: Human-powered spacecraft

items.description: A pig farmer decides he no longer wants to dispose of bodies for the mob. What follows is a discussion between him and his would-be killer.
items.description_ja: A pig farmer decides he no longer wants to dispose of bodies for the mob. What follows is a discussion between him and his would-be killer.
items.title: Adios

items.description: Imagine you're a 12 year old, suddenly in charge of the guard shed at the castle gate, where you decide if elves, goblins and 100+ other characters should be admitted. It's a wonderful combination of deduction, narrative and puzzle games.
items.description_ja: あなたは12歳の主人公となり、城門の番人小屋の管理を突然任され、エルフやゴブリンをはじめとする100種類以上のキャラクターを投獄する決定権を譲られます。推理ゲーム、物語ゲーム、謎解きゲームの要素が見事に融合した作品です。
items.title: Lil' Guardsman

items.description: Chicken Feet is a first person survival-stealth horror game about a giant, angry chicken. Descend into the depths of GOOBER laboratories and uncover the horrors that lie beneath the lab's shiny façade.
items.description_ja: Chicken Feet is a first person survival-stealth horror game about a giant, angry chicken. Descend into the depths of GOOBER laboratories and uncover the horrors that lie beneath the lab's shiny façade.
items.title: Chicken Feet

items.description: Dino Trauma introduces you to a secret laboratory somewhere in eastern Europe where gore and dinosaurs aren't unusual things. Retro FPS inspired by the '90s legends.
items.description_ja: Dino Trauma は、恐竜とゴアの調和が独特の雰囲気を醸し出す、東ヨーロッパの秘密の研究所が舞台です。ゲームは、90年代のレトロなFPSの傑作にインスパイアされています。
items.title: Dino Trauma

items.description: Turn off the lights, dodge the ghosts and go to sleep as soon as you can in this hand-crafted 2d platform experience! In this vampiric precision platformer you will overcome challenging puzzles and deadly enemies before going to sleep in your cosy coffin.
items.description_ja: Turn off the lights, dodge the ghosts and go to sleep as soon as you can in this hand-crafted 2d platform experience! In this vampiric precision platformer you will overcome challenging puzzles and deadly enemies before going to sleep in your cosy coffin.
items.title: Desvelado

items.description: "Illusion Box" is the first virtual reality entertainment project of the 21st century. However, malicious rumors and computer virus infections forced the company to shut down the project. Now, the long-abandoned "Illusion Box" devices are being reactivated...
items.description_ja: イリュージョンボックスとは21世紀初期のヴァーチャルプロジェクトであり、ユーザーにもたらす想像力溢れる体験が、2000年以降爆発的に流行した。しかし、噂やウイルス感染などの原因により、やむなくこのプロジェクトは中止となった。そして今、廃れたイリュージョンボックスのデバイスが、再び起動する……
items.title: Illusion Box

items.description:
"Xi" is a horror puzzle game set in the context of modern Chinese folklore. 
The story takes place in an long-abandoned mountain mansion. This immersive escape room experience feels a bit too real, with eerie and strange elements everywhere—an empty banquet, an endless corridor.
items.description_ja:
『喜』は、中国近代の民俗をテーマにしたホラーパズルゲームです。
物語は、長い間廃墟となっていた山奥の古い屋敷で繰り広げられます。今回の没入型脱出ゲームは少し現実的すぎて、至る所に不気味で奇妙な雰囲気が漂っています。誰もいない宴席、抜け出せない回廊、誤って幽霊屋敷に入り込んだ「あなた」は本当に逃げ出せるのでしょうか？幸いなことに、この屋敷には他にも人がいますが、不幸なことに、その「人」は人間ではないようです...
items.title: Xi

items.description: Strap in, floor it, and deliver the goods... before the bomb goes off. Play as Carl, a monkey driving a wildly unstable mail truck through a difficult race against the clock.
items.description_ja: シートベルトを締めて、アクセル全開で荷物を届けろ……爆弾が爆発する前に。ぐらぐらと不安定な配達トラックを運転し、時間との厳しいレースに挑むサルのカールとしてプレイしよう。
items.title: DEADLINE DELIVERY

items.author: thepottus
items.description: Cinco Noites com Eduardo
items.title: Cinco Noitadas com Eduardo

items.description: Explore the mysterious room by traversing time, while you watch a man succumb to the room syndrome.
items.description_ja: Explore the mysterious room by traversing time, while you watch a man succumb to the room syndrome.
items.title: The Room Syndrome

items.description: You're a detective, and a frog, and it's time to solve a mystery in the wild west.
items.description_ja: ごきげんよう、カエルくん。いや失礼、探偵くん！キミに、調査の依頼が入っているぞ。今度の舞台は、無法地帯の西部だ！
items.title: Frog Detective 3: Corruption at Cowboy County

items.description: Piss bottles. Bats. Bike locks. Face the media-manufactured outrage of braindead mobs in a fully destructible, randomly generated riot zone as you try to get home from court alive after each self-defense trial. Shoot, hack, blast & build walls & turrets vs tricky AI in this brutally intense shooter!
items.description_ja: Piss bottles. Bats. Bike locks. Face the media-manufactured outrage of braindead mobs in a fully destructible, randomly generated riot zone as you try to get home from court alive after each self-defense trial. Shoot, hack, blast & build walls & turrets vs tricky AI in this brutally intense shooter!
items.title: Acquitted

items.description: School labyrinth is a 1~4 co-op horror game set in a randomly generated school at night. Cooperate with your friends and try to escape from the school building!
items.description_ja:
ランダム生成される夜の学校が舞台の1~4人協力型ホラーゲーム。
友達と協力し、複雑な迷宮と化した校舎からの脱出を目指せ！
items.title: School Labyrinth

items.description: You are the prey. Unknown Tapes is a horror video game that employs the found footage technique to narrate a story focused on survival in a modern setting overrun by dinosaurs. It aims for realism and draws inspiration from Dino Crisis and Outlast.
items.description_ja: あなたは獲物です。Unknown Tapesは、見つかった映像の技術を使用して、恐竜に侵入された現代の環境での生存に焦点を当てた物語を語るホラーゲームです。リアリズムを目指し、Dino CrisisとOutlastからインスピレーションを得ています。
items.title: Unknown Tapes

items.description: Sniper Dan is a delightfully funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a sniper rifle to solve hundreds of low-stakes jobs across six packed locations, discover surprising secrets, snap hilarious photo ops, and unlock costumes, upgrades, office décor, collectables and more!
items.description_ja: 『スナイパー・ダン：ワンショットの何でも屋』は面白おかしく、家族で遊べる一風変わった3D隠しオブジェクトゲーム。強力なスナイパーライフルを使い、小さな問題を解決していこう。スコープで場面をのぞき、問題を見つけ、解決策を撃ち抜く。暴力要素はなし。あるのはただ、ほっこりするカオスと善意だけ！
items.title: Sniper Dan

items.description: Dog Brew - a light indie adventure where the main character, burdened by debts, decides to settle them through the art of brewing beer.
items.description_ja: Dog Brew - a light indie adventure where the main character, burdened by debts, decides to settle them through the art of brewing beer.
items.title: Dog Brew

items.description: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest.  Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block.  Take caution, however.  These woods were never empty...
items.description_ja: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest.  Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block.  Take caution, however.  These woods were never empty...
items.title: Project Songbird

items.description: Play a Go Fish-style card game with Boo, the “Are you scared?” cat. Ask for cards, collect four of a kind and beat him to five sets. His questions offer clues about his hand, and he remembers what you ask for, too.
items.description_ja: Play a Go Fish-style card game with Boo, the “Are you scared?” cat. Ask for cards, collect four of a kind and beat him to five sets. His questions offer clues about his hand, and he remembers what you ask for, too.
items.title: Boo! Are you scared? The Chests Game

items.description: An absurdist FPS/interactive fiction game where you murder stupid robots, chat with idiot people, and explore a painstakingly hand-drawn and highly animated world!
items.description_ja: 不条理FPS×インタラクティブ・フィクション。マヌケなロボットをぶち殺し、バカな人間とくっちゃべり。さあ、死ぬほど気合いの入った手描きアニメの世界を探検だ。
items.title: Shooty Shooty Robot Invasion

items.description: A psychological horror game where you take the role of Jonah, an 18 year old trying out a new board game, The Ouija Board, with his friend Emily. Little did they know, it was far from a simple board game.
items.description_ja: A psychological horror game where you take the role of Jonah, an 18 year old trying out a new board game, The Ouija Board, with his friend Emily. Little did they know, it was far from a simple board game.
items.title: Forbidden Terror: Board Game

items.description: Control a tiny ball of grey goo with the ability to eat anything smaller than itself. The more it eats, the bigger it gets! Eat rats, dinosaurs, gladiators, samurai, pyramids, volcanoes... Everything! Soon you'll be eating the entire planet.
items.description_ja: Control a tiny ball of grey goo with the ability to eat anything smaller than itself. The more it eats, the bigger it gets! Eat rats, dinosaurs, gladiators, samurai, pyramids, volcanoes... Everything! Soon you'll be eating the entire planet.
items.title: Tasty Planet: Back for Seconds

items.description: Supernatural phenomena are on the rise. In MetaPhysical you and up to 5 other friends can go on the hunt for eerie creatures to put an end to their sinister activities! Whether it's an ordinary ghost or a demon, your task is to identify the rumbling creature and then finish it off.
items.description_ja: Supernatural phenomena are on the rise. In MetaPhysical you and up to 5 other friends can go on the hunt for eerie creatures to put an end to their sinister activities! Whether it's an ordinary ghost or a demon, your task is to identify the rumbling creature and then finish it off.
items.title: MetaPhysical

items.description: Out of Hands is a bizarre card-based adventure game that blends video-collage graphics with gripping psychological horror. Will you seek the truth lurking in this wicked, warped world—and can you bear its weight? Misty memories threaten to tear you apart, contorting you into a being... Out of Hands.
items.description_ja: 『萬手一体』は、独創的なカードプレイを通じて、この狂気の世界の裏に隠された真実を見つけ出す、実写風コラージュスタイルのスリラーゲーム。 受け入れようが受け入れまいが、記憶の牙はあなたを引き裂き、今のような歪んだ......手だらけの体になってしまった。
items.title: Out Of Hands

items.description: YOU CONTROL THE FOUND FOOTAGE. Another tape has been leaked, this time a recording of a training protocol. By answering questions and resisting jumpscares, can you beat the Entity Exam?
items.description_ja: YOU CONTROL THE FOUND FOOTAGE. Another tape has been leaked, this time a recording of a training protocol. By answering questions and resisting jumpscares, can you beat the Entity Exam?
items.title: The Lancaster Leak - Entity Exam

items.description: A girl visited your home, who you don't know but she identified herself as your girlfriend. She seems a little bit Menhera, but she knows too much to be just a stalker. This is a Kawaii Future Mystery, you will answer by free input for branching story. Please Try to find out true identity of her.
items.description_ja:
あなたの恋人を名乗る知らない女性。でも、ただのストーカーにしては色々なことを知りすぎている。
あなたが入力した推理が"だいたいのニュアンス"で判定されるKawaii Future Mysteryです。インターフォン越しに話を合わせながら、あなたの考える彼女の正体に辿り着きましょう。
items.title: Inverted Angel

items.description: Explore and admire while navigate through eerie, surreal environments inspired by the Backrooms lore. Explore this uncanny world lost in time and get lost in the otherworldly architecture in a world where reality bends and your sanity is tested.
items.description_ja: バックルームズの伝承にインスパイアされた、不気味で超現実的な環境を探索し、鑑賞しましょう。現実が歪み、理性が試される世界で、この時間を失った奇妙な世界を探検し、異世界の建築の中で迷子になりましょう。
items.title: Liminalcore

items.description: A game made by students in twelve weeks. As a chef, master your pizza moveset to traverse a corporation-ridden town in this cartoony 3D platformer!
items.description_ja: A game made by students in twelve weeks. As a chef, master your pizza moveset to traverse a corporation-ridden town in this cartoony 3D platformer!
items.title: Pizzapocalypse (Student Version)

items.description: One gloomy night, Bulb Boy wakes suddenly from a frightening nightmare to discover that evil has overshadowed the Bulbhouse. His family has disappeared and there are horrid monsters lurking in the shadows. Gather the courage and use his glass head to save everything he loves.
items.description_ja: One gloomy night, Bulb Boy wakes suddenly from a frightening nightmare to discover that evil has overshadowed the Bulbhouse. His family has disappeared and there are horrid monsters lurking in the shadows. Gather the courage and use his glass head to save everything he loves.
items.title: Bulb Boy

items.description: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick single player and multiplayer party game designed for chaotic fun, crazy characters and weapons galore. Complete an extensive solo campaign with hundreds of unlockables or party it up with friends in one of the many couch play or online party modes.
items.description_ja: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick single player and multiplayer party game designed for chaotic fun, crazy characters and weapons galore. Complete an extensive solo campaign with hundreds of unlockables or party it up with friends in one of the many couch play or online party modes.
items.title: Knuckle Creek

items.description: Take on the role of a town’s rules-driven (and reckless) bus driver in Thank You Bus Driver! Drive fast, slap faster, and toss any rulebreakers out of your bus to reach true victory: being appreciated.
items.description_ja: Take on the role of a town’s rules-driven (and reckless) bus driver in Thank You Bus Driver! Drive fast, slap faster, and toss any rulebreakers out of your bus to reach true victory: being appreciated.
items.title: Thank You Bus Driver

items.description: Explore a surreal world inspired by Kowloon Walled city in this turn-based RPG inspired by Japanese dungeon crawlers from the late 1990s.
items.description_ja: 1990年代後半の日本のダンジョンクローラーにインスパイアされたターン制RPGで、九龍城壁都市にインスパイアされたシュールな世界を探検しよう。
items.title: Kowloon's Curse: Lost Report

items.description: Olive is trapped in school in the midst of the apocalypse! With demons slaughtering every dog in sight there's only so many left to spend time with! Will their special someone be Brownie the snack-loving corgi, Sparky the sporty husky or Patches the dalmatian bookworm? You decide!
items.description_ja: オリーブは虐殺真っ盛りの学校に閉じ込められた！　悪魔が目に入った犬を殺し尽くし、一緒に過ごせる犬は限られている！　かけがえのない相手は、お菓子大好きコーギーのブラウニー？　スポーティーなハスキーのスパーキー？　本好きダルメシアンのパッチーズ？　決めるのはアナタ！
items.title: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Love at Furst Bite

items.description: Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!
items.description_ja: Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!
items.title: Deadzoned

items.description: Working at a data entry job in the big city, you type up and transcribe the lost mail and letters that have nowhere else to go. But as the days carry on oddities in the mail start to emerge, and cracks begin to appear.
items.description_ja: あなたはこの大都市で、行き場のない郵便物や手紙の内容をパソコンで打ち込むデータ入力の仕事にありついた。しかし日が経つにつれて郵便物に潜む奇怪が徐々に姿を現し、現実感が失われていく。
items.title: DEAD LETTER DEPT.

items.description: Owinka Shooter throws you into an action packed mad-dash through an evil facility. Get ready to fight for your escape!
items.description_ja: Owinka Shooter throws you into an action packed mad-dash through an evil facility. Get ready to fight for your escape!
items.title: Owinka Shooter

items.description: EMPTY SHELL will throw you in a dark industrial environment, a secret facility on a Japanese island. Each volunteer has signed a contract for a "recovery operation" without being privy to too many details. A tense roguelite survival horror with a top down perspective.
items.description_ja: EMPTY SHELLは、日本の島にある秘密の施設である暗い産業環境にあなたを投げ込みます。 各ボランティアは、あまり詳細を知らずに「回収作業」の契約に署名しました。 トップダウン視点の緊迫したローグライト サバイバル ホラー。
items.title: EMPTY SHELL

items.description: Play as a mighty Blood Wizard on a quest to escape a death-loop of psychedelic dungeons. Slay disgusting creatures using a large array of bladed weapons and unnerving spells, harness the power of cursed rings, find mysterious treasures, and learn the secrets of the universe you are trapped in.
items.description_ja: Play as a mighty Blood Wizard on a quest to escape a death-loop of psychedelic dungeons. Slay disgusting creatures using a large array of bladed weapons and unnerving spells, harness the power of cursed rings, find mysterious treasures, and learn the secrets of the universe you are trapped in.
items.title: Dungeons of Blood and Dream

items.description: "Messy UP" is a cute multiplayer game where pets destroy homes to grab the owner's attention. Due to the owner's busy schedule, they lack time for their pets. Players control the pets or play as the owner to catch them in this delightful mischief-filled game!
items.description_ja: "Messy Up"は、多忙な飼い主の注意を引くためにペットたちが家を荒らすマルチプレイヤーゲームです。様々なメカニクスを使用して大混乱を引き起こすか、悪戯好きなペットを捕まえるための飼い主としてプレイしてください！
items.title: Messy Up

items.description:
Search for 100 Jellyfish.
A carefully hand drawn 4K scene filled with cute characters.
The process is short and won't take up too much player time.
You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players.
Extremely easy to achieve.
items.description_ja:
Search for 100 Jellyfish.
A carefully hand drawn 4K scene filled with cute characters.
The process is short and won't take up too much player time.
You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players.
Extremely easy to achieve.
items.title: Where Jellyfish 水母在哪里

items.description: 4 short horror games from different authors and in different genres. Each game is an author's vision on the theme of 'pursuit'.
items.description_ja: 4 short horror games from different authors and in different genres. Each game is an author's vision on the theme of 'pursuit'.
items.title: Violent Horror Stories: anthology

items.description:
GuGu Pizza’s motto is to deliver anywhere! So couldn't refuse the pineapple pizza order that came from the space station. 
Eventually, the pigeon deliveryman begins a high-altitude jump to deliver pizza to space, passing through the city, forest, and sky...
items.description_ja: グーグーピザのモットーは「どこへでも配達すること」です！そのため、宇宙ステーションから来たパイナップルピザの注文を断るわけにはいきませんでした。結局、ハトの配達員は街や森、空を通り抜け、ピザを宇宙に届けるために高高度ジャンプを始めます…
items.title: GuGu Pizza : Delivering Pizza to the Space Station? Boss, this is just not right!

items.description:
A psychological horror adventure experienced through a "selfie-cam" perspective.
Contradictions in the timeline, subtle anomalies in the footage—every detail holds the key to the truth.
Reconstruct her fragmented records, and uncover what was truly left behind.
items.description_ja:
「自撮り視点」で追体験する、サイコロジカルホラー探索アドベンチャー。
時系列や記録の違和感が、物語のキーとなる。
見届けよう、彼女の残したかった記録を。
items.title: Cyan Heart

items.description: 8Bit Fiesta brings everything you need to the table with its action packed local multiplayer mayhem including a built in drinking game! Choose between a ton of characters and challenge your friends and prove yourself worthy the title "King of the Fiesta".
items.description_ja: 8Bit Fiesta brings everything you need to the table with its action packed local multiplayer mayhem including a built in drinking game! Choose between a ton of characters and challenge your friends and prove yourself worthy the title "King of the Fiesta".
items.title: 8Bit Fiesta - The Drinking Game

items.description: NOW WITH PUBLIC LOBBIES! Blend into the environment and eat objects around you as a sneaky Mimic, or burn, zap, and explode everything as a crafty Exterminator to root out the Mimics in this Prop-Hunt inspired multiplayer game of chaos and frenetic fun!
items.description_ja: NOW WITH PUBLIC LOBBIES! Blend into the environment and eat objects around you as a sneaky Mimic, or burn, zap, and explode everything as a crafty Exterminator to root out the Mimics in this Prop-Hunt inspired multiplayer game of chaos and frenetic fun!
items.title: Mimicry!

items.description: Award winning emotional visual novel about a little girl in a world of adults. How can you find a monster you can’t see?
items.description_ja: Award winning emotional visual novel about a little girl in a world of adults. How can you find a monster you can’t see?
items.title: Lydia

items.description: Change the minds of evildoers…for good! MINDHACK is a text adventure game where you meet unique evildoers, hack their minds, and rewrite them into happy people!
items.description_ja: 悪人の頭の中をお花畑に変えるテキストアドベンチャーゲーム。個性的な悪人たちをハックして、ハッピーな人格に書き換えましょう。
items.title: MINDHACK

items.description:
Electoral Carnage is an absurd 2D fighting game featuring America's most famous (and infamous) politicians. If you don't download it you hate America. 
Also JFK can assassinate himself. What more do you need to know?
items.description_ja:
Electoral Carnage is an absurd 2D fighting game featuring America's most famous (and infamous) politicians. If you don't download it you hate America. 
Also JFK can assassinate himself. What more do you need to know?
items.title: Electoral Carnage

items.description:
"Curse of the Shadow" is a BL-themed horror visual novel.
Cursed by a "ghost", protagonist Xu  finds eerie dark shadows in every photo he takes.Once escaping reality, he’s forced by fate to face fears   uncover the curse’s truth, he and two friends embark on a terrifying, unknown journey.
items.description_ja:
"Curse of the Shadow" is a BL-themed horror visual novel.
Cursed by a "ghost", protagonist Xu  finds eerie dark shadows in every photo he takes.Once escaping reality, he’s forced by fate to face fears   uncover the curse’s truth, he and two friends embark on a terrifying, unknown journey.
items.title: 咒影  Curse of the Shadow

items.description: Silent Wounds is an episodic psychological horror anthology. Each episode offers a compact and intense narrative experience. In this first episode, a man returns home and trades reality for the dangerous, silent obsession with a perfect doll.
items.description_ja: 『サイレント・ウォンズ』は、オムニバス形式のサイコロジカルホラーです。各エピソードで、短くも濃密な物語体験を提供します。第1話では、ある男が帰宅し、現実を捨てて完璧な人形への危険で静かな執着に溺れていく姿が描かれます。
items.title: Silent Wounds - The Doll

items.description: For 3-8 players and an audience of thousands! Your phones or tablets are your controllers! The game of terrible drawings and hilariously wrong answers.
items.description_ja: For 3-8 players and an audience of thousands! Your phones or tablets are your controllers! The game of terrible drawings and hilariously wrong answers.
items.title: Drawful 2

items.description: It's hard to be a kitten when you have such a clumsy owner! Yesterday she lost a lot of things in the park and now it's up to you to find them! Memories of that day can be helpful - you should remember where you've seen these things last and search there. And finally you can climb up a tree and ask a big cat for a hint – you will see all the events of that day again.
items.description_ja:
おっちょこちょいの飼い主さんがいるネコは大忙し！昨日飼い主さんが公園にたくさん忘れ物をしちゃったみたい。これから忘れ物を探しに出かけよう！
当日の記憶はとても役に立つ判断材料になる。探し物を最後に見た場所の記憶を辿り、そこを探してみよう。
items.title: Kitten Adventures in City Park

items.description: HorrorVale: A grand Spooktacular adventure about a girl, her dog, and her long journey to save him in a strange and horrifying Underworld.
items.description_ja: HorrorVale: A grand Spooktacular adventure about a girl, her dog, and her long journey to save him in a strange and horrifying Underworld.
items.title: HorrorVale

items.description: 2D side scrolling, adventure, horror game where you avoid monsters and solve puzzles.
items.description_ja: 2D side scrolling, adventure, horror game where you avoid monsters and solve puzzles.
items.title: The Little Red Lie

items.description: Third person shooter with minor platforming. You have to eliminate the condiment threat.
items.description_ja: Third person shooter with minor platforming. You have to eliminate the condiment threat.
items.title: Mayonnaise Simulator

items.description: Just a game about a friendly fungus. There's nothing wrong, is there?
items.description_ja: Just a game about a friendly fungus. There's nothing wrong, is there?
items.title: Fungiman

items.description: Hop into Orbo's shoes! Run, jump and drill around your boss's office, make some new friends, and uncover terrifying secrets about the company you work for in this comedically surreal 3D platformer!
items.description_ja: Hop into Orbo's shoes! Run, jump and drill around your boss's office, make some new friends, and uncover terrifying secrets about the company you work for in this comedically surreal 3D platformer!
items.title: Orbo's Odyssey

items.description:
Pih🥀 is the one and only pig-physics based shooter! 
Defeat enemy pigs, and don't get "HAMMED🍖" or "SAUSAGED"
Oh... also make sure you don't get "GOLD HOGGED", "BOAR'ED" or..."LIL PIGGED"
Shoot and punch those hawgs like your life depends on it!
And the music is 🔥 Hop on Pih🥀hawg!
items.description_ja:
Pih🥀 is the one and only pig-physics based shooter! 
Defeat enemy pigs, and don't get "HAMMED🍖" or "SAUSAGED"
Oh... also make sure you don't get "GOLD HOGGED", "BOAR'ED" or..."LIL PIGGED"
Shoot and punch those hawgs like your life depends on it!
And the music is 🔥 Hop on Pih🥀hawg!
items.title: Pih

items.description: She continues to dream. A first-person dream simulator where you explore a corner of a dream.
items.description_ja: 「彼女」は夢を見続ける。夢の一端を探索する一人称ドリームシミュレーター。
items.title: NIDANA

items.description: At soccer camp, a teacher tells two unsettling tales: a strange presence in the mountains and a body bundled in a sheet by the sea. They should be mere ghost stories—but something feels wrong. A short psychological horror visual novel, lasting about an hour.
items.description_ja:
サッカー部の合宿の日の夜。先生が語り始めたのは、山と海で起きた2つの不可解な体験談だった。
「山中で遭遇した異様な存在」「シートに詰められた遺体」
ただの怪談のはずが、語られる記憶の中には奇妙な「違和感」が潜んでいて——。
約1時間で濃厚な恐怖を味わえる、短編サイコロジカルホラーノベル。
items.title: Kyofu Yawa: Scary Stories at Night

items.author: rcheck
items.description: Every date doubles your stock. One date gets you fired.
items.title: Honey, I Leaked the Company

items.description: Rhome is a first-person dark atmospheric exploration game made by students at SMU Guildhall. Players navigate an increasingly chaotic and psychologically unnerving environment to reveal the fate of Hailey Rhome.  Proceeds from your purchase on Steam go to support student development.
items.description_ja: Rhome is a first-person dark atmospheric exploration game made by students at SMU Guildhall. Players navigate an increasingly chaotic and psychologically unnerving environment to reveal the fate of Hailey Rhome.  Proceeds from your purchase on Steam go to support student development.
items.title: Rhome

items.description: Get lost in a lucid dream, bending the lines between reality and fiction. Utilize the strange camera to navigate through the ghosts' mysterious residence. Find the purpose of your nocturnal visit in a vivid and dreamlike setting.
items.description_ja: 現実と幻の境界線を超えて明晰夢に迷い込み、不思議なカメラを駆使して幽霊たちの謎めいた住処を探索しながら、その夢の世界にいる本当の意味を見つけ出そう。
items.title: Afterdream

items.description:
"Peaceful days full of curses"
A heartwarming horror game about exploring in a mysterious company housing and living with a ghost for 7 days
items.description_ja:
『呪あふれる 穏やかな日々を』
幽霊との７日間の奇妙な共同生活を描く、ハートフルホラー探索ゲーム
items.title: Seven Nights Ghost

items.description: Observe every corner of your apartment by moving your camera along a rail that runs through the rooms. Find and take pictures of paranormal anomalies to exorcise them. Locked in your surveillance room, will you survive tonight's 8 rounds?
items.description_ja: 部屋に設置されているレールに沿ってカメラを動かし、アパートの隅々まで監視しよう。超常的なアノマリー（異常）を見つけて写真を撮り、悪魔祓いをしよう。監視室に閉じ込められたあなたは、今夜の8ラウンドを乗り切れるだろうか？
items.title: Paragnosia

items.description: Fish, scale, sell, repeat. Scale the Depths is a casual fishing game built around this simple but satisfying loop. Feed hungry customers, upgrade your gear, and uncover the many secrets hidden beneath the surface.
items.description_ja: 魚を釣り、うろこを取り、売って、また繰り返す。Scale the Depths は、このシンプルながら満足感のあるループを中心に作られたカジュアル釣りゲームです。空腹のお客さんに食事を提供し、装備をアップグレードし、水面下に隠された数々の秘密を解き明かしましょう。
items.title: Scale the Depths

items.description: Backrooms: Found Footage is a single-player horror game where you are the main character trying to survive the Backrooms. Curiosity wins and you decide to explore this weird place that you got trapped in. What could go wrong?
items.description_ja: Backrooms: Found Footage is a single-player horror game where you are the main character trying to survive the Backrooms. Curiosity wins and you decide to explore this weird place that you got trapped in. What could go wrong?
items.title: Backrooms: Found Footage

items.description: A twisted trial of pill roulette for up to 4 players (solo or online). Pick your poison. Use experimental items to shift the odds. And remember: only one of you can survive.
items.description_ja: 2人の被験者。1つの歪んだ医療実験。生き残るのはただ1人。一回の投薬が命取りになるかもしれない、ターン式メディカル・ルーレットゲーム。
items.title: SIDE EFFECTS

items.description: A narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with the butterfly effect at its core. Board the Babel, a mysterious cruise ship that takes you on a whimsical journey to the afterlife. Use a special pen to help fellow travelers fulfill their wishes by rewriting the past, changing how the future unfolds.
items.description_ja: 『バベル号ガイドブック』は、「バタフライ・エフェクト」を軸としたシナリオ型アドベンチャーゲームです。幻想的な巨大船「バベル」に乗り込み、奇妙な輪廻転生の旅を経験する…旅人たちの願いと後悔がここに交錯する。君はペンを持ち、彼らが経験したすべてを書き換える準備ができていますか？
items.title: A Guidebook of Babel

items.description: Make full use of your advanced move-set to navigate hand-crafted retro worlds without a jump button in this vibrant love letter to the N64 era of collectathons!
items.description_ja: N64時代のコレクタソンへの愛にあふれるこのゲームで、高度なムーブセットを駆使し、ジャンプボタンなしで手作り感あふれるレトロな世界をナビゲートしましょう！
items.title: Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom

items.description: Gum Ball Run is a free to play fast paced 3D platformer with online multiplayer where Gum Balls race against each other through procedurally generated obstacle courses to become the #1 Gum Ball in the Gummieverse!
items.description_ja: Gum Ball Run is a free to play fast paced 3D platformer with online multiplayer where Gum Balls race against each other through procedurally generated obstacle courses to become the #1 Gum Ball in the Gummieverse!
items.title: Gum Ball Run

items.description: "Of course you'll never get to experience Freddy Fazbear's Pizza like I did. And maybe that's a good thing. But a few months ago, I wondered... What if Popgoes could?"
items.description_ja: "Of course you'll never get to experience Freddy Fazbear's Pizza like I did. And maybe that's a good thing. But a few months ago, I wondered... What if Popgoes could?"
items.title: myPOPGOES

items.description:
The spiritual successor to DLC Quest! Earn that sense of pride and accomplishment in the way that only repetitive clicking can deliver. 

It's a clicker game, so chill out, have a few chuckles, and watch numbers get bigger while the industry burns around us all.
items.description_ja:
The spiritual successor to DLC Quest! Earn that sense of pride and accomplishment in the way that only repetitive clicking can deliver. 

It's a clicker game, so chill out, have a few chuckles, and watch numbers get bigger while the industry burns around us all.
items.title: Loot Box Quest

items.description: A ball, two goals and... toasters! Welcome to Toasterball. Play against your friends in this physics-based multiplayer sports game, where toasters are athletes, bread flies everywhere and the gameplay changes every time you score a goal!
items.description_ja: このフィールドにあるのはボール1つと2つのゴール、それと…トースターたちだ！『トースターボール』へようこそ！アスリートであるトースターたちが得点を競い合い、パンは宙を舞い、点が入るごとにゲームプレイも変化する。これは友だちと一緒に対戦できるフィジカルを使ったマルチプレイ対応のスポーツゲームだ！
items.title: Toasterball

items.description:
Survive seven days with a cursed painting.
Rely on notes from past victims and manage to successfully paint her portrait.
But be careful not to upset her, or you'll quickly find yourself dead!
An assortment of terminal tableaus awaits you. Will you be the one to finally finish her?
items.description_ja:
絵画の女の子と過ごす、呪われた７日間。
暗いアトリエに囚われた主人公は、過去の犠牲者の記録を頼りに、彼女の絵を彩っていきます。
気難しい絵画の機嫌を損なうと即デッドエンド 。
あなたは彼女を終わりにできるでしょうか。
items.title: Matsuro Palette

items.description: One thousand zombies from the massacre of Hachiko High are crashing Olive's birthday party! Trapped in the Grimalkin Estate they'll have to unravel the mystery behind the zombies, all while making sure their friends are having the Purrfect Apawcalypse!
items.description_ja: ハチ高大虐殺から生まれた1000体ものゾンビがオリーブの誕生日パーティーをめちゃくちゃにしていく！　グリマルキン家に閉じ込められた仲間たちとゾンビの謎を解き明かし、サイコーのしゅうまつに導こう！
items.title: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Purrgatory Furever

items.description: Explore your kingdom and rule wisely in the card game - Choice of Life: Middle Ages 2
items.description_ja: 王国を探索し、賢明に統治するカードゲーム - Choice of Life: Middle Ages 2
items.title: Choice of Life: Middle Ages 2

items.description: Zet Zillions is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder where you use your cards to make freakish combinations and explode entire planets. BIG-BADDA-BOOM!
items.description_ja: 『Zet Zillions』は一人用のローグライクなデッキ構築ゲームだ。カードでとんでもない組み合わせを作って、惑星を丸ごと爆発させよう。ドッカーン！
items.title: Zet Zillions

items.description: Eliminate your victims as a serial killer dubbed ‘The Sniper Killer’.  Terrorize the city with your keen eye and thirst for blood while staying one step ahead of a detective hell bent on bringing you to justice.
items.description_ja: Eliminate your victims as a serial killer dubbed ‘The Sniper Killer’.  Terrorize the city with your keen eye and thirst for blood while staying one step ahead of a detective hell bent on bringing you to justice.
items.title: Sniper Killer

items.description: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 15 year old kid were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare me the developer has had. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...
items.description_ja: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 15 year old kid were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare me the developer has had. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...
items.title: [Stories to Tell] Greyville Stay

items.description: A classic arcade mining game where you dig for gold, collect treasure, dodge hazards, and upgrade your gear across multiple modes and levels.
items.description_ja: 金を掘り、宝を集め、危険を避け、装備をアップグレードしながら様々なモードとレベルを楽しめる、クラシックなアーケード採掘ゲーム。
items.title: Gold Miner:Classic Edition

items.description:
REVEIL is a narrative first-person psycho-thriller game that focuses on story, puzzles and exploration. 
Find out what’s going on inside Walter Thompson and what his dark past at the Nelson Bros Circus has to do with it.
items.description_ja: 『REVEIL』はストーリー、謎解き、探索に重点を置いた、物語性のある一人称視点のサイコスリラーゲーム。ウォルター・トンプソンの頭の中で何が起きているのか、そして、ネルソンブロスサーカスでの彼の暗い過去がそれにどう関係しているのかを見つけ出そう。
items.title: REVEIL

items.description: Shattered Lights is a VR psychological horror room-scale experience, which focuses on drawing the player into the game with unparalleled immersion.
items.description_ja: Shattered Lights is a VR psychological horror room-scale experience, which focuses on drawing the player into the game with unparalleled immersion.
items.title: Shattered Lights

items.description: Placed in a world without change, you must create fate by watering an ancient plant. Determine a future and live with it.
items.description_ja: Placed in a world without change, you must create fate by watering an ancient plant. Determine a future and live with it.
items.title: Fatum Betula

items.description: Draft of Darkness is a survival horror RPG with deck building and roguelike dungeon exploration. Recruit allies, synergize their decks to create powerful card combos. Manage your limited resources and explore procedurally generated maps to determine the story's outcome.
items.description_ja: Draft of Darknessはデッキビルダー、ローグライクダンジョン探索の要素を併せ持ったサバイバルホラーRPG。仲間を集め、様々なデッキを組み合わせて強力なコンボを作り出せ。限られたリソースを管理しつつ、ランダム生成のマップを探索して物語を辿ることになる。
items.title: Draft of Darkness

items.description: A=B is a programming puzzle game with only one instruction: A=B, which means replacing A with B.
items.description_ja: A=Bは命令が1つしかないプログラミングゲームです：A=Bで、AをBに置き換えるという意味です。
items.title: A=B

items.description: To make some money from an old man, you are asked to fish at the forbidden Shinto shrine.
items.description_ja: To make some money from an old man, you are asked to fish at the forbidden Shinto shrine.
items.title: lure

items.description: This is a first-person indie horror game. In 9 Childs Street you will find the terrifying atmosphere of a recently abandoned house, and its captive inhabitants, through the eyes of a curious little boy in a red cap.
items.description_ja: This is a first-person indie horror game. In 9 Childs Street you will find the terrifying atmosphere of a recently abandoned house, and its captive inhabitants, through the eyes of a curious little boy in a red cap.

items.description: 🦀Crustacean Nations🦀 is a real-time strategy game about total crab warfare. Build a sprawling sand castle and amass huge armies to dominate the beach and become the one true crustacean nation!

カルト、ギャル、そしてゴア、あなたの闘争本能はこれらの具材が揃った闇鍋でぐらぐらと煮込まれる！！！！

items.description: Liminal Shift is a unique atmospheric suspense game developed using the latest Unreal Engine 5 technologies such as Lumen and Nanite. With every step you take, Liminal Shift pushes you deeper into an eerie, unsettling experience like no other.
items.description_ja: Liminal Shiftは、最新のUnreal Engine 5テクノロジー（LumenやNaniteなど）を使用して開発された、独特の雰囲気を持つサスペンスゲームです。あなたが一歩踏み出すたびに、Liminal Shiftは他に類を見ない不気味で不安を呼び起こす体験へとあなたを引き込みます。
items.title: LIMINAL SHIFT

items.description_ja: Fight the gangs of Paris in this action packed Beat'Em up. Up to 4 players can join in, to cooperate, or fight against each other! Many unlockables, game modes, crazy combos and devastating furies await you in this deep fighting game.

items.description: Martin has been given an urgent assignment at work. However, for this he had to go to the house of his Boss. And so Martin found himself alone at home, in the middle of a vast field of sunflowers. Everything was going well until there was a knock on the window.
items.description_ja: マーティンは仕事で急な仕事を任された。しかし、そのためには上司の家に行かなければならない。ひまわり畑の真ん中で、マーティンは一人で家にいた。窓をノックする音がするまで、すべてがうまくいっていた。
items.title: Knock On The Window

items.description: A doomsday land defense adventure in which you raise MOCHI-O, a weapon of annihilation that looks a lot like a hamster, to protect your country. Pet and raise MOCHI-O to defeat the oncoming enemies and fight through the tender post-apocalypse.
items.description_ja: ハムスターによく似た殲滅兵器「もちお」を育てて国を守る、終末国土防衛アドベンチャー。撫でて育てて迫りくる敵を撃破し、やさしい終末世界を戦い抜きましょう。
items.title: MOCHI-O

items.description: Patch me if you can is a puzzle adventure where you dive into a game world and manipulate objects however you want. Equip blocks to shrink boulders, move the sun, and thwart Lord's conspiracy. This broken world needs your 'patch'!
items.description_ja: 『Patch me if you can』は、ゲームの世界に飛び込み、思いのままにオブジェクトを操作するパズルアドベンチャーです。ブロックを装備して岩を小さくしたり、太陽を動かしたり、領主の陰謀を阻止しましょう。この壊れた世界にはあなたの「パッチ」が必要です！
items.title: Patch me if you can

items.description: Moonshiner Simulator is an in-depth spirits production simulator. Start from the bottom and build your operation into a thriving empire by mastering the intricacies of the craft and creating unique recipes. But beware – there will always be those who want to see you fail.
items.description_ja: これは、アルコール飲料製造を深くシミュレートするゲームです。ゼロからスタートし、職人の技を極め、独自のレシピを生み出すことで、あなたの事業を繁栄する帝国へと変えましょう。しかし、忘れてはいけません。あなたの邪魔をしたがる者たちは、常に現れるということを。
items.title: Moonshiner Simulator

One holiday, the father Haruma came to the park with his daughter Naori.
But in that park, strange things began to happen—.
Carry out the holiday mission “Playing House” for your beloved daughter!
items.description_ja:
休日、父親・春馬は娘のなおりと公園にやってきた。
しかし、その公園で異様なことが起き始める——。
可愛い娘のために休日任務「おままごと」を遂行せよ！

items.description_ja: A teenage girl and the vengeful ghost possessing her stumble onto horrors of cosmic proportions as the latter searches for a way to murder the former.

items.description: It is an adventure game with multiple endings. An original script written by a well-known light novelist with a total of 400,000 words. With reasoning, suspense, love, and science fiction elements, it allows players to embark on a highly immersive journey of salvation on the submarine train.
items.description_ja: 複数の選択肢と複数の結末がある2Dの日本式テキストアドベンチャーゲームです。有名なライトノベル作家によって執筆され、40万文字の完全オリジナルの脚本があります。推理、サスペンス、恋愛、SFなどの要素が融合し、プレイヤーは没入度の高い海底列車の救済の旅を体験します。
items.title: Rail of Möbius

items.description: You have ventured this far, now there is no turning back. Uncover the island’s dark history by travelling through crumbling caverns and mysterious laboratories, but be warned, some may not be too welcoming of your presence…
items.description_ja: あなたはここまで冒険しました、今は後戻りはありません。崩れかけた洞窟や神秘的な研究所を旅して島の暗い歴史を発見してください。ただし、注意してください。あなたの存在をあまり歓迎しない人もいるかもしれません… メリディアン157シリーズの壮大な結論が到着しました！ザンダー博士を施設の中心に連れて行き、FLAREプロジェクトの背後にある不吉な目的を発見し、その構想によってもたらされる差し迫った災害を回避してください。
items.title: Meridian 157: Chapter 3

items.description:
A horror walking sim that emphasizes atmosphere, tension, fear, and immersive storytelling, all heightened by well-timed jump scares. 
The game takes place in a village frozen in time, stuck somewhere in the mid-20th century.
items.description_ja:
雰囲気、緊張感、恐怖、没入感あふれるストーリーテリングを強調したホラーウォーキング シミュレーション。タイミングよくジャンプ スケアがこれらを一層高めます。

このゲームは、20 世紀半ばのどこかで時が止まった村を舞台にしています。
items.title: Greed Stays Home

items.description: Saddle up with friends and investigate a dark mystery, where each trail leads to wonder and intrigue. A string of events has set the idyllic island on edge. Discover the truth behind your mother’s disappearance and a local's sudden death. For fans of horses, murder mysteries, and cozy exploration!

items.description_ja: たとえ魔物の支配された世界でも、社会の歯車はひたすら回り続ける。崩壊した世界を生きるごく普通の会社員として、日々の仕事をこなし、パズルを解き、この歪んだ社会の真実を紐解いていこう。

items.description: In September of my third year in junior high school, I went with my father to my grandparents' house in the mountains. The place we arrived at was Yotsu Village. It was a small village that had long believed in "Yotsume God". There I meet a mysterious boy.
items.description_ja:
中学3年の9月、私は父と一緒に山奥の実家へ行くことになった。辿り着いた先は 四津村。そこは古くから”四ツ目神”を信仰する 小さな村だった。そこで私は、謎の少年と出会う――。
物語を楽しみながら謎を解く、和風ホラー×脱出アドベンチャー「四ツ目神 -再会-」がSteam®に登場！
items.title: Yotsume God -Reunion-

items.description: Peace, Death! 2 is a midcore turn-based logic game where you send clients to Hell, Heaven, or Purgatory and help members of the Reapers Union as they work towards their great cause!
items.description_ja: Peace, Death! 2 is a midcore turn-based logic game where you send clients to Hell, Heaven, or Purgatory and help members of the Reapers Union as they work towards their great cause!

items.description: A slice of life story-driven adventure game with a distinctive 3D pixel art. Embark on a journey and accompany Haruto Soraki, a high schooler, in his quest to find the memory he lost in an accident seven years ago.
items.description_ja: 本作は、3Dピクセルアートを駆使した、時間遡行の要素を持つ日常的なストーリー仕立てのアドベンチャーゲームです。高校生のソラキ・ハルトとともに、7年前の事故で失ったと思われる記憶を探す旅に出ましょう。

items.description: Feed All Monsters is a cute and cozy Line Puzzle game. Assist a team of delivery workers in their quest to bring tasty food to all the little monsters. Find the optimal path for each worker in order to get all the monsters fed.
items.description_ja: Feed All Monstersは、かわいくて心温まるラインパズルゲームです。小さなモンスターたちにおいしい食べ物を届けるために、配達員をサポートしましょう。 すべてのモンスターに食べ物を与えるために、配達員それぞれに最適な道を見つけてください。
items.title: Feed All Monsters

items.description: The family is hungry and he must provide, VHS slasher survival horror.
items.description_ja: The family is hungry and he must provide, VHS slasher survival horror.

items.description:
A 90s Hong Kong public housing block hides twisted tenants, buried truths, and ghosts.
As security guard Lee Shing, your choices shape the story and unlock multiple endings.
A mystery full of foreshadowing—some truths can only be uncovered through repeated playthroughs.
items.description_ja:
取り壊し寸前の公営住宅「昌榮楼」。
若い警備員・李誠は、住民から移転同意書を集めるはずが、奇行、伏線、噂の幽霊に巻き込まれていく。
選択が物語を大きく分岐させ、真相は一度では見抜けない。
90年代香港の空気と恐怖が交錯するマルチエンド・ホラー。

items.description: 🤡🎪🐾100 Funny Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the funny themed locations full of cats! 🤣🎈🐈 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of the Circus and Cats hidden throughout the game. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

items.description: Become the fella. Walk on the stilts.
items.description_ja: 竹馬で歩き、障害物を乗り越える、やりごたえ抜群の物理学ベース・アーケードゲーム。日本語でプレイ可能！
items.title: Stilt Fella

items.description: You will answer a series of questions that will reveal your potential fate. These questions may make you uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Horrorscope, and if you do, are you sure you want the answers you seek?
items.description_ja: You will answer a series of questions that will reveal your potential fate. These questions may make you uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Horrorscope, and if you do, are you sure you want the answers you seek?
items.title: The Horrorscope: Fatal Awakening

items.description: DREAM LOGIC is a story driven first-person atmospheric horror game which takes place in liminal spaces. Explore various nostalgic, dreamlike, uncanny environments. But don't feel too safe, there's a sneaky creature watching your every move.
items.description_ja: DREAM LOGIC is a story driven first-person atmospheric horror game which takes place in liminal spaces. Explore various nostalgic, dreamlike, uncanny environments. But don't feel too safe, there's a sneaky creature watching your every move.
items.title: DREAM LOGIC

items.description: Munch down a bite-sized SLUDGE LIFE experience in this free self-contained interlude.
items.description_ja: Munch down a bite-sized SLUDGE LIFE experience in this free self-contained interlude.
items.title: SLUDGE LIFE: The BIG MUD Sessions

items.description: Discover 'Departed Away,' a captivating visual novel where friendship intertwines with mystery. Uncover secrets, engage in verbal duels, and make choices that shape your story. Delve into emotional depth and intricate connections in this unique story.
items.description_ja: 『Departed Away』は友情と謎が絡み合った、心奪われるビジュアルノベル。明かされる秘密、女の子達との論戦、そして君の選択がこの物語を形作る。交錯する関係性の中で、心の奥底に眠る真実を探し求めよ。
items.title: Departed Away

items.description: Challenging co-op horror (1-4 players). You are looking for your missing friend Darvin. Do whatever it takes to stay alive. Only the patient and the clever will succeed.
items.description_ja: LockYourDoorは1〜4人用の協力型サバイバルホラーゲームです。あなたは行方不明の友人ダーヴィンを探しています。彼を見つけて、生き続けるために必要なことをすべて行ってください。忍耐強く賢い者だけが生き残れます。
items.title: LockYourDoor

items.description: You wake up tied to an office chair in the middle of an empty room. A mysterious device with a 10-minute timer is attached to you. Explore the office floors, try not to tip over, and find a way to escape!
items.description_ja: 空っぽの部屋の真ん中、オフィスチェアに縛られて目覚める。10分のタイマーが刻む謎の装置が仕掛けられている。オフィスフロアを探索し、体勢を崩すな！脱出への道を見出せ！
items.title: Ells Tales: Chairbound

items.description: A unique incremental idle clicker where you flip cards to earn money, grow your hand, buy new decks, unlock powerful upgrades, discover new cards, and more. Can you defeat the Jester and escape the carnival?
items.description_ja: カードをめくって金を稼ぎ、手札を強くし、新デッキを買い、強力なアップグレードを解放し、新しいカードを見つけ出すユニークなインクリメンタル放置クリッカー。あなたは道化師を倒してカーニバルから脱出できるか？
items.title: This Ain’t Even Poker, Ya Joker

items.description: Coal Duty is a 1-5 player co-op extraction horror-comedy. Meet the state coal quota in procedurally generated mines, spend your tickets, plan your escape. Some miners have reportedly escaped. The state does not confirm this.
items.description_ja: Coal Dutyは1～5人用協力型エクストラクション・ホラーコメディ。手続き的に生成される鉱山で国の石炭ノルマを達成し、チケットを使い、脱出を計画せよ。一部の鉱夫は脱出に成功したと報告されている。国はこれを確認していない。
items.title: Coal Duty

items.description: Welcome to Windy Oaks National Park. A beautiful and chilling point-and-click horror adventure. On your way to visit your aging father, everything goes wrong, leaving you trapped and isolated.
items.description_ja: Welcome to Windy Oaks National Park. A beautiful and chilling point-and-click horror adventure. On your way to visit your aging father, everything goes wrong, leaving you trapped and isolated.
items.title: Shiver

items.author: illomens
items.description: A Manifesto For Making Games
items.title: NO-ONE IS GOING TO BUY YOUR GAME

items.description:
Chapter 2 is OUT NOW!

The first chapter of an unforgettable survival horror experience. Solve puzzles and work your way through this terrifying place. You may be more familiar with it than you initially think.
items.description_ja:
Chapter 2 is OUT NOW!

The first chapter of an unforgettable survival horror experience. Solve puzzles and work your way through this terrifying place. You may be more familiar with it than you initially think.
items.title: The Designer's Curse

items.description: The only way to wake up is to die. The player must decide for himself whether he is inside a dream or is in reality.
items.description_ja: The only way to wake up is to die. The player must decide for himself whether he is inside a dream or is in reality.
items.title: Knock Harder: Useless

items.description:
The Chef’s Shift is a fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting,
where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING.
items.description_ja:
The Chef's Shiftはレストランを舞台にしたテンポの良いタイピングゲームです、
お腹を空かせたお客さんに料理を作って提供します。
items.title: The Chef's Shift

items.description: A gardener gets hired for maintenance work over the weekend. A simple task, but strangely some tools are missing… The owner of the garden isn't around, and their house is off-limits. Perhaps new tools can be found in the mysterious town, or maybe some of the reserved townsfolk have seen them?
items.description_ja: あなたは、週末に手入れをするために雇われた庭師。簡単な作業のはずなのに、おかしなことに、いくつかの道具が見当たりません。その上、庭の主は不在で、家の中も立ち入り禁止です。こうなったら、不思議な町で新しい道具を見つけようとするか、シャイな町の住人たちがその道具を見ていないか聞いてみるしかありません。
items.title: Grunn

items.description: Welcome to my first game! Where you'll Immerse yourself in a unbelievable, story-rich mystery, packed with jaw-dropping plot twist, horror, and multiple endings.
items.description_ja: Welcome to my first game! Where you'll Immerse yourself in a unbelievable, story-rich mystery, packed with jaw-dropping plot twist, horror, and multiple endings.
items.title: Ethel

items.description:
A story about the self—and about others.
A toy factory, several cursed dolls, and a horror novel… This quiet seaside town throws Noele's love life into chaos and dredges up the old wounds she has tried for years to forget.
items.description_ja:
A story about the self—and about others.
A toy factory, several cursed dolls, and a horror novel… This quiet seaside town throws Noele's love life into chaos and dredges up the old wounds she has tried for years to forget.
items.title: Stiff Neck

items.description: Have you got what it takes to be a Wanba Warrior? Step into the absurd world of calligraphy combat and prepare to lay the smackdown upon all who dare to oppose you, dishing out damage with your chosen ink brush of brutality! highly recommend playing with controllers.
items.description_ja: Wanba Warriorsに立ち向かう覚悟はありますか？カリグラフィーの世界に足を踏み入れ、選んだインクブラシで敵に挑み、残虐さをもって制裁を加える準備をしましょう！コントローラーを使用することを強くお勧めします。
items.title: Wanba Warriors

items.description: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.
items.description_ja: 【ひぐらしのなく頃に解　皆殺し編】本作品は日本語モード、英語モードを搭載したサウンドノベルです。音楽や背景、キャラクターによって楽しく演出された世界を、小説の感覚で読み進んで行きます。笑ったり、泣いたり、怒ったり。そんな心の揺らめきを主人公と一緒に堪能して下さい。
items.title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.7 Minagoroshi

items.description: Phil's life has crumbled to dust. The four walls of his room have become his safe haven. He yearns for sleep...but terrible nightmares haunt him. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.
items.description_ja: Phil's life has crumbled to dust. The four walls of his room have become his safe haven. He yearns for sleep...but terrible nightmares haunt him. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.
items.title: Midnight Scenes: A Safe Place

items.description: If you don't sacrifice your neighbors, the world ends. Life Eater is a horror fantasy kidnapping simulator where you must become intimately familiar with your targets' lives one intrusive action at a time... and hope that the dark god you serve is even real.
items.description_ja: 隣人を犠牲にしなければ世界が終わる。『Life Eater』はホラーファンタジー誘拐シミュレーターだ。君は次々と生活に立ち入り、ターゲットを熟知しなければならない…そして、君が仕える暗黒神がちゃんと実在することを祈ろう。
items.title: Life Eater

items.description: A co-op climbing game about two stuck-together toys on an escape mission from their evil owner.
items.description_ja: 二人協力の極限クライムゲーム！友達とくっついて奇抜な仕掛けや奇怪な部屋を攻略。登攀、ブランコ渡り、UFOに引きずられ、謎の巨大な手に追われる…息ぴったりで乗り越えろ！一歩のミスでやり直し、失敗自体が大笑いのネタ。友情よりゲームが第一。罵り合いもハグも、どうぞご自由に！
items.title: Stuck Together

items.description: Tingus Goose is a delightfully absurd idle game where you plant seeds in patients, bounce babies for profit, and ascend through surreal worlds toward riches.
items.description_ja: 奇妙なグースの木を育成するクリッカーゲーム。各ステージでは、グースの木に「ブロッサム」を配置し、収益を高めて目標を目指す。グースがぐんぐん伸びていく一方で、地下の根もまた静かに広がっていく。この不思議な光景をただ見ているだけなのに、なぜか目が離せない。
items.title: Tingus Goose

items.description: A psychological horror anthology inspired by real-life cases. In Route 86, a group of friends ends up in a remote nightmare. Explore, hide, and survive in this first-person experience with multiple playable characters and rising tension.
items.description_ja: A psychological horror anthology inspired by real-life cases. In Route 86, a group of friends ends up in a remote nightmare. Explore, hide, and survive in this first-person experience with multiple playable characters and rising tension.
items.title: Tales Beyond The Tomb - Route 86

items.description: Beso's Shawarma is a short, narrative-driven horror game. A late-night call lures you on a surreal journey through empty streets to a sketchy shawarma shop. Talk to a cast of strange characters, make a terrifying choice, and try to escape a disjointed, looping nightmare.
items.description_ja: Beso's Shawarma is a short, narrative-driven horror game. A late-night call lures you on a surreal journey through empty streets to a sketchy shawarma shop. Talk to a cast of strange characters, make a terrifying choice, and try to escape a disjointed, looping nightmare.
items.title: Beso's Shawarma

items.description: "Arai-san Mansion Exploration Game: Incarnation" is a command-based text adventure based on the "Kemono Friends". As an investigator, explore an eerie mansion with astronomical floors. Use your skills and Ally cards to survive anomalies, and find a way to contain the mystery.
items.description_ja: 「アライさんマンション探索ゲーム～Incarnation～」は、天文学的な数の階層が広がる不気味なマンションを調査する、「けものフレンズ」「アライさんマンション」を原作とした、コマンド選択式のテキストアドベンチャーゲームです。プレイヤーは調査員として、フレンズとの協力やスキルを駆使し、怪異が潜む未知の階層へと挑みます。限られたリソースの中で「探索」と「撤退」を判断し、マンションの安全な収容方法を解明してください。
items.title: Arai-san Mansion Exploration Game: Incarnation

items.description: Your neighbor invites you on a double date, setting you up with the new girl from out of town. After sneaking into an abandoned house, your neighbor suggests everyone play a game, 67 Minutes in Heaven.
items.description_ja: Your neighbor invites you on a double date, setting you up with the new girl from out of town. After sneaking into an abandoned house, your neighbor suggests everyone play a game, 67 Minutes in Heaven.
items.title: 67 Minutes in Heaven

items.description: Immerse yourself in an adaptation of an old story about Ewan Berrington.
items.description_ja: イワン・ベリントンにまつわる古い物語に、あなたはのみこまれていく。
items.title: Fibrillation HD

items.description: Master of Magic is a classic, one of the most popular strategy games of the 90s. It is a 4X fantasy strategy game that allows you to play as an extremely powerful wizard, leading your troops and overcoming your magical opponents.
items.description_ja: Master of Magic is a classic, one of the most popular strategy games of the 90s. It is a 4X fantasy strategy game that allows you to play as an extremely powerful wizard, leading your troops and overcoming your magical opponents.
items.title: Master of Magic Classic

items.description: WARNING: This game contains puns, dad jokes, flappy-bird-like-arcade-minigames, breaking of the 4th wall and jabs directed at tryhard-overly-serious-RPGS. Do not play if you hate FUN or would not like to strap in for a Hilarious quest for The Legendary Villain-Beating Artifact™.
items.description_ja: 警告：このゲームには、シリアスな激ムズRPGへのオヤジギャグと辛辣なジョークが含まれます。
items.title: Sir Whoopass™: Immortal Death

items.description: Cosmodread is a VR survival horror roguelike about escaping a dying spaceship filled with nightmares. Stranded in a hostile universe, you must explore, survive, and find your way back to the safety of Earth.
items.description_ja: Cosmodreadは、悪夢に満ちた死にかけの宇宙船から脱出する、VRサバイバルホラーローグライクゲームです。厳しい宇宙に取り残されたあなたは、探索し、生き延び、安全な地球に戻る方法を見つけなければなりません。
items.title: Cosmodread

items.description: Missing Children | 行方不明 is a Japanese horror-themed adventure game about a bully detective searching for reported missing children.
items.description_ja: Missing Children | 行方不明は、いじめ探偵として行方不明の子どもを探すゲームであり、和風ホラーをテーマにしたアドベンチャーゲームです。
items.title: [Chilla's Art] Missing Children | 行方不明

items.description:
MOTHER is a first-person psychological horror game about protecting your children while descending deeper & deeper into madness. 


Defend them at all costs. Be careful, because their death is permanent!
items.description_ja:
MOTHER is a first-person psychological horror game about protecting your children while descending deeper & deeper into madness. 


Defend them at all costs. Be careful, because their death is permanent!
items.title: MOTHER

items.description: The Crackpet Show is an action-packed rogue-lite shoot’em-up about mutated animals that fight in a bizarre TV show, crushing their opponents with a variety of weapons. Choose your beastie, gear ‘em up, and go kill your enemies in the name of fame and sweet sponsorship deals!
items.description_ja: クレイジーペットショーは、アクションいっぱいのローグライト シューティングゲーム。奇妙なテレビ番組に、突然変異した動物が登場し、さまざまな武器を使って敵と対戦していきます。動物を選んで、装備を整え、敵を倒して、名声と豪華なスポンサー契約を手に入れてください！
items.title: The Crackpet Show

items.description: A surreal mind-bending journey into the depths of madness. You assume the role of Tom, a man hopelessly in love with Daisy, who embarks on a psychedelic adventure through a bizarre and unpredictable world.
items.description_ja: 狂気の深淵へと至る超現実的な心を曲げる旅。あなたはデイジーに絶望的に恋しているトムの役割を果たし、奇妙で予測不可能な世界を通してサイケデリックな冒険に乗り出します。
items.title: The Indigo Parallel

items.description: In the world where all answers were told the great enemies confronted each other. The time has come. Time to defeat Obama once and for all. Will the world be free from racism or you will start a new era? It is up to you. But keep in mind... Obama has no chill.
items.description_ja: In the world where all answers were told the great enemies confronted each other. The time has come. Time to defeat Obama once and for all. Will the world be free from racism or you will start a new era? It is up to you. But keep in mind... Obama has no chill.
items.title: Obama Boss Fight

items.description: Someone told me to go touch some grass.  I'm pretty sure this is what they meant.
items.description_ja: Someone told me to go touch some grass.  I'm pretty sure this is what they meant.
items.title: Touch Some Grass

items.description_ja: VHS、最もレトロで懐かしい放置ゲーム！
items.title: VHS

items.description:
A new life begins in a low-cost apartment.
Strange occurrences at night and the suspicious behavior of neighbors gradually push the protagonist to the edge.
items.description_ja:
格安アパートで始まる新生活。
夜中の奇妙な現象と隣人の不審な行動が主人公を追い詰めていく。
items.title: Haunted Property

items.description: Skinwalker Hunt is a horror themed hunting game from the creator of Witch Hunt. Main focus of the game is on exploration, non-linear gameplay, and atmosphere.
items.description_ja: Skinwalker Huntは、Witch Huntの制作者が手がけるホラーをテーマにした狩猟ゲームです。探索、一本道ではないゲームプレイ、そして雰囲気を重視しています。

items.description: You can’t run from your dreams in this unsettling classic point-and-click horror game from award-winning indie developer scriptwelder. To find a way out, you’ll have to go even deeper into your nightmares.
items.description_ja: You can’t run from your dreams in this unsettling classic point-and-click horror game from award-winning indie developer scriptwelder. To find a way out, you’ll have to go even deeper into your nightmares.

items.description:
Enjoy chill Lo-fi walks and fight bosses to K-POP, EDM and Hip-Hop inspired tracks.
Features a quirky story, 30 handcrafted levels and various EX-modes to refresh your gameplay.
items.description_ja:
オリジナルの楽曲と奇想天外なストーリーモードで展開する、スピード感溢れるリズムアクションゲーム。
リズムバトルでかわいいボスを倒し、好奇心をそそる3D環境でビートに合わせて走りましょう。さまざまなモードでレベルをアレンジして、挑戦とリプレイの楽しみが無限に広がります。
シュガーダディ王を止められるか？
items.title: Rhythm Sprout: Sick Beats & Bad Sweets

items.description: A short, single-player horror action game starring Carl, the suburban house frog. Will you be able to conquer arcade challenges, solve puzzles, and Ribbit and Tear your way back to the life you once knew?
items.description_ja: A short, single-player horror action game starring Carl, the suburban house frog. Will you be able to conquer arcade challenges, solve puzzles, and Ribbit and Tear your way back to the life you once knew?
items.title: Frog Legs

items.description: Free single-player Backrooms game developed on a low budget.
items.description_ja: Free single-player Backrooms game developed on a low budget.
items.title: Budget Backrooms

items.description: Lovecraft meets Papers, Please. Play as a lighthouse keeper and guide ships safely into the harbor using your radio. Survive the presence of something impossible, and don’t let the shadows consume you!
items.description_ja: ラヴクラフト風の世界で『Papers, Please』のような体験を。灯台守となって無線で船を港に導こう。不可能な存在に耐え、影に飲み込まれないように生き延びろ！
items.title: Static Dread: The Lighthouse

items.description: Physics engine-powered trendy toy figures, automatic battles, customizable moves, bring your friends and fight crickets together online!
items.description_ja: 物理エンジン搭載のトレンディなおもちゃフィギュア、自動バトル、カスタマイズ可能な技、友達を連れてオンラインでコオロギ対戦を楽しもう！
items.title: Flash Doll

items.description:
An atmospheric climbing experience for solo players or up to 4 in co-op.
A short, minimalist platformer about the cold, isolation, and quiet persistence.
items.description_ja:
シングルプレイ、または最大4人の協力プレイで楽しめる、情緒あふれる登山体験。
寒さ、孤独、そして静かな忍耐を描いた、短編ミニマル・プラットフォーマー。
items.title: But Why?

items.description: The breakout title from Summitsphere, Antonball Deluxe is a retro, high-octane smorgasbord of ballbusting arcade action! Antonball Deluxe quite literally turns the breakout genre on its head, blending traditional brick-breaking gameplay with tight, intense platforming.
items.description_ja: The breakout title from Summitsphere, Antonball Deluxe is a retro, high-octane smorgasbord of ballbusting arcade action! Antonball Deluxe quite literally turns the breakout genre on its head, blending traditional brick-breaking gameplay with tight, intense platforming.

items.description: A mind-bending puzzler where your avatar controls another avatar via an in-game keyboard.
items.description_ja: A mind-bending puzzler where your avatar controls another avatar via an in-game keyboard.

items.description: The rise and fall of a rock n' roll star.
items.description_ja: The rise and fall of a rock n' roll star.
items.title: A Chamber of Stars

items.description: PETSITTER WANTED. A horror point-and-click adventure game. Water the plants, feed the pets, and DON'T turn off the lights.
items.description_ja: ペットシッター急募！　不思議なペットショップでバイトしてみませんか？　ポイント・アンド・クリック型のホラーアドベンチャーゲーム。
items.title: a pet shop after dark

items.description: Meet Henry, merely half a head, yet with the peculiar ability to become any object within their reach! Discover every object’s unique abilities and cleverly combine them to take Henry through their not-so-ordinary everyday life.
items.description_ja: ハーフヘッドのヘンリーと出会おう。触れたらどんなものにも変身できる特別な力を持っている！あらゆるオブジェクトのユニークな力を引き出し、頭を使って組み合わせて、ヘンリーを日常からかけ離れた冒険に連れ出そう。
items.title: Henry Halfhead

items.description: Your average student life quickly descents into horror as a mysterious witch takes over the college... Can you save the girl you love? Or even make it out alive?
items.description_ja: Your average student life quickly descents into horror as a mysterious witch takes over the college... Can you save the girl you love? Or even make it out alive?
items.title: Midnight Witch

items.description: This free version of the United Penguin Kingdom covers the content from one year of in-game time. A city-building game where you build a penguin settlement and satisfy the various needs of your penguins while dealing with seals and killer whales.
items.description_ja: この無料版のペンギン連合の王国は、ゲーム内の1年間の内容を体験可能。ペンギンの集落を建設し、アザラシやシャチを相手にしながら、ペンギンたちのさまざまなニーズを満たす街づくりゲーム。
items.title: United Penguin Kingdom: Huddle up

items.description: This is a survival horror action game in which a young girl "Enri" tries to escape from a mysterious facility filled with blood and madness.
items.description_ja:
少女「エンリ」が血と狂気に満ちた謎の施設からの脱出を目指す、サバイバルホラーアクションゲームです。
物語は、多くの謎を抱えた状態から始まり、先に進むにつれて謎が少しずつ明らかになっていきます。怪物からの逃走、アイテム探し、謎解きなどの要素が含まれています。
items.title: Purgatory -NARAKU-

items.description: Aki is haunted by a curse. In search of salvation, she travels into the memories of a dead classmate, where she must witness three eerie mystical stories and figure out how to break the shackles of misfortune.
items.description_ja:
亡くなった少女の記憶に潜り、死の真相を解き明かせ。
その死の裏に、三人の女子生徒のうち誰かが関わっているのかもしれない──。
items.title: Graces: Posthumous Wish

items.description:
Funny clicker game👆 in which you should increase your chin🤫🧏🏻‍♂️ for becoming trully sigma😎.

items.description_ja: Follow a recluse who is the only being left in the world as she struggles with little things in her everyday life. This game was made entirely out of scanned traditional watercolor art.

items.description: Goat Duty is a multiplayer shooter where you get the chance to shatter other armed goats to pieces in madness and crazy matches. Throw other goats to the deep end, watch them fly, and test your skills while wearing the craziest skins in our four multiplayer modes. Are you ready? Set? GOOOOATS!
items.description_ja: Goat of Duty＜ゴ―トオブデューティー＞は、角まで完全武装したヤギ（ゴート） たちが、メーメー鳴きながら情け無用のデスマッチを繰り広げる、超高速マルチプレイヤーシューターだ。最高にイカした装備＜ゴスチューム＞を装着し、戦友（ヤギ）たちと角を突き合わせ、かつてない奇抜なFPS体験に身を投じよう。さあ君は、ヤギの中のヤギとして、頭角を現わすことができるか……？
items.title: GOAT OF DUTY

items.description: This time, Motherland sent you to fight against the Nazi forces to capture Berlin. Kill enemies to get the maximum chance of survival.
items.description_ja: This time, Motherland sent you to fight against the Nazi forces to capture Berlin. Kill enemies to get the maximum chance of survival.
items.title: BEAR, VODKA, FALL OF BERLIN! 🐻

items.description: Cute cats want to play with you! Chill out with them in your free time! Find differences between two nearly similar artistic paintings.
items.description_ja: かわいい猫があなたと一緒にプレイしたい！あなたの自由な時間を楽しみ、私たちの毛皮の友人を幸せにする！2つの似たような手作りの写真の違いを見つける。
items.title: Cute Cats

items.description: A goofy action RPG. Armed with a plushie, smack down nightmarish foes with cuddly chaos. Cheese the boss. Dodge roll your way to victory!
items.description_ja: へんてこなアクションRPG。ぬいぐるみを武器に、かわいいカオスで悪夢のような敵を打ちのめそう。ボスに挑め。勝利への道を転がりながら回避しよう！
items.title: Plushie from the Sky

items.description: Play minigames and discover the hidden truth in this retro-style horror game
items.description_ja: Play minigames and discover the hidden truth in this retro-style horror game

items.description: Navigate the eerie world of Dreams in the Witch House, a unique blend of point-and-click and RPG-adventure. Unravel occult mysteries in Arkham, maintain your sanity, and survive the May-Eve in this Lovecraftian horror game.
items.description_ja: Navigate the eerie world of Dreams in the Witch House, a unique blend of point-and-click and RPG-adventure. Unravel occult mysteries in Arkham, maintain your sanity, and survive the May-Eve in this Lovecraftian horror game.

items.description: Can this last case of Oliver, all be just a small part of a bigger picture? Gather clues, unravel the mystery behind the case and uncover the truth.
items.description_ja: このオリバーの最後の事件は、もっと大きな写真の一部ではないかもしれませんか？手がかりを集め、事件の謎を解き明かし、真実を突き止めましょう。
items.title: File Destined

items.description_ja: A terrible darkness threatens a world of overwhelmingly adorable mares. Can a new cute mare with amnesia save the world or will she lose more than her memories along the way?
