items.description: "Charming Hearts" is a real-life interactive dating game. Players will meet, get to know, and fall in love with different types of beauty. Every choice will lead to a completely different chemical reaction with "her"; every entanglement, the sweet love is entangled and pulled.
items.description_ja: "Charming Hearts" is a real-life interactive dating game. Players will meet, get to know, and fall in love with different types of beauty. Every choice will lead to a completely different chemical reaction with "her"; every entanglement, the sweet love is entangled and pulled.
items.title: Charming Hearts

items.description: Crush someone's skull, Suffer from Hypothermia, Transcend your Mortal Frame, Find all 10 Endings. GET YOUR HOUSE BACK.
items.description_ja: Crush someone's skull, Suffer from Hypothermia, Transcend your Mortal Frame, Find all 10 Endings. GET YOUR HOUSE BACK.
items.title: This Is Not Your House

items.description:
Puni the Florist is a cozy flower shop simulation game that highlights creative expressions.
Manage the shop, design unique bouquets, and join Puni on a silly, wholesome, and relatable journey of self-discovery.
items.description_ja: 『Puni the Florist』は、花と彩りで想いをかたちにする、心あたたまるお花屋さんシミュレーションゲームです。お店を切り盛りしながら、世界にひとつだけの花束を作ってみませんか？ちょっとヘンテコで心温まる、そして誰もがどこか共感できる、そんなプニの自分探しの旅へ一緒に出かけましょう。
items.title: Puni the Florist

items.description: Dog Witch is a roguelike deckbuilder where your spells are fueled by enchanted dice. Combine over 150 unique items to forge ever-evolving strategies, perfect synergy combos, summon minions, and tackle an endless range of foes so bizarre, they’ll leave your tail wagging in disbelief!
items.description_ja: 魔法のダイスが紡ぐ戦略ローグライク！『Dog Witch』は、ダイスで発動する呪文と150種以上のユニークアイテムを組み合わせ、無限に進化する戦略を構築するローグライク・デッキビルダー。型破りな敵と白熱のバトルを繰り広げ、召喚した仲間たちとともに、狂気に満ちた冒険へ飛び込め！
items.title: DOG WITCH

items.description:
Lucius game has been demade, and is now ready for mayhem.
Enjoy all the gore now in fewer pixels and fewer colors.
The original game has been fully demade to achieve the atmosphere of an 80's style gory adventure. Lucius is now killing all the pixels and there isn't a damn thing anyone can do about it.
items.description_ja:
Lucius game has been demade, and is now ready for mayhem.
Enjoy all the gore now in fewer pixels and fewer colors.
The original game has been fully demade to achieve the atmosphere of an 80's style gory adventure. Lucius is now killing all the pixels and there isn't a damn thing anyone can do about it.
items.title: Lucius Demake

items.description:
GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you.

Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?
items.description_ja:
GONE Fishing は、1〜8人で遊べるサバイバルホラーです。仲間と力を合わせ、釣りで生き延びましょう。生き残る唯一の方法は、湖の底なしの飢えを満たし続けること。さもなければ、喰われるのはあなたです。

あなたはその飢えを満たせるか……それとも、次の生贄になるか？
items.title: GONE Fishing

items.description: You've been hired by a real estate agency to photograph their listings at night, giving them a unique look online. Grab your camera, explore dark, quiet homes, and capture every required shot before the property notices you. Uncover the truth: why do these listings need to be photographed at night?
items.description_ja: You've been hired by a real estate agency to photograph their listings at night, giving them a unique look online. Grab your camera, explore dark, quiet homes, and capture every required shot before the property notices you. Uncover the truth: why do these listings need to be photographed at night?
items.title: FLASH AND DIE

items.description: Explore what is around every corner in hopes for answers to where you're going and why.
items.description_ja: Explore what is around every corner in hopes for answers to where you're going and why.
items.title: Greetings

items.description: Wells, pitfalls, houses, villagers, monsters (!?), anything around you can be a weapon! An action RPG that you've never seen before,  you can fight with all the objects you see in the game. There are more than 300 kinds of weapons.Aim to complete the weapon gallery!
items.description_ja: 井戸、落とし穴、家、村人、モンスター（!?）周りにあるものが、なんでも武器になる！ゲームに登場するものすべてを武器にして戦う、新感覚爽快武器集めアクションRPGです。300種類以上ある武器をすべて集めて、武器図鑑をコンプリートしよう。
items.title: The World is Your Weapon

items.description: Use our innovative patented funky fresh ChairF*cker simulation tech to meet the chair of your wildest dreams.
items.description_ja: Use our innovative patented funky fresh ChairF*cker simulation tech to meet the chair of your wildest dreams.
items.title: Chair F*cking Simulator

items.description: The Director, a psycho killer, has chosen you to play the main character in his next film. Will you play your part and survive the night or will you be his latest victim?
items.description_ja: The Director, a psycho killer, has chosen you to play the main character in his next film. Will you play your part and survive the night or will you be his latest victim?
items.title: The Director's Disorder: Pilot Episode

items.description:
This is a simple story about young people, about the aroma of youth and the smells of life, which can so easily be cut short by a fatal accident.
Or maybe at the behest of a heartless fate.
items.description_ja:
This is a simple story about young people, about the aroma of youth and the smells of life, which can so easily be cut short by a fatal accident.
Or maybe at the behest of a heartless fate.
items.title: Aroma

items.description: A procedural first-person horror adventure. You are on your own after something goes terribly wrong in this top-secret containment facility. Collect items to aid in your escape and try to uncover the truth, as horror lurks behind every door. Can you make it out alive?
items.description_ja: A procedural first-person horror adventure. You are on your own after something goes terribly wrong in this top-secret containment facility. Collect items to aid in your escape and try to uncover the truth, as horror lurks behind every door. Can you make it out alive?
items.title: SCP – Containment Breach

items.description: YOU ARE THE FINAL BOSS. Brutal synergy arena roguelike. Pick your Final Boss character, equip boss patterns and combine tons of attacks to create unique builds. Play solo or in co-op!
items.description_ja: お前がラストボスだ！シナジーが鍵となる過酷なアリーナローグライク。ボスを選び、ボスパターンを装備し、無数の攻撃を組み合わせて独自のビルドを作れ！ソロまたは協力プレイ可能！
items.title: Noobs Are Coming

items.description: You're Benny, a test character trapped in an unfinished game by a figure called The Designer. She's up against a deadline for her publisher which means it's your last day as a test character. Navigate the facility, dodge game-dev chaos and defy expectations to become the main character.
items.description_ja: You're Benny, a test character trapped in an unfinished game by a figure called The Designer. items.description: ଘ(੭ˊᵕˋ)੭* ੈ✩‧₊˚ Embrace your destiny in Magical Mic Duel: Senpai, Hear My Spell! Your voice commands the forces of fabulousness. Chant spells with conviction, and witness dazzling displays of magical might! The world needs your power. Step up and claim your place as the ultimate magical girl!
items.description_ja: ଘ(੭ˊᵕˋ)੭* ੈ✩‧₊˚魔法少女☆可愛いラブリー★ずきゅんどきゅんばきゅんぶきゅん☆ルルピンでは、あなたは魔法少女と覚醒し、魔法で悪と戦うことになります。画面に表示される呪文を唱えるだけで、あなたの声はAIによって分析され、様々な魔法が発動されます。世界平和のために今すぐ！あなたの力が必要です。
items.title: Magical Mic Duel: Senpai, Hear My Spell

items.description: Night Bus is a thrilling public transit simulator that costs less than a bus ticket! It's your first night on the job: Pick up passengers, take their fares, enjoy the beautiful countryside, and please ignore That Which Has No Eyes.
items.description_ja: Night Bus is a thrilling public transit simulator that costs less than a bus ticket! It's your first night on the job: Pick up passengers, take their fares, enjoy the beautiful countryside, and please ignore That Which Has No Eyes.
items.title: Night Bus

items.description: Become a parliamentarian, create a powerful party, and lead it to victory in this humorous adventure game. Manage your popularity and dignity, use unique powers, and navigate a storyline inspired by current events.
items.description_ja: Become a parliamentarian, create a powerful party, and lead it to victory in this humorous adventure game. Manage your popularity and dignity, use unique powers, and navigate a storyline inspired by current events.
items.title: Politics The Game

items.description: Inspired by SCP-261, you play as a homeless girl struggling to survive in a distorted city using a vending machine that should not exist. Every coin dispenses impossible food that defies biology and logic, and every meal reshapes your fate. How long can you survive before you stop being human?
items.description_ja: Inspired by SCP-261, you play as a homeless girl struggling to survive in a distorted city using a vending machine that should not exist. items.title: Interdimensional Vending Machine

items.description: Play as Vroombi, a brave little robo-vacuum who needs to keep Lily's house nice and clean! Clean away dust, dirt and debris in this satisfying twist on an interactive cleaning simulator. What awaits little Vroombi at night? What is Lily scared of?
items.description_ja: Play as Vroombi, a brave little robo-vacuum who needs to keep Lily's house nice and clean! Clean away dust, dirt and debris in this satisfying twist on an interactive cleaning simulator. What awaits little Vroombi at night? What is Lily scared of?
items.title: 7 Nights with Vroombi

items.description: A short game about an average white-collar worker who struggles to find meaning in a life full of constant overtime and isolation. After an accident lands him in the hospital, Mr. Saitou is spirited away to a strange fantasy world where an unexpected friend takes him on a life-changing adventure.
items.description_ja: どこにでもいる、ごくふつうの会社員が主人公の短編ゲーム。残業続きの孤独な毎日を送るサイトウさんは、いつしか生きる意味を見失っていた。そんなある日、事故で入院することになった彼は、気づくと不思議な世界に…　そこで意外な人物に導かれ、人生を変える冒険の旅に出る。
items.title: Mr. Saitou

items.description: Ever dreamt of working a cash register with no pay or real-life customer interaction? Look no further! This simulation game brings a fresh-take to the notoriously dull tasks of customer service, introducing you to a cast of wacky characters and the baggage they carry.
items.description_ja: Ever dreamt of working a cash register with no pay or real-life customer interaction? Look no further! This simulation game brings a fresh-take to the notoriously dull tasks of customer service, introducing you to a cast of wacky characters and the baggage they carry.
items.title: Check it Out!

items.description: A visual novel about cute melancholic girls!
items.description_ja: A visual novel about cute melancholic girls!
items.title: My Therapy

items.description: For less than the price of a movie ticket, experience your very own horror-fueled slasher flick in Massacre at the Mirage. Step into The Mirage cinema and face a chilling nightmare, where staff and patrons must survive a masked killer's rampage.
items.description_ja: For less than the price of a movie ticket, experience your very own horror-fueled slasher flick in Massacre at the Mirage. Step into The Mirage cinema and face a chilling nightmare, where staff and patrons must survive a masked killer's rampage.

items.description: investigate the evidence left by a stalker and kidnapper and track the fate of a college girl. The player advances and watches the plot by clicking to make choices for the heroine at key moments, with different choices leading to different endings.

items.description: Gamble with your life in this explosive PvP game for 2-4 players. Cut wires, earn cash, use abilities and avoid the detonators. Test your luck, skills and remember to always bet on the boom!
items.description_ja: Gamble with your life in this explosive PvP game for 2-4 players. Cut wires, earn cash, use abilities and avoid the detonators. Test your luck, skills and remember to always bet on the boom!

items.description: You're a young man named Alex who arrives in the cliffside town of Silverpine. Explore the town's many mysteries and meet its colourful townsfolk, while you grow closer to a kind-hearted local named Jake. Can the two of you save the town from the impending doom brewing inside the mysterious Vault?
items.description_ja: You're a young man named Alex who arrives in the cliffside town of Silverpine. Explore the town's many mysteries and meet its colourful townsfolk, while you grow closer to a kind-hearted local named Jake. Can the two of you save the town from the impending doom brewing inside the mysterious Vault?
items.title: Newfound Courage

items.description: Rum & Gun combines fast-paced shooter action with ARPG loot and character building. Journey across the Indian Ocean, uncover the secrets of the Drunken God, and become a legendary pirate captain. You're not on the Caribbean anymore...
items.description_ja: Rum & Gun combines fast-paced shooter action with ARPG loot and character building. Journey across the Indian Ocean, uncover the secrets of the Drunken God, and become a legendary pirate captain. You're not on the Caribbean anymore...
items.title: Rum & Gun

items.description: From the sick mind behind Bloodwash, Jordan King, comes his latest experiment in terror. Inspired by the Italian zombie flicks from Lucio Fulci and Bruno Mattei, Night of the Gates of Hell promises to be a blood dripping, neon soaked, flesh rotting experience.
items.description_ja: From the sick mind behind Bloodwash, Jordan King, comes his latest experiment in terror. Inspired by the Italian zombie flicks from Lucio Fulci and Bruno Mattei, Night of the Gates of Hell promises to be a blood dripping, neon soaked, flesh rotting experience.
items.title: Night At the Gates of Hell

items.description: Emerald seas! Blue skies! Sandy beaches! An island adventure in the ocean sounds like a trip to paradise. However, the place is a nightmare with no one to provide any blood for Raylan to feed on after he turned into a vampire by accident, especially since he has another hungry vampire at his side.
items.description_ja: 蒼い海！青い空！砂浜！ヤシの木！遥かな海の無人島探検。多くの冒険者は心躍らせることだろう。しかし、不幸にもヴァンパイアになってしまったレーランにとって、吸血する相手のいない場所で生き延びるなど悪夢に等しい。そのうえ、腹を空かせたヴァンパイアをもう一人連れているのだ……
items.title: Vampires' Melody 2

items.description: Croakoloco is a relaxing frog collecting idle game. Watch them jump, croak, and eat delicious flies. Grow frogs, feed frogs, or take control of one in “Froggy Mode” for a more active play style!
items.description_ja: 『Croakoloco』は、心休まる収集系放置ゲーム。跳んで、ゲコゲコ鳴いて、ハエをモグモグ… そんなカエルたちを育てて、餌をやり、時には「ケロケロモード」で操作しよう！
items.title: Croakoloco

items.description: One hunter & up to 9 friends disguised as deer. A game of hide-and-seek where every move could be your last. Will you blend in with the herd or stand out? Oh Deer...
items.description_ja: ハンター1人、最大4人の友達がシカに変装しています。 このスリリングなかくれんぼゲームでは、すべての動きが最後かもしれません。 あなたは群れに紛れるか、目立ちますか？ オー、シカ...
items.title: Oh Deer

items.description: Alone on a remote island, you're tasked with keeping a lighthouse. But the horrific events that claimed the lives of previous keepers still whisper through the air. Each day, the line between reality and delusion fades and something in the dark is waiting for the last keeper
items.description_ja: Alone on a remote island, you're tasked with keeping a lighthouse. But the horrific events that claimed the lives of previous keepers still whisper through the air. Each day, the line between reality and delusion fades and something in the dark is waiting for the last keeper

items.description: An online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time. Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole.
items.description_ja: 打順の概念がない、1～8人用の同時進行型オンラインゴルフゲーム！ 打って、撃って、妨害しちゃって、なんでもアリの大乱戦で真っ先にカップインを目指そう。
items.title: Super Battle Golf

items.description: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator is a silly and super tough physics based shooter puzzler in which you attempt to help a drunken redneck hit targets without accidentally shooting himself with a ricochet.
items.description_ja: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator is a silly and super tough physics based shooter puzzler in which you attempt to help a drunken redneck hit targets without accidentally shooting himself with a ricochet.
items.title: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator

items.description: Experience 64 endings in a web of insane mini games and hand drawn artwork as Marty tries his dang ol' best to enjoy his family vacation.
items.description_ja: Experience 64 endings in a web of insane mini games and hand drawn artwork as Marty tries his dang ol' best to enjoy his family vacation.
items.title: Air Marty

items.description: Mothmen 1966 is a 'Pixel Pulp' - a visual novel fusing exceptional writing and stunning illustration, inspired by mid-20th century pulp fiction and 80s home computer graphics - set amongst the strange occurrences of the Leonid meteor shower of 1966.
items.description_ja: モスメン 1966は『ピクセル・パルプ（ドット絵のパルプフィクション）』で、優れた文章と美しいイラストが融合したビジュアルノベルゲームです。20世紀半ばのパルプ・フィクションと80年代のPCのグラフィックスにインスパイアされ、1966年のしし座流星群の際に起きた奇妙な出来事を舞台にしています。
items.title: Mothmen 1966

items.description: Burnhouse Lane tells a story of Angie Weather, a one foot in the grave agency nurse attempting to complete five impossible tasks in order to win her life back. Solve puzzles, make friends and enemies, run, hide and fight in this dark adventure that'll take you on a trip to another world and back...
items.description_ja: バーンハウス・レーンは派遣看護師アンジー・ウェザーの物語。彼女は片足を棺おけに突っ込んでいるが、五つの不可能に近い試練を遂行できれば、自分の命を勝ち取れる。この闇の冒険では彼女と共に異世界に飛び込んでパズルを解いたり、友達や敵を作ったり、逃げたり、隠れたり、戦ったりして暗黒その物を乗り越える。アンジーは果たして自分の人生を取り戻せるのか…
items.title: Burnhouse Lane

items.description: USAC: Code Breach™ is a unique coop experience set in a cyberpunk universe. As a special police unit, you and your partner are called in to investigate the unexpected shutdown of a high-tech research facility. Between reflection and action, you must survive a situation that is beyond you.

items.description_ja: Doll Impostor is a horror game where 1-4 players take on the role of guardians of possessed dolls. Work together to identify the impostor doll before 9 a.m, or face dire consequences. Every hour counts in this tense, fear-filled race against time.

items.description: The You Quiz is a multiplayer game where the questions are about you! Be the King and judge your friends' answers about yourself. Or be a Courtier, guess their quirks, tastes, and dreams. Invite up to 7 friends for free using the Friend's Pass!
items.description_ja:
The You Quizは、“あなたのこと”をテーマにしたマルチプレイヤーゲーム！
王様になって、友だちがあなたについて答えた内容をジャッジしよう。
あるいは家臣になって、その人のクセや好み、夢を当ててみよう。
Friend's Passを使えば、最大7人の友だちを無料で招待して一緒に遊べるよ！
items.title: The You Quiz

items.description: Rage Quit is a first-person melee game where the player uses only the sledgehammer for combat, traversal, and defense against hordes of office-bots. Use a fluid variety of light, heavy, dash-based, and reflective attacks to smash your way through your foes and enact revenge!
items.description_ja: Rage Quit is a first-person melee game where the player uses only the sledgehammer for combat, traversal, and defense against hordes of office-bots. Use a fluid variety of light, heavy, dash-based, and reflective attacks to smash your way through your foes and enact revenge!

items.description: Play a flute to solve puzzles and unlock secrets, looking for an exit of a dark place before the darkness consumes everything. In this dark immersive horror puzzle game, knowledge is key to put the pieces together. No music experience required.
items.description_ja: Play a flute to solve puzzles and unlock secrets, looking for an exit of a dark place before the darkness consumes everything. In this dark immersive horror puzzle game, knowledge is key to put the pieces together. No music experience required.
items.title: Fugaz

items.description: In Serve Or Die, you work alone in a small sandwich shop during the night shift. With a VHS-inspired style and an increasingly unsettling atmosphere, survive as simple orders turn into something far more disturbing.
items.description_ja: Serve Or Die では、夜勤中に小さなサンドイッチ店で一人きりで働きます。VHS風のスタイルと、次第に不穏さを増していく雰囲気の中で、単純な注文がはるかに不気味なものへと変わっていく状況を生き延びましょう。
items.title: Serve Or Die

items.description:
“I’ll tell you a scary story. It’s so scary you might not be able to take it. It’s the story of the Sand Man...”
This is the second title in the Strange Man series, developed by Uri Games. Unable to sleep and exhausted, Sophie wanders into a town where everything sleeps. That is where the terror begins...
items.description_ja:
『こわい話をしてあげるわ。こわくてこわくてたまらない、サンドマンのお話―――』
本作はUri Gamesが開発した「The Strange Man」シリーズの第二作目です。不眠症に悩まされるソフィーが迷い込んだのは、すべてが眠る街。そこからはじまる、恐怖の数々をお楽しみください。
items.title: The Sand Man

items.description: A racing game with cubes on constantly changing tracks to mess with your friends in the fairest way possible
items.description_ja: A racing game with cubes on constantly changing tracks to mess with your friends in the fairest way possible
items.title: Cube Racer 2

items.description:
Hidden object game in the cartoon city style.
Ultra hard! Really very difficult!
items.description_ja:
Hidden object game in the cartoon city style.
Ultra hard! Really very difficult!
items.title: 100 hidden birds

items.description:
Satori's overworked herself into bed, but Okuu needs help remembering things!
You can't use her heart-reading power, and will instead have to ask questions and use her power of recollection to correct wrong info,
all while enduring visits from Orin and Koishi as you deduce what Okuu's forgotten!
items.description_ja:
過労で倒れてしまったさとりの元に重要なことをいろいろと忘れてしまったお空がやってきた！
読心能力がうまく作動しない中でも何度も問答を繰り返し想起の力で勘違いを正し
お燐やこいしの襲来にも対処しながらお空の忘れてしまったものを思い出させてあげよう！
items.title: Help Me Remember, Satori-sama!

items.description: The epic conclusion of the CURSED trilogy.
items.description_ja: The epic conclusion of the CURSED trilogy.
items.title: Cursed 3

items.description: Weep for the dead! In this short psychological horror story, play as a professional mourner travelling between funerals. Ride a nightmarish bus whose destination depends on how you choose to face your traumas.
items.description_ja: Weep for the dead! In this short psychological horror story, play as a professional mourner travelling between funerals. Ride a nightmarish bus whose destination depends on how you choose to face your traumas.
items.title: I Did Not Buy This Ticket

items.description: An eerie liminal game that explores just how far an angel can fall. Play as sapphic Lucifer and corrupt angels into falling... in love with you.
items.description_ja: An eerie liminal game that explores just how far an angel can fall. Play as sapphic Lucifer and corrupt angels into falling... in love with you.
items.title: Seraphim Slum

items.description: Play the first game of many! Wittle Mistakes is a mechanics-based third-person 3D adventure where players navigate the trials of infancy within the Mother Corporation. Unveil the dark secrets that Mother has been hiding. The playpen awaits! Built by an insane two-man team.
items.description_ja: Play the first game of many! Wittle Mistakes is a mechanics-based third-person 3D adventure where players navigate the trials of infancy within the Mother Corporation. Unveil the dark secrets that Mother has been hiding. The playpen awaits! Built by an insane two-man team.
items.title: Wittle Mistakes - Prologue

items.description: Panelak is an old socialist-era building where strange things happen. Can you make it to the roof and help the helpless man?
items.description_ja: Panelak is an old socialist-era building where strange things happen. Can you make it to the roof and help the helpless man?
items.title: Panelak

items.description: A game for players who adore humorous fantasy adventures. A sprawling turn-based JRPG offering 50 hours of meticulously crafted plot, engaging quests, and no unnecessary grind. Four gorgeous yet utterly misguided heroines set out on perilous yet wildly entertaining adventures.
items.description_ja:
ユーモア溢れるファンタジー冒険譚を愛するプレイヤーへ贈る。緻密に練り込まれた50時間のストーリーと魅力的なクエストが詰まった、ボリューム満点のターン制JRPG。無意味なレベル上げ作業は一切なし！
美しくも、どうしようもなく「ポンコツ」な4人のヒロインたちが、危険で、そして最高に愉快な冒険へと旅立ちます。
items.title: Heroines of Swords & Spells 2

items.description: From Orange Juice comes a shoot'em'up starring the lone enhanced human, Sora. The sequel of the high-speed shoot'em'up "Suguri", with improved game system and graphics.
items.description_ja: 人工的に強化された孤独な少女ソラは滅びつつある世界を救うために奮闘する
items.title: Sora

items.description: A dark sci-fi horror where ancient rituals intertwine with secret Soviet experiments. Explore atmospheric tunnels, hidden laboratories, and abandoned shrines inspired by real locations—and survive by solving intricate, mind-bending puzzles.
items.description_ja:
古代の儀式とソ連の実験が交錯する、ダークなSFホラー。
濃密な雰囲気の中、実在の場所に着想を得た禁断の地を探索せよ。要塞のトンネル、隠された研究所、そして古代の聖域があなたを待ち受けている。
items.title: LYSA HORA: The Haunted Hill

items.description: Explore the exciting world of slavic legends!
items.description_ja: スラブ神話のエキサイティングな世界を探検しましょう！
items.title: Eventide: Slavic Fable

items.description: A raccoon co-op extraction game for 1-8 players, blending goofy horror with a roguelite twist. Loot procedural ruins, extract relics, defeat powerful bosses and rescue NPCs together… All while Mammon, the Greed Demon, tests your trust in each other.
items.description_ja: アライグマになってお宝を持ち帰る、1～8人用の協力型エクストラクションゲーム。おバカなホラーにローグライト要素をプラス！自動生成の遺跡でお宝を漁り、遺物を回収し、仲間と強大なボスを倒してNPCを救い出そう…その間も、強欲の悪魔マモンは仲間同士の信頼を試してくる。
items.title: Greedy

items.description: FOR THE POWER AND GLORY; NOW AND FOREVER
items.description_ja: FOR THE POWER AND GLORY; NOW AND FOREVER
items.title: Lucah: Born of a Dream

items.description: Silvia never runs from evil—she makes it her business. Eccentric yet warm-hearted, this seasoned modern exorcist has mastered the art of confronting the supernatural, turning haunted places into tangible nightmares. But on this fateful night, nothing goes as planned.
items.description_ja: シルビアは決して悪から逃げない――それこそが彼女の仕事。風変わりだが情に厚いこの熟練の現代エクソシストは、超常的な存在への対処法を極め、呪われた場所を現実の悪夢へと変えてしまう。だが、この運命の夜は、すべてが思わぬ方向へと転がっていく。
items.title: Evil Tonight

items.description: Pumpkin Eater is a visual novel about grief, pumpkin heads, and human decomposition. 100% medically accurate.
items.description_ja: Pumpkin Eater is a visual novel about grief, pumpkin heads, and human decomposition. 100% medically accurate.
items.title: Pumpkin Eater

items.description: Cultivate a thriving farm to survive in this peaceful horror farming game! Play online with up to 16 players in the same lobby. Work together with your fellow farmers to repair your tractor and escape the farm, try not to fall victim to the eerie and mysterious creatures that lurk nearby.
items.description_ja: Cultivate a thriving farm to survive in this peaceful horror farming game! Play online with up to 16 players in the same lobby. Work together with your fellow farmers to repair your tractor and escape the farm, try not to fall victim to the eerie and mysterious creatures that lurk nearby.
items.title: Cryptid Farm

items.description: Explore the inner demons of three childhood friends on a summer retreat. Unearth secrets, fears and obsessions as you help them reconnect and rediscover themselves. A mature and treacherous visual novel from the creator of Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star.
items.description_ja: 幼なじみ３人の中に潜む悪魔を探検する夏の逃避行。彼らの秘密、恐怖、執着を解き明かし、絆を取り戻し、自分自身を再発見する手助けをしよう。『ミルキーウェイ・プリンス〜ヴァンパイア・スター〜』のクリエイターが贈る、よく熟れた、そして不穏なビジュアルノベル。
items.title: Mediterranea Inferno

items.description: Night Security | 夜間警備 is a Japanese psychological horror game about night security.
items.description_ja: Night Security | 夜間警備 is a Japanese psychological horror game about night security.
items.title: [Chilla's Art] Night Security | 夜間警備

items.description: Fast-paced first-person platformer with character upgrading. Begin your journey across the Devilish Megastructures as a frail, armless priest and grow stronger through sacred relics.
items.description_ja: あなたは世界を救うために武器を持たないまま悪魔の住処に乗り込んだ最後の神父。美に満ちた一人称のアクションホラー・プラットフォーマー作品。
items.title: Blessed Burden

items.description: Featuring a blend of 2D adventure and visual novel. Chapter 1 is the very beginning of the grim tale about a village inhabited only by children who follow savage pagan traditions. A young witch Kyrphel, along with her sisters, are bound to perform a macabre Ritual in order to save their village.
items.description_ja: 2Dアドベンチャーとビジュアルノベルを融合した本作の第1章は、荒々しい異教の伝統を受け継ぐ子どもたちだけが暮らす村を舞台にした、陰鬱な物語の幕開けです。若き魔女キルフェルは、姉妹たちとともに、村を救うため、身の毛もよだつ儀式を執り行うことを余儀なくされます。
items.title: The Mildew Children: Chapter 1

items.description: FISHGUN is a chaotic fish-person shooter where you feed your sentient gun random upgrades to defeat hordes of evil fruit.
items.description_ja: FISHGUN is a chaotic fish-person shooter where you feed your sentient gun random upgrades to defeat hordes of evil fruit.
items.title: FISHGUN

items.description: An old shack deep in a dense forest, a strange computer and a game that's trying to kill you!
items.description_ja: 密林の奥深くにある古い小屋、奇妙なコンピューター、そしてあなたを殺そうとするゲーム！
items.title: Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?

items.description: As an adventurer, you have unintentionally uncovered a horrifying secret hidden in the town for years. Every choice you make will shape the story and become part of your personality test. Will you be the hero who saves the villagers, or will you sacrifice them to create your own legend?
items.description_ja:
記憶を失った冒険者が、記憶を取り戻す過程で、町に長く隠されていた恐ろしい秘密を偶然にも明らかにする。
プレイヤーの選択は、物語の展開を形作るだけでなく、性格診断の一部にもなる。
果たして、英雄として村人たちを血まみれの危機から救い出すのか？それとも、自分の冒険を成し遂げるために彼らを犠牲にするのか？すべてはあなた次第……
items.title: The Apocalypse Sacrifice

items.description: The main character is an experienced journalist who always strives to uncover the truth. He manages to gain access to the house, which is guarded by the police.
items.description_ja: The main character is an experienced journalist who always strives to uncover the truth. He manages to gain access to the house, which is guarded by the police.
items.title: April 24th

items.description: Follow the story of a young boy, Cantus as he meets Maris, the mysterious girl by the sea - an experience that will change his life forever.
items.description_ja: Follow the story of a young boy, Cantus as he meets Maris, the mysterious girl by the sea - an experience that will change his life forever.
items.title: Voices from the Sea

items.description:
Under a snowy overpass, people gather around warm lights.
In this cozy management simulation game, run your own POJANGMACHA and serve Korean street foods like tteokbokki and ramyun.
Handle quirky events and grow your tiny stall into a street food success!
items.description_ja:
"雪の降る暗い高架下…温かな灯りに人々が集まる。
ラーメンやたい焼きなど、多彩な韓国ストリートフードを販売しながら「屋台」を経営するシミュレーションゲーム！
予期せぬ出来事やさまざまな状況を乗り越えて、自分だけの屋台を成功へと導こう！"
items.title: POJANGMACHA : Korean Street Food Management Simulator

items.description: Membrillo Hid My Socks is a silly point & click hidden object game about finding your missing socks after your mischievous cat went on a rampage.
items.description_ja: Membrillo Hid My Socks is a silly point & click hidden object game about finding your missing socks after your mischievous cat went on a rampage.
items.title: Membrillo Hid My Socks

items.description: You wake up in a strange place, not knowing who you are, where you are, or how you got here. Trapped in an environment that twists to break your sanity, your only way out is to delve into the unknown and face the horrors of a past your mind is trying to hide.
items.description_ja: You wake up in a strange place, not knowing who you are, where you are, or how you got here. Trapped in an environment that twists to break your sanity, your only way out is to delve into the unknown and face the horrors of a past your mind is trying to hide.
items.title: Unanswered

items.description: Cutie anime girl realizes her cool big bro is missing?? Cheese it up with Chizuru and SHOOT TO THE BEAT OF THE SONG in this top down bullet hell shooter! Absorb enemy bullets using your waveshines to utilize their bullets as your own! Show those cheeseheads that you're better!
items.description_ja: お兄さんが消えた！？リズムに乗って攻撃すれば敵もチーズの如く溶け落ちる、弾幕アクションシューティング！伝家の宝刀「絶リフ」で敵弾を吸収して脳味噌チーズな奴らにお返しだ！
items.title: Super Ledgehop: Double Laser

items.description: Ninjin: Clash of Carrots is an anime-inspired beat-em-up with varied enemies and deep customization. Play as the rabbit Ninjin, or Akai, the ninja fox, and fight to retrieve the carrots stolen by Shogun Moe! Redeem carrots for weapons, upgrades and more! Supports 2-player online or local co-op.
items.description_ja: Ninjin: Clash of Carrotsは、アニメにアイデアを得た作品で、さまざまな敵や幅広いカスタマイズを備えた戦闘アクションです。ウサギのNinjinまたは忍者狐のAkaiとしてプレイし戦って、Shogun Moeに盗まれたニンジンを奪い返しましょう！ニンジンは武器、アップグレードなどと換金できます！2プレイヤーのオンラインゲームまたはローカルな協力プレイに対応しています。
items.title: Ninjin: Clash of Carrots

items.description: This time, Motherland sent you to fight vs Nazi forces in the ruins of the snowy Stalingrad. Kill enemies and conquer trophy weapons to get the maximum chance to survive.
items.description_ja: This time, Motherland sent you to fight vs Nazi forces in the ruins of the snowy Stalingrad. Kill enemies and conquer trophy weapons to get the maximum chance to survive.
items.title: BEAR, VODKA, STALINGRAD!🐻

items.description: Get ready to explore a movie studio that vanished into thin air, only to find yourself trapped in a twisted, alternate dimension where creatures lurk in the shadows, waiting to ensure you never see the light of day again...
items.description_ja: Get ready to explore a movie studio that vanished into thin air, only to find yourself trapped in a twisted, alternate dimension where creatures lurk in the shadows, waiting to ensure you never see the light of day again...
items.title: Venge

items.description: First there was the Whip/Nae Nae, now it’s time to Wear The Purp with the greatest rappers of all time*! Dance along with the Whiteboyz Wit Attitude in an epic FMV rhythm game, and celebrate the launch of their new album The Pursuit of Money.
items.description_ja: First there was the Whip/Nae Nae, now it’s time to Wear The Purp with the greatest rappers of all time*! Dance along with the Whiteboyz Wit Attitude in an epic FMV rhythm game, and celebrate the launch of their new album The Pursuit of Money.
items.title: Whiteboyz Wit Attitude: The Pursuit of Money

items.description: You are Ava, a survivor out in the wild in the midst of an alien invasion. Fight back as you dodge, jump, roll, and use advanced technology to navigate your escape across terrain and extraterrestrial foes!
items.description_ja: You are Ava, a survivor out in the wild in the midst of an alien invasion. Fight back as you dodge, jump, roll, and use advanced technology to navigate your escape across terrain and extraterrestrial foes!
items.title: Aliens After Ava

items.description: Find all the pictures before Floppa finds you.
items.description_ja: Big Floppa があなたを見つける前に、すべての写真を見つけてください。
items.title: DARK NIGHT WITH FLOPPA

items.description: You wake up in a dark warehouse, tasked with packing orders while something lurks in the shadows. Work fast, stay safe, and protect your cat. He’s all you’ve got.
items.description_ja: あなたは暗い倉庫で目を覚まし、物陰に何かが潜んでいる間に注文の梱包を任される。素早く作業し、安全を確保し、猫を守れ。あなたには猫しかいないのだから。
items.title: ORDER 13

items.description: Find yourself on a mission exploring the depth of an ominous forgotten mine. You arrive barehanded but quickly find the tools needed to go deeper. Destroy the infected living parts of the mine and face the final threat and complete your mission.
items.description_ja: Find yourself on a mission exploring the depth of an ominous forgotten mine. You arrive barehanded but quickly find the tools needed to go deeper. Destroy the infected living parts of the mine and face the final threat and complete your mission.
items.title: The Pulse of Evil

items.description: One night, Lyu Xuan woke up soaked in blood, a mysterious black hole in the palm of her hand, and millions pouring out of that hole, like an unstoppable fountain of wealth. Still in shock, She has to evade the monsters that rushed to her and her new riches. A strange story begins in a gloomy city…
items.description_ja: 夜の中で目を覚ました主人公、呂璇は血の海に身を包まれていました。手には神秘的な黒い穴が広がり、同時に、1億もの驚くべき財産がその穴から這い出ました。恐怖に怯える中、その財宝に引き寄せられたさまざまな異形の怪物が呂璇に向かって押し寄せます。不思議な物語が始まります。
items.title: Raining City: Millions Recollections

items.description: Defend the Oval Office from an endless alien invasion by harnessing the abilities of your favorite (or least favorite) U.S. Presidents.
items.description_ja: Defend the Oval Office from an endless alien invasion by harnessing the abilities of your favorite (or least favorite) U.S. Presidents.
items.title: Presidents Tower Defense

items.description: This is a horror adventure game where a girl, devoted to her best friend, searches for her companion in an aquarium that has transformed into a world of horror. While evading the deformed entities known as "Creepies," the player must unravel the mysteries concealed within the aquarium.
items.description_ja:
親友思いの少女が、恐怖の世界と化した水族館で友人を探すホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。クリーピーと呼ばれる異形の存在から逃れながら、水族館に隠された謎を解き明かしていきましょう。

ホラー要素は弱めで、歯ごたえのある謎解きを楽しむことができます。主人公のほか、個性的で魅力的な少女たちが登場します。物語はマルチエンドで、あなたの選択によって結末が変化します。
items.title: The Aquarium does not dance

items.description: A narrative courtroom adventure all about VTubers! Players will take the role of prosecutor Justin Truth and investigate a murder at a VTuber agency, doing their best to uncover the identity of both the killer and VTuber's real face.
items.description_ja: VTuberをテーマにした法廷ミステリーゲーム！プレイヤーは検察官となり、VTuber事務所で発生した殺人事件に挑みます。「中の人」と「犯人」──二重の謎を解き明かせ！
items.title: The Real Face of a VTuber

items.description: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.
items.description_ja: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.
items.title: Otherside Tapes: Favela

items.description: The premier first-person destructive house cat simulator is back with a vengeance! Play as a mischievous cat, swat your human's possessions onto the floor, scratch up curtains, smash precious keepsakes, and show your owner who's boss.
items.description_ja: あのネコ人称視点ちらかしシミュレーターがパワーアップして帰ってきました！ イタズラ好きな飼い猫になって、ニンゲンの物をパンチして床に落とし、カーテンをひっかき、思い出の品をポイして、飼い主気取りのニンゲンに誰が本当の主人なのか教えてあげましょう。
items.title: Catlateral Damage: Remeowstered

items.description: Will you solve the mystery of the Salazar manor or will you become another permanent inhabitant? An Italian horror inspired adventure game!
items.description_ja: Will you solve the mystery of the Salazar manor or will you become another permanent inhabitant? An Italian horror inspired adventure game!
items.title: The Horror Of Salazar House

items.description: In this 2D puzzle game you have the responsibility to arrange lovely doggos in a way that fits the grid. Dogs Organized Neatly comes with 80 brand-new hand-crafted levels and a whole bunch of dogs in all shapes and sizes.
items.description_ja: この2Dパズルゲームではわんちゃんの友達をピッタリとつめる役目があります。80の手作りステージと様々な形や大きさのいぬがいっぱいます。
items.title: Dogs Organized Neatly

items.description: Welcome to Super Psycho Baseball, a sadistic home-run hitting roguelike in which you try to conquer a gang of pitch-slinging bosses, each more psychotic than the last. Come face five fully-realized pitchers, rack up powerups, and reach the top!
items.description_ja: Welcome to Super Psycho Baseball, a sadistic home-run hitting roguelike in which you try to conquer a gang of pitch-slinging bosses, each more psychotic than the last. Come face five fully-realized pitchers, rack up powerups, and reach the top!
items.title: Super Psycho Baseball

items.description: Monitor camera feeds, report valuable info, and hand-deliver shady packages. An hourly quota of reports will test your keen eye to spot the differences, while timed deliveries will force you outside unexpectedly. Until you clock out for the night almost nowhere is safe.
items.description_ja: Monitor camera feeds, report valuable info, and hand-deliver shady packages. An hourly quota of reports will test your keen eye to spot the differences, while timed deliveries will force you outside unexpectedly. Until you clock out for the night almost nowhere is safe.
items.title: Dead Signal

items.description: The most realistic simulator of the life of ancient Rus during the war with lizards! A historical saga about the greatness of our ancestors, bravely fighting the green plague that outnumbered them!
items.description_ja: トカゲとの戦争中の古代ラスの生活を最もリアルに再現したシミュレーター！数で勝る緑の疫病と勇敢に戦った我々の祖先の偉大さの歴史的なサガ！
items.title: Ancient Russian Life Simulator

items.description: A brand‑new bundle from the creators of the short‑form horror hit Violent Horror Stories. This time the collection revolves around one chilling theme: confinement.
items.description_ja: A brand‑new bundle from the creators of the short‑form horror hit Violent Horror Stories. This time the collection revolves around one chilling theme: confinement.
items.title: Violent Horror Stories 2

items.description:
You are trapped in a small house, suffering from psychosis with no memory.
Carefully observe your surroundings to distinguish reality from hallucinations, and overcome your illness by taking medication from visitors at the right time.
items.description_ja: あなたは記憶を失い、精神病を患い、小さな家に閉じ込められています。周囲を注意深く観察し、現実と幻覚を区別し、訪問者が提供する錠剤を時間通りに服用して病気を克服してください。
items.title: Who's at the door?

items.description: A minimalist 2D platformer about a liquid cat, locked in a world she doesn't quite understand, trying to get out.
items.description_ja: A minimalist 2D platformer about a liquid cat, locked in a world she doesn't quite understand, trying to get out.
items.title: Cats are Liquid - A Light in the Shadows

items.description:
A short narrative and exploration game about Zach, June, and a strange phenomenon. 
You're Zach and, stuck in your home, you will do everything to keep hearing June's voice messages. What is happening out there?
items.description_ja:
A short narrative and exploration game about Zach, June, and a strange phenomenon. 
You're Zach and, stuck in your home, you will do everything to keep hearing June's voice messages. What is happening out there?
items.title: Answer Knot

items.description: Oh no! Jerma985 has fallen into a spooky cavern filled with ROBOT dinosaurs and EVIL warlocks. In this wacky action-platformer, fight to escape the treacherous cavern while a live studio chat cheers you on!
items.description_ja: Oh no! Jerma985 has fallen into a spooky cavern filled with ROBOT dinosaurs and EVIL warlocks. In this wacky action-platformer, fight to escape the treacherous cavern while a live studio chat cheers you on!
items.title: Jerma's Big Adventure

items.description: Battle the corrupt animals of the forest, collect valuable items and abilities, and save the world, TWICE, in this retro-styled RPG adventure! As an official spinoff of the Five Nights at Freddy's horror game series, you can expect familiar characters, loads of secrets, and maybe some scares...
items.description_ja: Battle the corrupt animals of the forest, collect valuable items and abilities, and save the world, TWICE, in this retro-styled RPG adventure! As an official spinoff of the Five Nights at Freddy's horror game series, you can expect familiar characters, loads of secrets, and maybe some scares...
items.title: POPGOES Arcade

items.description: Share the same body with a friend in Split Brain. One of you controls, the other one sees, but the decisions are made together! Face the illusion and uncover the truth to find your way out of Hexarture.
items.description_ja: 友達と同じキャラクターを操作して、「Split Brain」で協力しよう。一方が操作を担当し、もう一方が視覚を担当。しかし、決断は二人で協力して下す！幻影に立ち向かい、真実を明らかにしてHexartureからの脱出を目指そう。
items.title: Split Brain

items.description: Puttler is a mini-golf puzzle game featuring wacky obstacles and a charming backstory. Build contraptions to score the golf ball under par across 15 courses and over 250 unique holes to solve.
items.description_ja: Puttler is a mini-golf puzzle game featuring wacky obstacles and a charming backstory. Build contraptions to score the golf ball under par across 15 courses and over 250 unique holes to solve.
items.title: Puttler

items.description: Are you a quadrober?
items.description_ja: Are you a quadrober?
items.title: Quadrober Simulator

items.description: Become an anime character. Write your own incantations and cast over 100 spells using your microphone. Battle in duels, team fights, and chaotic free-for-all matches.
items.description_ja: アニメキャラクターになろう。自分だけの詠唱を書き、マイクを使って100種類以上のスペルを唱えよう。デュエル、チーム戦、そしてカオスなフリーフォーオールマッチでバトルしよう。
items.title: Super Shout Showdown

items.description:
Zelle is a occult adventure game. 
You can explore the inside and outside of the castle using adventure game mechanics and battle demons with strategic mouse clicks.
Your goal in this game is to bring the protagonist home.
items.description_ja:
Zelleはオカルトアドベンチャーゲームです。
城の中と外を探索するアドベンチャー要素をベースに、マウスクリックによるバトルが盛り込まれています。
あなたのこのゲームでの目的は・・・主人公を「家」に帰してあげること。
items.title: Zelle

items.description: Clea is a jump scare free, skill-based survival horror adventure.
items.description_ja: クレアはドッキリ抜きのプレイヤースキル勝負のサバイバルホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。
items.title: Clea

items.description: An audio-based black comedy action arcade game - Blind Drive is a video game you can play with your eyes closed! 1st person hyper-realistic audio adventure meets fast paced arcade gameplay, driven by an insane B-movie plot.
items.description_ja: 音だけで遊ぶ、ブラックコメディ・アーケードゲーム――目を瞑って遊ぶゲーム、Blind Drive！臨場感溢れるオーディオアドベンチャーに、ハイペースで進行するアーケードタイプのゲーム性がドッキング。B級映画さながらの脚本で、プレイヤーを振り回す。
items.title: Blind Drive

items.description: You wake in a surreal carnival, where a woman cries out to you before leaping to her death. Can either of you be saved? The denizens and devices of Strangeland answer with riddles, puzzles, and warnings of a Dark Thing lurking at the park’s peak. A new adventure from the creators of Primordia.
items.description_ja: You wake in a surreal carnival, where a woman cries out to you before leaping to her death. Can either of you be saved? The denizens and devices of Strangeland answer with riddles, puzzles, and warnings of a Dark Thing lurking at the park’s peak. A new adventure from the creators of Primordia.
items.title: Strangeland

items.description: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.
items.description_ja: 「ひぐらしのなく頃に」番外編のエピソード3編を収録。真の最終章ともいえる『賽殺し編』は古手梨花が主人公の『祭囃し編』の後日談。本作はMangaGamer版の新規立ち絵を実装した新たなリニューアル版です！
items.title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Rei

items.description: A surrealist text-based RPG. You will explore an island, solve puzzles, and fight enemies, all in your attempt to get the Dark Egg.
items.description_ja: A surrealist text-based RPG. You will explore an island, solve puzzles, and fight enemies, all in your attempt to get the Dark Egg.
items.title: The Dark Egg Demo

items.description: The Jeffy Game is an outrageously fun 2D platformer where you play as Jeffy and embark on the adventure of a lifetime! Defeat the evil green beans, collect the cereal boxes, and discover hidden surprises! Now available on Steam!
items.description_ja: The Jeffy Game is an outrageously fun 2D platformer where you play as Jeffy and embark on the adventure of a lifetime! Defeat the evil green beans, collect the cereal boxes, and discover hidden surprises! Now available on Steam!
items.title: The Jeffy Game

items.description: “Paper Bride 6 Nightmare” is the sixth work to the Paper Bride series. Dive into a bewitching dream and immerse yourself in yet another immersive Chinese horror puzzle game!
items.description_ja: 『紙装束6 輪廻の劫』は中国民俗怪談アドベンチャーゲーム『紙装束』シリーズ6作目の作品です。
items.title: Paper Bride 6 Nightmare

items.description: Cats VS Zombies is a hidden object game – the player's task is to find cats hidden on the map and eliminate the zombies. The game is designed in a zombie apocalypse style, but with a touch of humor.
items.description_ja:
Cats VS Zombiesはユーモアたっぷりのアイテム探しゲームです。

汚染により疫病が発生——ゾンビが軍事基地全体を支配。
items.title: Cats vs Zombies II

items.description: POTENTIAL MAN is a role-playing experience where you must navigate the whims and woes of a humble seed. This wacky story features fully hand-drawn visuals, zany characters, and a classic JRPG-styled soundtrack to boot. Are you ready to achieve your true potential?
items.description_ja: POTENTIAL MAN is a role-playing experience where you must navigate the whims and woes of a humble seed. This wacky story features fully hand-drawn visuals, zany characters, and a classic JRPG-styled soundtrack to boot. Are you ready to achieve your true potential?
items.title: POTENTIAL MAN

items.description: Four Last Things is a very silly pythonesque adventure made from Renaissance-era paintings and public domain recordings of classical music. It is about sin, and the Four Last Things – Death, Judgement, Heaven and Hell – and strives to be intelligent and ridiculous in equal measures.
items.description_ja: 『Four Last Things』はルネサンス期の絵画と、著作権が消えたクラシック音楽の公有音源を元に製作された、最高にバカバカしくてシュールな冒険ゲーム。罪と四つの終着点（死、審判、天国、地獄）をテーマとし、知的さと馬鹿らしさの両立を目指した作品。
items.title: Four Last Things

items.description: The Walking Fish returns, this time in space, in an all-new fish comedy horror experience. Stuck on a space station, you have to solve the mystery of the Walking Fish, and escape its terror.
items.description_ja: The Walking Fish returns, this time in space, in an all-new fish comedy horror experience. Stuck on a space station, you have to solve the mystery of the Walking Fish, and escape its terror.
items.title: The Walking Fish 2: Final Frontier

items.description: Ever wondered how much of a kinky pervert you are? Ever wanted to know what your fate entails for being such a kinky pervert? Answer a series of disgustingly hilarious, immoral questions to reveal ridiculous scenarios & unlock the answers you seek...
items.description_ja: Ever wondered how much of a kinky pervert you are? Ever wanted to know what your fate entails for being such a kinky pervert? Answer a series of disgustingly hilarious, immoral questions to reveal ridiculous scenarios & unlock the answers you seek...
items.title: The Confession

items.description: Kill It With Fire: IGNITION is a free sampler of a first-person action game about hunting spiders and causing collateral damage. The full game is OUT NOW!
items.description_ja: Kill It With Fire: IGNITION is a free sampler of a first-person action game about hunting spiders and causing collateral damage. The full game is OUT NOW!
items.title: Kill It With Fire: Ignition

items.description: Hello Guest, beloved Hello Neighbor 2 pre-alpha, a stealth horror thriller with an advanced, self-learning AI. You take the night shift as a security guard at an abandoned Golden Apple Amusement Park where a creature is hiding in the shadows. What can go wrong?
items.description_ja: Hello Guest, beloved Hello Neighbor 2 pre-alpha, a stealth horror thriller with an advanced, self-learning AI. You take the night shift as a security guard at an abandoned Golden Apple Amusement Park where a creature is hiding in the shadows. What can go wrong?
items.title: Hello Guest: Hello Neighbor 2 pre-alpha

items.description: After a science experiment gets out of control, you need to survive and escape this dark prison that hides weird secrets. The game is a cinematic platform of terror and stealth, inspired by INSIDE, Another World, Blackthorne and Prince of Persia.
items.description_ja: After a science experiment gets out of control, you need to survive and escape this dark prison that hides weird secrets. The game is a cinematic platform of terror and stealth, inspired by INSIDE, Another World, Blackthorne and Prince of Persia.
items.title: RATUZ

items.description: A young girl needs to find her friends, unravel a dark mystery and escape the clutches of her cursed toys.
items.description_ja: A young girl needs to find her friends, unravel a dark mystery and escape the clutches of her cursed toys.
items.title: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 2

items.description: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo is a whimsical point’n’click adventure with a surrealist story, astounding hand-drawn animations and hilarious puzzles. Mr. Coo is trapped and broken into pieces. But most of all, he has no idea of what’s going on. Is that a giant chicken over there?
items.description_ja: 昔ながらのカートゥーンと他にはない独自の謎解きを完璧に融合させた「ミスター・クーのいろいろ」に一歩足を踏み入れれば、たちまち奇妙でユニークな冒険の始まり始まり。マウスをクリックするだけで謎を解け、可愛らしい手描きのカートゥーン世界を楽しむことができます。
items.title: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo

items.description:
Your next job awaits in Karisvale, detective. Will you fulfill your duty? Or become lost in the mystery... 
Explore a retro top-down world, question its citizens, and collect hidden items to uncover Karisvale's dark secret.
items.description_ja:
次の仕事は Karisvale です。 あなたはあなたの義務を果たしますか？ または謎に迷う...
レトロなトップダウンの世界を探索し、市民に質問し、隠されたアイテムを集めて Karisvale の暗い秘密を明らかにしてください。
items.title: Karisvale

items.description: The renowned slasher horror films of the 1980s and 1990s serve as a source of inspiration for Terror at Oakheart. The community of Oakheart has been terrorized by Teddy, a masked serial killer. As the body count rises, you discover there is more going on here than just a man in a mask.
items.description_ja: 1980年代と1990年代の有名なスラッシャーホラー映画は、『オークハートの恐怖』のインスピレーションの源となっている。オークハートのコミュニティは、マスクをかぶった連続殺人鬼テディによって恐怖に陥れられている。死体の数が増えるにつれ、マスクの男以上のことが起こっていることに気づく。
items.title: Terror At Oakheart

items.description: A cozy time survival roguelite in space. You steer the shippy while the shooting happens automatically. Meet cute NPCs, solve small quests, and fight quirky enemies with satisfying weapons. A shorter experience for people who don't have much time but love playing (and finishing) games.
items.description_ja: Cozy Space Survivorsは、宇宙で心地よい時間が過ごせるサバイバル・ローグライトです。自動で弾が発射される宇宙船に乗って出発し、かわいいキャラクターたちと出会います。そして、風変わりな敵を倒し、クエストを完了します。時間はないけれど、ゲームを遊ぶのが(そして、クリアするのが)大好きな人向けのちょっとしたオモチャです。
items.title: Cozy Space Survivors

items.description: Discover how people across the country think! The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a collection of hilarious survey-based game modes, using real one-word answers from real people. Really! Grab some friends and start guessing!
items.description_ja: Discover how people across the country think! The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a collection of hilarious survey-based game modes, using real one-word answers from real people. Really! Grab some friends and start guessing!
items.title: The Jackbox Survey Scramble

items.description: Play as a Turtle and duke it out in a game of Football. Use your gun to fly around the field or even shoot the ball.
items.description_ja: Play as a Turtle and duke it out in a game of Football. Use your gun to fly around the field or even shoot the ball.
items.title: Turtle Champs

items.description: Rediscover the joy of the original Backyard Baseball 1997, now updated for modern systems! Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids, aim for those home runs, and various game modes. Relive the magic of this classic baseball game!
items.description_ja: Rediscover the joy of the original Backyard Baseball 1997, now updated for modern systems! Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids, aim for those home runs, and various game modes. Relive the magic of this classic baseball game!
items.title: Backyard Baseball '97

items.description: TSIOQUE (pronounced: "chiock") is a dark but playful Point & Click adventure, hand-animated in meticulous, frame-by-frame 2D. Escape the clutches of an Evil Wizard and discover the secrets hidden within the spellbound castle of your ancestors.
items.description_ja: TSIOQUE (pronounced: "chiock") is a dark but playful Point & Click adventure, hand-animated in meticulous, frame-by-frame 2D. Escape the clutches of an Evil Wizard and discover the secrets hidden within the spellbound castle of your ancestors.
items.title: TSIOQUE

items.description: In Bitardia you will experience all the rules of the Internet in action, and venture on a journey in the spirit of classic low-budget shooters, making your way through the obstacles of the fantastic world of an imageboard.
items.description_ja: In Bitardia you will experience all the rules of the Internet in action, and venture on a journey in the spirit of classic low-budget shooters, making your way through the obstacles of the fantastic world of an imageboard.
items.title: Bitardia

items.description: A hand-drawn hidden object game inspired by the joy of people watching and telling small stories. Shake trees, peek through windows and spin curious objects to uncover secrets and follow the lives of its charming inhabitants.
items.description_ja:
人々が数々の小さな物語を見たり語ったりする喜びに感化された、手描きイラスト風の探し物ゲーム。
木を揺らしたり、窓を覗いたり、興味をそそる物体を回転させたり。様々な秘密を明らかにつつ、魅力あふれる住人たちの生活を追いかけていこう。
items.title: Nippets: A Hidden Object Game

items.description: Explore the moon of a gas giant with a bush plane. Do deliveries and challenges to unlock upgrades and more aircraft.
items.description_ja: Explore the moon of a gas giant with a bush plane. Do deliveries and challenges to unlock upgrades and more aircraft.
items.title: Bush 1022

items.description:
Short visual novel.
A 24-hour romance at its worst; a 24-hour escape at its sweetest.
items.description_ja:
短編ビジュアルノベル。
たった24時間の、最悪な恋と、いちばん甘い逃避行。
items.title: Mercury Elopement Syndrome

items.description: [The pod will break soon. Will she survive the nightmare or find the truth?]
items.description_ja: 本作品はピクセル風なハードコアホラーゲームである。プレーヤーは可愛いヒロインを操作して奇異なる空間で色んな恐怖と危険に直面、その中でゲームのステージデザインとストーリースタイルを理解できる。
items.title: Eve of Souls: Static Pod

items.description: A psychological horror short story. Explore the untouched wilderness of rural Wales as you uncover the forgotten remains of a mysterious facility and find the truth behind the missing villagers of Hearth.
items.description_ja: これは、サイコロジカルホラーのショートストーリー。80年代のSFホラーと現代の超現実主義映画にインスパイアされた本作は、オーディオを駆使した新しいゲームメカニズムと非線形の探索によって、ナラティブ・アドベンチャーというジャンルに独自のアプローチをもたらす。
items.title: Chasing Static

items.description: To get a "Ticket to Paradise" while being in Hell. A ticket that’s obviously worth it. A ticket that sends you to the obstacle path. What kind of road from Hell to Heaven could it be? What difficulties are awaiting you on this road? Are you worthy of a chance at redemption?
items.description_ja: To get a "Ticket to Paradise" while being in Hell. A ticket that’s obviously worth it. A ticket that sends you to the obstacle path. What kind of road from Hell to Heaven could it be? What difficulties are awaiting you on this road? Are you worthy of a chance at redemption?
items.title: Wicked Games

items.description: Rise of Gun - immerses you in a world of zombie apocalypse as a gun store owner. Buy parts, craft, sell, upgrade your store and hire workers. Help to humanity survive
items.description_ja: Rise of Gun- 銃器店のオーナーとして、ゾンビの黙示録の世界に浸ってください。部品を購入し、製作し、販売し、店舗をアップグレードし、労働者を雇ってください。人類の生存を助ける
items.title: Rise of Gun

items.description: Cursorblade is a bullet hell game where you play as the cursor, fighting your way through waves of enemies. Combine weapons and items to become more powerful with your own unique builds. Slash, dodge, upgrade, and repeat!
items.description_ja: カーソルブレードはカーソルを操作して大量の敵を倒すアクションゲーム。様々な武器やアイテムを使うことで自分だけのスタイルで強くなっていく。やることは三つだけ。斬りまくる！敵陣に乗り込みまくる！アップグレードしまくる！
items.title: Cursorblade

items.description:
You break into the mansion at night.
It’s huge and built like a maze.
You're trying to escape, but the monster is after you!
The chase begins.

RUN!!
items.description_ja: あなたは一人ぼっち、救いも来ない、それに戻り道もない……
items.title: Eyes: The Horror Game

items.description:
A condensed incremental experience, where you build a colony to collect and merge bigger and bigger fruits.
Combine game-changing technologies and special upgrades to find the best synergies and take your cash flow to another dimension.
items.description_ja:
気軽に遊べる放置ゲームの醍醐味がつまった作品。コロニーを築き上げ、フルーツをペアリングしてどんどん大きくしよう。
ゲームプレイを一変させる技術と特別なアップグレードを組み合わせ、最高のシナジーを見つければ、桁違いのお金をじゃんじゃん稼げる！
items.title: Idle Colony

items.description: Laundering Simulator puts you in charge of a two-faced enterprise – a hidden counterfeiting workshop with a laundromat as its front! Help Eddie Wiser run this crazy show and deal with small-business management, a criminal underground, nosy authorities, and a rage-inducing grandmother!
items.description_ja: Laundering Simulatorは、コインランドリーという表の顔と、その裏に隠された偽造工房という、2 つの顔を持つ企業を運営するゲームです！エディー・ワイザーがこのイカれたなショーを運営するのを手伝い、中小企業の経営や犯罪組織の統括を行いつつ、詮索好きな当局やすぐに怒り狂う祖母にも対処しましょう！
items.title: Laundering Simulator - Clean Cash and Laundry

items.description: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.
items.description_ja: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.
items.title: Happy Wheels

items.description: HYPERFIGHT is a fighting game where every hit is lethal, and every win counts. Lightning-fast 1-on-1 duels!
items.description_ja: HYPERFIGHT is a fighting game where every hit is lethal, and every win counts. Lightning-fast 1-on-1 duels!
items.title: HYPERFIGHT

items.description:
Make friends, free spirits and make sure that the world doesn’t end! 
Welcome to Kraken Academy, a technicolor fever dream that for legal reasons can only be described as "technically a school." 
Join forces with a magical kraken to save the world!
items.description_ja: 友達を作り、魂を解放し、世界の終わりを阻止しましょう！クラーケン・アカデミーへようこそ。ここは法律により「一応は学校」としか言い表せない、風邪をひいたときに見る極彩色の夢。魔法のクラーケンとともに、時間のループを操作し世界を救いましょう。
items.title: Kraken Academy!!

items.description: Take your perceptivity to a new dimension in a relaxing low-poly isometric puzzle game. Find the differences in the beautiful, fully rotatable, and zoomable 3D environments. Can you find them all?
items.description_ja: リラックスできるローポリ立体ゲーム。心地よい3D環境で間違い探しを楽しめます。
items.title: Tiny Lands

items.description: What The Dub?! is a multiplayer party game where each player overdubs missing dialogue from hilariously awful B-movies, outdated PSAs, and bizarre industrial films, with their own witty (or just plain stupid) dubs!
items.description_ja: What The Dub?! is a multiplayer party game where each player overdubs missing dialogue from hilariously awful B-movies, outdated PSAs, and bizarre industrial films, with their own witty (or just plain stupid) dubs!
items.title: What The Dub?!

items.description: Frog Fighters is a light-hearted, fast-paced, third-person-shooter where you become a frog on a lily pad with an ability to shoot other flying frogs with different types of laser-leafs.
items.description_ja: Frog Fighters is a light-hearted, fast-paced, third-person-shooter where you become a frog on a lily pad with an ability to shoot other flying frogs with different types of laser-leafs.
items.title: Frog Fighters

items.description: Puppet House is a puzzle-adventure horror with escape room elements. A freak ritual creates a killer puppet, murdering anyone who enters the ventriloquist’s mansion. Detective Rick, seeking missing locals, will soon face his greatest horror.
items.description_ja: Puppet House is a puzzle-adventure horror with escape room elements. A freak ritual creates a killer puppet, murdering anyone who enters the ventriloquist’s mansion. Detective Rick, seeking missing locals, will soon face his greatest horror.
items.title: Puppet House

items.description: Gensokyo Odyssey! A Touhou satirical visual novel where you find yourself lost in Gensokyo with only your schoolbag and an air hockey puck.
items.description_ja: 東方Project二次創作の風刺ビジュアルノベル。通学カバンとエアホッケーのパックだけを頼りに、迷い込んだ幻想郷を生き抜け!※本編は英語のみ対応
items.title: Touhou Gensokyo Odyssey

items.description: First-person horror metroidvania about fisting your way through a prison island crawling with cybernetic monstrosities. Explore, evolve, escape. Inspired by Tetsuo: The Iron Man.
items.description_ja: サイバネティックな怪物がひしめく監獄島を、拳で殴り抜ける一人称ホラーメトロイドヴァニア。探索し、変異し、脱出せよ。『鉄男』にインスパイアされた作品。
items.title: Voltage High Society

items.description: YOU CONTROL THE FOUND FOOTAGE. Another tape has been leaked, this time a cover-up of a tragic mass casualty event.
items.description_ja: 見つかった映像を管理するのはあなたです。別のテープが流出しましたが、今回は悲劇的な大量死傷事件の隠蔽でした。
items.title: The Lancaster Leak - Crisis At Call Center

items.description: Take the annual meme exam and prove you're an expert!
items.description_ja: Take the annual meme exam and prove you're an expert!
items.title: MEMOLOGY: GOYDA

items.description: A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards.
items.description_ja: 隔絶された共同体で起こった失踪事件。真相が眠る山。探偵に迫るタイムリミット。ダークな捜査ゲーム、Hillthornへようこそ。ゲーム中の会話は一切なし。プレイヤーのあなたは論理力と直感力を駆使しながら、手渡されたカードを元に謎の究明を目指す。
items.title: Hillthorn

items.description: Grab your nightstick, squeal like a siren, and Hit the Road with Sam & Max, Freelance Police, as they attempt to crack their toughest case.
items.description_ja: Grab your nightstick, squeal like a siren, and Hit the Road with Sam & Max, Freelance Police, as they attempt to crack their toughest case.
items.title: Sam & Max Hit the Road

items.description: A stealth-focused, satire co-op horror game where players must descend through an infinite series of mazes, evading the all-hearing Maze Creep and numerous other threats.

LET'S BE HONEST.
You're in deep shit.
Straitjacket locked tight.  
Hood over your head.  
And the atmosphere? Definitely not a dream vacation.
But hey… it happened.  
You did what you did.
And now you're here...

正直に言いましょう。
あなたはとんでもない状況に陥っています。
拘束衣はきつく締められています。
頭にはフード。
そしてこの雰囲気？とても夢のバカンスとは言えません。
でも……起きてしまったことです。
あなたは自分のしたことをしました。
そして今、あなたはここにいます…

items.description_ja: 1〜8人で遊べる、ハチャメチャなオンライン協力建築ゲーム。レンガを作り、巨大なピラミッドを建設しよう。生産ラインを自動化したり、仲間を雇ったり、あの手この手でレンガを頂上まで運ぼう！
items.title: How They Built the Pyramids

items.description: Heave Ho is a riotous multiplayer party game for up to four players in couch co-op and versus play, or online with Steam Remote Play. Reach out, get a grip, and swing to victory — or meet your messy end!
items.description_ja: 『Heave Ho』は、最大4人で協力＆対戦できるハチャメチャパーティーゲーム！ウデをのばしてギュッとつかんで、ゴールに向かってぶらーんとスイング！ オフラインでもSteam Remote Playを使ったオンラインでも、友だちといっしょのマルチプレイを楽しもう！
items.title: Heave Ho

items.description: It's exactly what it sounds like. You are the tree! You are equaled by no other. Relax and be the best tree you can be.
items.description_ja: It's exactly what it sounds like. You are the tree! You are equaled by no other. Relax and be the best tree you can be.
items.title: Tree Simulator 2020

items.description: It's a story-based escape puzzle game. Gretel headed to Madame Winslow's Mansion on an errand by her parents. Following her parents' note, Gretel will stay at Madame Winslow's Mansion for three days to help her with her work. Help Gretel solve the mystery of the villa and escape safely.

Following her parents' note, Gretel will stay at Madame Winslow's Mansion for three days to help her with her work. Help Gretel solve the mystery of the villa and escape safely.

items.description: Tide Up is a rather dark and gloomy adventure game. Accompany the girl in a dreamlike world of wonder. Collect the pearls scattered around the world and help the girl escape!
items.description_ja: TideUpは多少暗い雰囲気のアドベンチャーゲームです。 主人公と多彩で夢幻的な世界を歩き回ってください。 あちこちに散らばった真珠の玉を集めてこの世界から出て行くのがゲームの目標です。
items.title: Tide Up

items.description: Meow meow! Kittens are hidden in London, let's find them all. A short and pleasant experience! Start with a Beautiful monochromatic illustration, relax and find all the cats one by one to reveal the final colored art. Play through different modes, find special cats, and unlock bonus levels!
items.description_ja: ニャンニャン！ロンドンにネコが隠れているよ。全員見つけよう。短くも楽しい体験！最初は美しいモノクロのイラストでリラックスし、ネコを一匹ずつ見つけて最終的には色がついた絵を明らかにしよう。さまざまなモードをプレイして、特別なネコを見つけ、ボーナスステージをアンロックしよう！
items.title: Hidden Cats in London

items.description: A first-person dog sledding horror game. Play as a sled dog musher hired to transport a scientist deep into the unforgiving wastes of the arctic.
items.description_ja: 一人称視点の犬ぞりスリラー作品。 あなたは犬ぞり操縦者(マッシャー)として雇われ、北極の過酷な荒野の奥深くまで科学者を運ぶことになる。
items.title: That Which Gave Chase

items.description: Immerse yourself in neon, smoke, and high-stakes legal gambles as a Defense Attorney with uniquely Killer insights in this episodic, diabolically stylish visual novel adventure game.
items.description_ja: Immerse yourself in neon, smoke, and high-stakes legal gambles as a Defense Attorney with uniquely Killer insights in this episodic, diabolically stylish visual novel adventure game.
items.title: of the Devil

items.description: Someone slipped a mysterious videotape under your door... Do you dare watch it?!
items.description_ja: 誰かがあなたのドアの下に謎のビデオテープを滑り込ませました...それを見る勇気はありますか?!
items.title: The Cursed Tape

items.description: in this game u play as Fuck and u get to use crappy weapons and talk to horrible NPCs and find the bible crystals and explore my game and find secrets and play further to see what the next part of the game is
items.description_ja: in this game u play as Fuck and u get to use crappy weapons and talk to horrible NPCs and find the bible crystals and explore my game and find secrets and play further to see what the next part of the game is
items.title: Fuck's Quest II

items.description:
A knowledge-based progression game. Explore and solve the strange misteries of the interconnected fantasy worlds trapped inside an esoteric book and discover the roots of a terrible evil.

No stats, no log, no savefiles. Only pure knowledge is your progress.
items.description_ja: 知識ベースの進行型ゲーム。難解な本に閉じ込められた相互接続されたファンタジーワールドの奇妙な謎を探検して解決し、恐ろしい悪の根源を発見してください。ステータスなし、ログなし、セーブファイルなし。純粋な知識だけがあなたの進歩です。
items.title: Amatsuko

items.description: A large brown shadow lurks in the abandoned factory; the night hides her form.Something terrifyingly massive is concealed within this town.I think of her, and of the days I can never go back to.“KUMASAMA” is a horror adventure set in the present day.
items.description_ja: 廃工場に潜む大きな茶色の影、夜は彼女を隠す。この街には何か恐ろしく巨大な何かが潜んでいる。私は彼女と戻れない日々たちを想う。『KUMASAMA』は現代を舞台にしたホラーアドベンチャーだ。
items.title: KUMASAMA

items.description: Your squad has been choppered to a remote mansion to investigate a bio-experiment gone wrong. You’re plunged straight into a deathtrap. Arm yourself, solve puzzles, and unearth mysteries. But beware: every move you make draws you deeper into the deadly embrace of Resident Evil.
items.description_ja: ある生体技術の実験が失敗し、調査のため怪しげな館にヘリで派遣された特殊工作部隊（通称S.T.A.R.S.）。そこで起こったのは単なる「大量殺人」ではなかった。数多の脅威がうごめく死の罠から生き延びるサバイバルがはじまる。武装を揃え、仕掛けや罠を解除し、謎を解き明かせ。だが、忘れるな。奥に進めば進むほど、『BIOHAZARD』の深みに足を踏み入れることになる。
items.title: Resident Evil (1996)

items.description: There’s no place like home - and yours is no home at all. Play as Rosa, a neglected child trying to escape her abusive family. Sneak out, but be ever so quiet. Mom is listening, dad is angry, and your big sister is always watching…
items.description_ja: There’s no place like home - and yours is no home at all. Play as Rosa, a neglected child trying to escape her abusive family. Sneak out, but be ever so quiet. Mom is listening, dad is angry, and your big sister is always watching…
items.title: Step Lightly

items.description: A killer puzzle game where you control Skullface, a psycho slasher bent on slaughtering camp counselors at the title campground. Slide an adorable voxel murderer around hundreds of isometric puzzle levels to squash, flay, and decapitate hapless victims in this darkly comic homage to 80s horror.
items.description_ja: A killer puzzle game where you control Skullface, a psycho slasher bent on slaughtering camp counselors at the title campground. items.description: FOOTSIES is a simple 2D ground-based fighting game that both new and experienced players can pick up and enjoy right away. Featuring online battle mode with rollback netcode, implemented using GGPO open-source codes.
items.description_ja: FOOTSIES is a simple 2D ground-based fighting game that both new and experienced players can pick up and enjoy right away. Featuring online battle mode with rollback netcode, implemented using GGPO open-source codes.

items.description: The game is an ultimate sauna experience where players can enjoy socializing with friends and strangers that easily can become friends. It's all about having fun, relaxing, and experiencing the unique benefits of sauna culture.
items.description_ja: このゲームは、プレイヤーが友人や見知らぬ人と簡単に友達になれる交流を楽しめる究極のサウナ体験です。 楽しみ、リラックスし、サウナ文化のユニークな利点を体験することがすべてです。
items.title: Soak & Splash

items.description:
Climb a massive overgrown concrete tower while constantly at risk of falling and losing precious progress.
BETON BRUTAL offers a fluid and responsive first person parkour experience through tranquil brutalist architecture.
items.description_ja:
Climb a massive overgrown concrete tower while constantly at risk of falling and losing precious progress.
BETON BRUTAL offers a fluid and responsive first person parkour experience through tranquil brutalist architecture.

items.description: Hunt down a beheaded ghost to save your college club from losing funding! It'll be a piece of cake— wait, what do you mean he wants to marry you!? The Groom of Gallagher Mansion is spooky comedic romantic visual novel full of laughs and scares all around!
items.description_ja: Hunt down a beheaded ghost to save your college club from losing funding! It'll be a piece of cake— wait, what do you mean he wants to marry you!? The Groom of Gallagher Mansion is spooky comedic romantic visual novel full of laughs and scares all around!

items.description:
Bloomtown: A Different Story is a narrative JRPG mixing turn-based combat, monster taming and social RPG set in a seemingly pleasant 1960s Americana world. 
Join Emily and her group of friends to save their cozy town from the demonic creatures that live in the hearts of its residents!
items.description_ja:
『Bloomtown: A Different Story』は、1960年代のアメリカーナの世界を舞台に、ターンベースの戦闘、モンスター育成、ソーシャルRPGを組み合わせたナラティブJRPGです。
Emilyや仲間たちと共に、住民の心の中に住むデーモンのようなクリーチャーから、居心地の良い町を守ろう！
items.title: Bloomtown: A Different Story

items.description: Find a way out of an old mansion as a priest, you have been tasked to exorcise a woman who has been possessed. Solve puzzles and complete objectives to cure her demonic possession in this SURVIVAL HORROR experience.
items.description_ja: あなたは悪魔に取り憑かれた女性を祓うために任命された司祭として、古い屋敷からの脱出方法を見つけてください。この恐ろしい体験でパズルを解き、目標を達成し、彼女の悪魔の取り憑きを治療してください。
items.title: KAMLA

items.description:
Meet quirky characters and clean strange artifacts in this short cozy comedy game.
From an enchanted teacup to a cursed skull with a chip on its shoulder, each item and client brings new twists and surprises.
items.description_ja:

items.description: Myths are 100% True is a Fast-Paced Combat-Platformer that feels like X-Files if it was made by 12 year olds in Windows Movie Maker back in 2008.
items.description_ja: Myths are 100% True is a Fast-Paced Combat-Platformer that feels like X-Files if it was made by 12 year olds in Windows Movie Maker back in 2008.

Play as the handsome mutant, Paradigm, whose past comes back to haunt him in the form of a genetically engineered sloth that vomits candy.

items.description:
The year is 1996 and you’re employed by a science lab called Nova Nexus.
You work as a security guard at the front gate to the lab, inside a guard booth.
However, tonight it seems something important is happening inside of Nova Nexus and things are... well... a little strange.

items.description_ja: A top-down action roguelike about buying snakes, fighting them, selling their oil, and buying more snakes. Upgrade your weapons, get stronger snakes to fight, and chase down a high score with only ten days to live.

items.description: Graphwar is an artillery game in which you must hit your enemies using mathematical functions. The trajectory of your shot is determined by the function you wrote, and your goal is to avoid the obstacles and your teammates and hit your enemies. The game takes place in a Cartesian Plane.

items.description: Outwit the HOST in a death game where fire spreads with each flip of a card. Be the last to burn. Do you fear death?

You are trapped deep inside a massive dungeon. Explore it, survive it and find a way to escape. Your only weapons will be stealth, your own courage, and a faint light.

items.description_ja: 『ストラグリング』は物理ベースの協力プラットフォームゲーム。あり得ないチームワークが求められる。グシャグシャになった異形の腕を操作して、メチャクチャな世界を旅しよう。

items.description: Dive into an exhilarating maritime battle for 1 to 4 players! Assemble warships with a variety of bottle caps, allowing the warships to transform and break, experiencing flexible physics that brings a refreshing maritime battle!  Fight monsters together, or engage in a battle with your friends.
items.description_ja: 1〜4人のパーティー用海戦シューティングゲーム！さまざまなビールキャップの砲台を使って戦艦を組み立て、変形、延長、切断を体験しながら、独特の柔軟な物理学を体験して爽快な海戦を楽しんでください！PVP対戦モードとPVE Roguelite協力モードをサポートしています：友達と痛快に戦ったり、協力して怒った海の怪物を撃退したりしましょう！

items.description_ja: あなたはホラーコンテンツのクリエイターであり、観客を魅了するために恐ろしい場所に足を踏み入れています。超常現象を記録することで、より多くの視聴者を引き付けようとしています。しかし、これらの恐怖に満ちた冒険は、いつか高い代償を払ってあなたを悩ませることになるでしょう。

items.description_ja: ミレニアルの始まり、中国北西のある地、悪性の殺人事件が一時的に世間に大騒ぎを起こしました。殺人者は死ぬ前に、半分の仏様の顔を深く握り、その強い怨念は「無者」の注意を引き起こしました。探究が深く入り込めば、十年前に起こった放火一家殺人事件を掘り出しました。同じ仏の裏に潜んでいるのは天災なのですか、人禍なのですか、その怨念が生まれる穢地では、おかしく、怖い表象の下に隠されている未知の秘密は、深く埋められているのです。

It's about myself mostly.  You walk around and press the 'interact' button.
Sorry for making this.
items.description_ja:
