items.description:
The protagonist is trapped in the world of a love game.
Can you return to the real world again...?
Try to escape while running away from the gal game heroine
A love simulation-style survival horror game!
items.description_ja:
恋愛ゲームの世界に閉じ込められてしまった主人公は
再び現実世界に戻ることができるのか・・・。
ギャルゲーヒロインから逃げながら脱出を試みる
恋愛シミュレーション風サバイバルホラーゲーム！
items.title: Love Love School Days

items.description: A bombastic puzzle platformer about worlds turned inside out. Shift dimensions at the push of a button, solve brain-twisting logistical riddles, and race through the wilds of the multiverse in a bleakly hilarious (and hilariously bleak) story where everything you know can turn on a dime.
items.description_ja: 次元を旅するコメディアドベンチャー、What Lies in the Multiverseへようこそ。本作では、ある才能ある少年と奇妙な科学者の力により世界が裏返ってしまいます。
items.title: What Lies in the Multiverse

items.description: EXIT 2 is a free multiplayer horror game in which a team of players must collect and deliver keys and then escape, while another player must stop them as a monster.
items.description_ja: EXIT 2 is a free multiplayer horror game in which a team of players must collect and deliver keys and then escape, while another player must stop them as a monster.
items.title: EXIT 2

items.description: They have launched an active invasion on our lands in late September this year, so let us break free of the slavic hand that held us by our balls for many ages! Rally all of our reptile militia, we will end this all together! LIZARDS, WE WILL NEVER BE SLAVES BUT WE WILL BE CONQUERORS!
items.description_ja: They have launched an active invasion on our lands in late September this year, so let us break free of the slavic hand that held us by our balls for many ages! Rally all of our reptile militia, we will end this all together! LIZARDS, WE WILL NEVER BE SLAVES BUT WE WILL BE CONQUERORS!
items.title: Lizard Survivors: Battle for Hyperborea

items.description: Cat Bait is a casual game with cute pixel graphics. Control the Cat Bait, dodge enemies, and use the unique abilities of helper cats.
items.description_ja: Cat Bait — かわいいピクセルグラフィックスのカジュアルゲーム。 餌猫を操作し、敵を避け、猫の仲間のユニークな能力を活用しましょう。
items.title: Cat Bait

items.description: So, have you ever heard of the Trolley Problem? Do you know the price of the choices you make? How far are you ready to go to act according to your values? Will you sacrifice the life of the other to hold the moral high ground?
items.description_ja: So, have you ever heard of the Trolley Problem? Do you know the price of the choices you make? How far are you ready to go to act according to your values? Will you sacrifice the life of the other to hold the moral high ground?

items.description_ja: Blue Estate is a black-humoured and corrosive rail shooter, adapted from the critically acclaimed and Eisner Award nominated graphic novel, Blue Estate by Viktor Kalvachev!
items.title: Blue Estate The Game

items.description: A supernatural horror visual novel where vampires compete to save their eternal unlives in a high-stakes reality show.
items.description_ja: A supernatural horror visual novel where vampires compete to save their eternal unlives in a high-stakes reality show.
items.title: Fledgling Manor

items.description: Christmas Story is a horror game filled with Christmas warmth and coziness, where every festive light hides darkness, and the sense of comfort fades with every step you take.
items.description_ja: Christmas Story is a horror game filled with Christmas warmth and coziness, where every festive light hides darkness, and the sense of comfort fades with every step you take.
items.title: Christmas Story

items.description: Become a Secret Agent and investigate paranormal activities in this dark Lovecraftian universe. This Alternate Reality Game will have you explore complex puzzles in-game but also in real-life; interacting with real websites, companies, and NPCs that we created as part of our universe.

This Alternate Reality Game will have you explore complex puzzles in-game but also in real-life; interacting with real websites, companies, and NPCs that we created as part of our universe.

items.description_ja: You Have 10 Seconds is a fast paced arcade style platformer game with over 40 levels.
items.title: You Have 10 Seconds

items.description: "The Herbalist" is a smooth and meditative game from the creators of  . You'll need to recreate some recipes of ancient potions with Slavya.
items.description_ja: The HerbalistはEverlasting Summerのクリエイター達が送る、ゆったりと落ち着いた雰囲気の論理パズルゲームです。このゲームでは色彩豊かなアニメ調のCGと優しく心地よい音楽、魅力的なストーリーをお楽しみいただけます。その中で貴方はスラヴヤと共に不思議なポーションのレシピを再現する事になるのです。
items.title: The Herbalist

items.description:
Oh nooo, the world is flooded! Oh no, there is also a really big shark! You are a survivor of the apocalypse, stuck in your apartment, all by yourself, so sad... Across the street there is another survivor. 
Let's wave to each other, work together and both reach the boat to get to safety!
items.description_ja:
Oh nooo, the world is flooded! Oh no, there is also a really big shark! You are a survivor of the apocalypse, stuck in your apartment, all by yourself, so sad... Across the street there is another survivor. 
Let's wave to each other, work together and both reach the boat to get to safety!
items.title: Sam & Dan: Floaty Flatmates

items.description: Let's do sit-ups! Let a chubby boy do his exercise and sink into a dog's body. Maybe animals will come to cheer him up.
items.description_ja: さあ、腹筋しよう。 太っちょの少年に運動をさせることで、その体を秋田犬へと沈み込ませよう。きっと他の動物たちも応援に駆けつけてくれるはず。
items.title: My Exercise

items.description: Witchtastic is a challenging 2-4 player coop game about brewing and delivering magic potions as fast as possible. Take on the role of aspiring witches and experience charming adventures. Need a break from all the yelling of your friends? You can practice in a single player campaign as well!
items.description_ja: 『ウィッチタスティック』は魔法の秘薬をできるだけ早く作り届ける2～4人で遊べるチャレンジングな協力プレイゲーム。高みを目指す魔女たちになりきって、魅惑の冒険を体験しましょう。え？今は友だち同士で叫び声を浴びせたい気分じゃない？それなら1人用のキャンペーンモードでプレイの練習もできますよ！
items.title: Witchtastic

items.description: The Definitive Political Debating Simulator. A wacky third-person multiplayer arena shooter inspired by Countryball memes - a game encouraging you to smash each others balls until someone finishes victoriously. Now includes an online co-op zombie mode!
items.description_ja: The Definitive Political Debating Simulator. A wacky third-person multiplayer arena shooter inspired by Countryball memes - a game encouraging you to smash each others balls until someone finishes victoriously. Now includes an online co-op zombie mode!
items.title: Countryballs: Modern Ballfare

items.description: Enjoy going in the gym how it was intended: phonk, sick racing cars and Emperor Putin guarding you. Get buff and visit the ♂Dungeon Master♂ to get uprades. Drink tonics and avoid obstacles on your path to becoming the ♂Boss of this Gym♂.
items.description_ja: フォーンク、気持ち悪いレーシングカー、プーチン皇帝があなたを守っています。バフを手に入れて、♂ダンジョンマスター♂を訪ねてアップグレードを手に入れよう。トニックを飲んで、♂このジムのボス♂になるまでの道のりで障害物を避けよう。
items.title: Boss of this gym

items.description: Ever just tired of it all? Ready for change? Wanna bet it all on sheer mayhem and destruction? In comes Maniac, a rogue-lite crime action game in which the world goes against you, and your insanity creates chaos!
items.description_ja: 全てに疲れたことがありますか？変化の準備はできているか？大混乱と破壊にすべてを賭けたい？世界があなたに逆らい、あなたの狂気がカオスを生み出すゲーム、Manaicの登場です！
items.title: Maniac

items.description: Immerse yourself in the bizarre art style and the surreal world of Cat Museum, a 2D side-scrolling puzzle-adventure game. Solve the strange puzzles with your mischievous cat, and unveil the truth behind the mysterious museum.
items.description_ja:
風変わりでユニークな挿絵風アートスタイルと、シュールなファンタジーシーンを備えた2D横スクロール型謎解きアドベンチャーゲーム。
いたずら好きなネコと一緒に奇妙な謎を解き、博物館の奥底に隠された真相を明らかにする！
items.title: Cat Museum

items.description: Quirky yet brutal run-and-gun roguelite: scavenge weapons, equipment, and artifacts, unlock powerful upgrades, and blast through procedurally generated biomes with witty dialogue and explosively satisfying combat.
items.description_ja: 風変わりでいて、かつ過酷なラン＆ガン・ローグライト：武器や装備、アーティファクトを収集し、強力なアップグレードを解除して、プロシージャル生成されたバイオームを駆け抜けよう。機知に富んだ会話と、爆発的な爽快感を味わえる戦闘が楽しめる。
items.title: Zombiehood

items.description: A dark and surreal puzzle adventure set in a decaying town where veins pulse through ruined structures and the night hums with unfamiliar life.
items.description_ja: A dark and surreal puzzle adventure set in a decaying town where veins pulse through ruined structures and the night hums with unfamiliar life.
items.title: Navicula Meatus

items.description: A different kind of liminal experience. Explore surreal spaces inspired by nostalgia, discover hidden paths, and unravel a mystery that is shaped by your own mind. No monsters, no combat. Just atmosphere, discovery, and dread.
items.description_ja: 現実が解き明かされる不思議な中間空間の奥深くへと導く、不気味な探索体験。 このウォーキング シミュレーターは、あなたの好奇心を刺激し、限界環境を探索し、その秘密を明らかにし、正気を保ったまま脱出するよう誘います。
items.title: Liminal Shroud

items.description: Experience romantic Regency England in this sumptuous solitaire game. Play your cards right as you tour historic London, Brighton and Bath, and help Bella create a dazzling ballroom. Unlock gameplay features with your makeover project and improve Bella’s chances of finding true love!
items.description_ja: Experience romantic Regency England in this sumptuous solitaire game. Play your cards right as you tour historic London, Brighton and Bath, and help Bella create a dazzling ballroom. Unlock gameplay features with your makeover project and improve Bella’s chances of finding true love!
items.title: Regency Solitaire

items.description: Find My Frogs: Branches is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a hand-drawn village nestled high in the branches of an ancient tree. Explore charming corners, discover tiny secrets, and help Uncle Froger find his missing hat.
items.description_ja: Find My Frogs: Branches は、古木の枝に佇む手描きの村でカエルやヒキガエルを探す、ほっこりとした隠しオブジェクトゲームです。魅力的な場所を探索し、小さな秘密を発見し、フロガーおじさんの失くした帽子を探しましょう。
items.title: Find My Frogs: Branches

items.description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.
items.description_ja: オフィスワーカーの行動を注意深く観察し、人間のふりをしているだけの者を見つけ出せ。このサイクルを生き残るための弾丸は1発しかない。ミスをすれば、アノマリーがお前に襲いかかる。
items.title: Metro Anomaly

items.description: The Station is a first-person sci-fi mystery set on a space station sent to study a sentient alien civilization. Assuming the role of a recon specialist, players must unravel a mystery which will decide the fate of two civilizations.
items.description_ja: The Station is a first-person sci-fi mystery set on a space station sent to study a sentient alien civilization. Assuming the role of a recon specialist, players must unravel a mystery which will decide the fate of two civilizations.
items.title: The Station

items.description:
What is this cat doing here? And where are his friends?
Explore strange and beautiful islands to find all the little kittens hidden there.
items.description_ja: このネコはここで何を？　仲間のネコたちはどこ？　不思議で美しい島を探索して、かくれんぼしているネコたちをすべて見つけ出しましょう。
items.title: Hidden Paws Mystery

items.description: Get Stuffed! is an Asymmetrical Multiplayer Social Horror game. Up to 16 players try to kill, deceive or escape as one of three role categories (Killer, Antagonist, or Victim). Each role has a unique way of winning.
items.description_ja: Get Stuffed! is an Asymmetrical Multiplayer Social Horror game. Up to 16 players try to kill, deceive or escape as one of three role categories (Killer, Antagonist, or Victim). Each role has a unique way of winning.
items.title: Get Stuffed!

items.description: Mr. Pumpkin 2: Kowloon Walled City is a sequel to the Mr. Pumpkin franchise. Our protagonist, an insignificant guy with a pumpkin head, will explore the Kowloon Walled City of Hong Kong, and witness the stories happening within these walls.
items.description_ja: Mr. Pumpkin 2: Kowloon Walled City は、 Mr. Pumpkin シリーズの続編。主人公はカボチャの頭をした取るに足らない男で、香港の九龍城壁都市を探検し、壁の中で起こる物語を目撃することになる。
items.title: Mr. Pumpkin 2: Kowloon walled city

items.description: Hyperbolica is a whimsical Non-Euclidean adventure with mind-bending worlds full of games, puzzles, mazes, and secrets! Immerse yourself in reality-warping geometries where lines can never be parallel, horizons are curved, and space grows exponentially.
items.description_ja: Hyperbolica is a whimsical Non-Euclidean adventure with mind-bending worlds full of games, puzzles, mazes, and secrets! Immerse yourself in reality-warping geometries where lines can never be parallel, horizons are curved, and space grows exponentially.
items.title: Hyperbolica

items.description: Unravel the mystery in this cute psychological horror VN, set deep in the woods of the Tatras Mountains. Will you wind up on the chopping block?
items.description_ja: タトラ山脈の奥深く山小屋に迷い込んだ若者たち。食料は底を尽き、洪水で水かさが増していく。みんなを励ませるかどうかは自分次第。機嫌を取る相手を間違えると、まな板の上で悲惨な運命が待っているかも？
items.title: Cooking Companions

items.description: "Durka Simulator" is a visual novel with humorous elements that takes place in an alternative reality in the Russian Federation.
items.description_ja: "Durka Simulator" is a visual novel with humorous elements that takes place in an alternative reality in the Russian Federation.
items.title: Durka Simulator

items.description: You are trapped at home in an endless loop. Remember your surroundings and watch out for anomalies, if you ever want to leave.
items.description_ja: あなたは家の中に閉じ込められ、無限ループに陥っています。脱出したければ、周囲の状況に注意し、異常事態に注意してください。
items.title: Forgot

items.description: Have you ever wondered WTF Is Wrong With You? Well, so have we... Let's find out together, shall we?
items.description_ja: Have you ever wondered WTF Is Wrong With You? Well, so have we... Let's find out together, shall we?
items.title: WTF Is Wrong With You?

items.description: A 1-4 player co-op survival horror where the horror begins when the shift starts. Clean, organize, and contain dangerous creatures using CCTV, motion sensors, and more. Earn your paycheck, upgrade your tools, and capture them. New game mode available!
items.description_ja: 1～4人協力プレイのサバイバルホラーゲーム。恐怖はシフトが始まるとともに訪れる。監視カメラ、モーションセンサーを駆使し、清掃・整理・危険なクリーチャーの封じ込めを行え。給料を稼ぎ、ツールを強化し、捕獲せよ—誰も助けてはくれない。
items.title: Hired 2 Die

items.description: You are tasked with urgent maintenance on a small moon. Find the monoliths and manage your survival to complete your mysterious assignment.
items.description_ja: You are tasked with urgent maintenance on a small moon. Find the monoliths and manage your survival to complete your mysterious assignment.
items.title: Moon Runner

items.description: The choice has been made, and now there is no turning back - they must find and stop him. The final chapter in the adventure of our heroes.
items.description_ja: The choice has been made, and now there is no turning back - they must find and stop him. The final chapter in the adventure of our heroes.
items.title: My Furry Protogen 3 🐾

items.description: Tasty Blue is an underwater side-scrolling eat 'em up game. You start as a small goldfish with an insatiable appetite. After being overfed by your owner, you'll escape into the ocean and eat everything that you encounter. The more you eat, the bigger you get!
items.description_ja: Tasty Blue is an underwater side-scrolling eat 'em up game. You start as a small goldfish with an insatiable appetite. After being overfed by your owner, you'll escape into the ocean and eat everything that you encounter. The more you eat, the bigger you get!
items.title: Tasty Blue

items.description: 3D physics-platformer where you are an egg!  Roll, hop and slide your way back home.
items.description_ja: タマゴとなって、転がって、跳ねて、滑って…家に帰ろう！３Dローリングアクションゲーム
items.title: Oeuf

items.description:
Check the suspect's status and solve the mystery!
A status-checking mystery ADV in which a rookie detective takes on difficult cases that take place in a fantasy world.
items.description_ja:
容疑者のステータスを見て謎を解け！
ファンタジーな世界で起こった難事件に新米探偵が挑む、ステータス確認系ミステリーADV。
items.title: ステータス確認探偵

items.description: Blend fragrances in your cozy perfume atelier! 🌸 Craft unique scents by mixing essences, design beautiful bottles, and try to sell your creations to curious customers. Decorate your workshop, unlock new recipes, and grow your reputation in the art of fragrance.
items.description_ja: 香水工房へようこそ！プレイヤーは調香師として、小さな癒やしの香水店を経営する。お客を持て成し、香水を調合し、パッケージをデザインして販売。お店をアップグレードしながら新たなレシピを解放していく。ここでは香りを通して物語や感情を紡ぎ、穏やかで安らかな調香のひと時を過ごせる。
items.title: Perfume Atelier

items.description: In a concrete slab beneath the earth, a lone technician is sent for routine maintenance on a network of supercomputers. Each terminal operates on its own hidden rules, and the only way to escape is to learn how to speak their language.  Crack the code, unlock the truth.
items.description_ja: In a concrete slab beneath the earth, a lone technician is sent for routine maintenance on a network of supercomputers. Each terminal operates on its own hidden rules, and the only way to escape is to learn how to speak their language.  Crack the code, unlock the truth.
items.title: Terminal Lucidity

items.description: Wick is a survival horror game where ghost stories are brought to life. Explore a local legend about the long lost children in the woods who can still be seen... but only by those who dare to enter alone by candlelight.
items.description_ja: Wick is a survival horror game where ghost stories are brought to life. Explore a local legend about the long lost children in the woods who can still be seen... but only by those who dare to enter alone by candlelight.
items.title: Wick

items.description:
Splasher is a fun and challenging 2D Platformer filled with humor and surprises. 
 
Armed with a paint cannon, you’ll face the dangers of the Inkorp mega-factory in order to save your companions, the Splashers, and put an end to the Machiavellian projects of the evil boss, Le Docteur.
items.description_ja:
Splasher is a fun and challenging 2D Platformer filled with humor and surprises. 
 
Armed with a paint cannon, you’ll face the dangers of the Inkorp mega-factory in order to save your companions, the Splashers, and put an end to the Machiavellian projects of the evil boss, Le Docteur.
items.title: Splasher

items.description:
Design! Control! Ride! 
Virtual Rides III is here! Set foot in an even bigger, more colorful, and more impressive fairground than ever before! Let your imagination be your guide! Design, control, and ride more than 15 unique attractions!
items.description_ja: ヴァーチャルライド3！これまでより、さらに大きく、よりカラフルで、より印象的な遊園地に足を踏み入れましょう！あなたの想像力に任せて15以上ものユニークなアトラクションをデザインし、コントロールし、乗り回しましょう！
items.title: Virtual Rides 3 - Funfair Simulator

items.description: This game is a simulation of self-isolation. You need to support your family, not to lose your job and finally not to go crazy.
items.description_ja: This game is a simulation of self-isolation. You need to support your family, not to lose your job and finally not to go crazy.
items.title: Self-Isolation

items.description: Witches x Warlocks is a cute and light-hearted Halloween Raising Sim; featuring a customizable protagonist and 4 love interests of different genders!
items.description_ja: Witches x Warlocks is a cute and light-hearted Halloween Raising Sim; featuring a customizable protagonist and 4 love interests of different genders!
items.title: Witches x Warlocks

items.description: Where do you run to when your demons reside within you? Decarnation is a pixel art adventure/action puzzle game with a horrific story inspired by some of the most influential films and novels in the genre. Dive into a breathtaking thriller where nightmares and dreams intertwine…
items.description_ja:
身の内に巣食う悪魔からは、誰も逃れられない。
『Decarnation』は、ピクセルアートで描かれるアドベンチャー／アクション・パズルゲーム。
同ジャンルで最も大きな影響力を持つ名作映画・小説から着想を得た、恐怖の物語が展開される。
悪夢と夢が交錯する世界で、息をのむ戦慄体験があなたを待っている…
items.title: Decarnation

items.description: Para Eyes is a spot the difference horror game. Flip through security cameras and find anomalies. But be careful not to go insane.
items.description_ja: Para Eyes is a spot the difference horror game. Flip through security cameras and find anomalies. But be careful not to go insane.
items.title: Para Eyes

items.description: Discover secrets, solve puzzles and survive the serial-killer in this pixelated topdown. You are Akin, an exterminator, who bought a house in a rural area, but the past of this house will affect your present.
items.description_ja: Discover secrets, solve puzzles and survive the serial-killer in this pixelated topdown. You are Akin, an exterminator, who bought a house in a rural area, but the past of this house will affect your present.

items.description: You play as the son of a restorer, a museum worker who died tragically. While searching for the memorabilia, the door suddenly closes and strange things begin to happen. The hero is waiting for immersion in the world of art and the paranormal.
items.description_ja: You play as the son of a restorer, a museum worker who died tragically. While searching for the memorabilia, the door suddenly closes and strange things begin to happen. The hero is waiting for immersion in the world of art and the paranormal.

Read through and save passages in any order with an original soundtrack, or listen through the greatest story ever told in audiobook form. Featuring an extensive Trivia section to find out how well you really know the stories of Old and New.

items.description: 「Maybe one day, I won't have to fight when I fly.」
items.description_ja: 「もしできるならの話だけど。いつか戦うために空を飛ぶんじゃなくって、何も考えないで空を飛べたらいいなって...考えてたのよ」

items.description_ja: A short horror game where you control a decaying spacecraft exploring distant star systems.

items.description: Escape from the Shadow Land!
items.description_ja: シャドウランドから抜け出そう！
items.title: Mind Snares: Alice's Journey

By sheer luck you've slipped through the cracks, but discovery means certain death. How long are you going to delay the inevitable?

items.title: DEATH PENALTY

items.description: Delilah is an ordinary school girl who accidentally discovers an old mansion on a rainy night. As her exploration in the mansion continues, she finds many mysterious phenomena that can't be explained. In this mansion covered by ashes, what's the secret hidden deep underground?
items.description_ja: 普通の女子校生デリラは、ある雨降りの夜に古い洋館に入ってしまった。洋館を冒険していくうちに、説明不可能な怪奇現象を目の当たりにする、この灰に包まれた洋館に何の秘密が隠されているのだろうか？
items.title: Coffin of Ashes

items.description: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.
items.description_ja: 【ひぐらしのなく頃に解　目明し編】本作品は日本語モード、英語モードを搭載したサウンドノベルです。音楽や背景、キャラクターによって楽しく演出された世界を、小説の感覚で読み進んで行きます。笑ったり、泣いたり、怒ったり。そんな心の揺らめきを主人公と一緒に堪能して下さい。
items.title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.5 Meakashi

items.description: Ready to play some ball? Grab a team, suit up, and climb inside your human! Prep its thrusters, lower the all-terrain wheels, and spin up that flailing magnet-arm. It's time to play Regular Human Basketball!
items.description_ja: Ready to play some ball? Grab a team, suit up, and climb inside your human! Prep its thrusters, lower the all-terrain wheels, and spin up that flailing magnet-arm. It's time to play Regular Human Basketball!
items.title: Regular Human Basketball

items.description: A quirky, absolutely content-packed, destructible open-world sandbox adventure with combat, platforming, character customization, and collect-a-thon scavenger hunt experience. Play solo, 2-player split screen, or online co-op for up to 4 players. No paid cosmetic DLC nonsense.
items.description_ja: 収集マラソン系3Dアクションプラットフォーム。一風変わった『Bang-On Balls: Chronicles』の世界で向こう見ずなヒーローとなり、ミッションやアイテム収集をこなしつつ、秘密を求めて（ちょっといい加減な）歴史を目撃しよう！
items.title: Bang-On Balls: Chronicles

items.description: Saiko no Sutoka No Shiki is a spin-off of the original game Saiko no Sutoka, in which Saiko is a zombie anime girl who wants to play with her senpai, with the senpai needing to complete her parts and give her food to satisfy her hunger while simultaneously trying to escape.
items.description_ja: サイコのストーカーの式は、オリジナルゲーム「サイコのストーカー」のスピンオフ作品で、サイコはゾンビのアニメ少女であり、先輩と遊びたがっています。先輩は彼女の部品を完成させ、彼女の飢えを満たすために食べ物を与えながら、同時に脱出を試みる必要があります。
items.title: Saiko no sutoka no shiki

items.description: Akai Onna | 赤い女 is a psychological J-horror game featuring a student.
items.description_ja: 赤い女は学生が主人公の心理的Jホラーゲームです。
items.title: Akai Onna

items.description: A broke young man takes on the night shift at a roadside diner. In the glow of the blood moon, routine tasks turn into a fight for survival. First-person horror based on a dark creepypasta with a set of rescue rules.
items.description_ja: 手持ちのない若い男性が路上のダイナーで夜勤を引き受けます。血の月の輝きの中で、日常のタスクが生存の戦いに変わります。救助ルールを基にしたダーククリーピーパスタに基づく一人称ホラー。
items.title: Creepy Shift: Roadside Diner

items.description: Free-to-play 30-player party royale where every round switches genres! Sprint, slide-hop, and shove rivals across 35+ modes and 60+ maps—from Kart Racing, Prop Hunt, and FPS Deathmatch to Glass Bridges and Mingle. With 3D proximity voice, custom lobbies, and cross-play!
items.description_ja: 毎ラウンドジャンルが変わる基本無料の30人対戦パーティーロイヤル！スライディングや突き落としで35種以上のモードと60種以上のマップを制覇せよ。カートレース、プロップハント、ガラスの橋など満載！3D近接ボイスチャット、カスタムマッチ、クロスプレイ対応！
items.title: Nexus Rumble: The Ultimate Showdown

items.description: Enter a chaotic courtroom where socks play lawyers, prosecutors, and judges! Use absurd evidence, craft wild arguments, and deliver verdicts in this hilarious online party game. Improvise, strategize, and shout "Objection!"—because in Guilty as Sock!, chaos always wins!
items.description_ja: 弁護士、検事や判事役の靴下となって、ハチャメチャな裁判に飛び込もう！トンデモな証拠を使ってデタラメな議論を交わして判決を下す、爆笑必至のオンラインパーティゲームです。即興で戦略を立てて「異議あり！」と叫ぶ… 『Guilty as Sock!』ではカオスが必ず勝つのです！
items.title: Guilty as Sock!

items.description: Chaotic foosball matches for up to 4 players! Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.
items.description_ja: 友達と一緒に超高速のテーブルサッカー対戦を楽しもう！これは物理的なマルチ乱闘ゲームで、クレイジーで面白いアイテムを使って相手を打ち負かし、真のテーブルサッカー王者を目指せ！
items.title: Pimbolas

items.description: Exit From - is a first-person horror-stealth game with quest and procedural generation elements where you have to get out of the old Soviet house, which changes every new game.
items.description_ja: Exit From - is a first-person horror-stealth game with quest and procedural generation elements where you have to get out of the old Soviet house, which changes every new game.
items.title: Exit From

items.description: Prepare to be blown away! Jiangshi x Daoshi is an epic story of vampires, dao priests, assassins and immortals, told in a spectacularly animated visual novel format.
items.description_ja: とにかく動く、奇妙奇天烈摩訶不思議な中華伝奇ビジュアルノベル。
items.title: Jiangshi x Daoshi

items.description: Free demo for Cognition Method - a story-driven, first-person puzzle game inspired by Space Odyssey 2001 and Solaris. Discover an innovative mechanics of altering gravity and dive into the surreal setting. Find your way within a mysterious artifact and unveal a non-ordinary story.
items.description_ja: Free demo for Cognition Method - a story-driven, first-person puzzle game inspired by Space Odyssey 2001 and Solaris. Discover an innovative mechanics of altering gravity and dive into the surreal setting. Find your way within a mysterious artifact and unveal a non-ordinary story.
items.title: Cognition Method: Initiation

items.description: Grab your axe and save the environment by chopping and recycling every man-made thing in your path and solving puzzles with your charming animal friends!
items.description_ja: 斧を手に、行く先に立ちふさがるあらゆる人工物を切り刻んでリサイクルし、魅力的な動物の仲間たちとパズルを解いて自然を救いましょう！
items.title: LumbearJack

items.description: Search a desolate town for traces of your childhood friend. A point&click adventure with action combat.
items.description_ja: Search a desolate town for traces of your childhood friend. A point&click adventure with action combat.
items.title: Cursed 2

items.description: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2 lets you duke it out with the biggest and best fighting character roster yet! Choose your favorite brawlers, master their unique move sets, and use all-new powerful Supers to land the finishing blow with friends or across a unique, roguelike player campaign!
items.description_ja: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2 は、史上最多＆最強の戦闘キャラが集結したゲームです！お気に入りの戦士を選んで、友達と戦ったり、ユニークなローグライク・プレイヤーキャンペーンで、各コマンドをマスターして、最強の新必殺技で止めを刺しましょう！
items.title: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2

items.description: A fast paced silly cutegore FPS! Earth has been taken over by demons. A catgirl codenamed MeowMeow fights back! MEOW, GUN, CLAW and BLOW UP hordes of evil demons, zombies, and other monsters in colorful environments with tons of weapons! The game runs on the FTEQW engine.
items.description_ja: A fast paced silly cutegore FPS! Earth has been taken over by demons. A catgirl codenamed MeowMeow fights back! MEOW, GUN, CLAW and BLOW UP hordes of evil demons, zombies, and other monsters in colorful environments with tons of weapons! The game runs on the FTEQW engine.
items.title: MeowGun: Hell Denizen

items.description: As the night darkens and you set out for home, an unsettling occurrence takes place on the road. Will this lead you to hell? Unveil the truth in a bone-chilling driving horror game that will keep you on the edge of your seat!
items.description_ja: As the night darkens and you set out for home, an unsettling occurrence takes place on the road. Will this lead you to hell? Unveil the truth in a bone-chilling driving horror game that will keep you on the edge of your seat!
items.title: Drive Me to Hell

items.description: Who Do Voodoo is a multiplayer party game of real-time combat and social deduction for up to 16 players. Collect and craft cards, cast spells to deal damage and defeat opponents, or deceive your friends using proximity voice chat.
items.description_ja: Who Do Voodooは、リアルタイムバトルと正体隠匿を楽しめる、最大16人のマルチプレイヤーパーティーゲームです。カードを集めてクラフトし、呪文でダメージを与えて敵を倒すか、近接ボイスチャットで友達を欺きましょう。
items.title: Who Do Voodoo

items.description: ECHOES OF RED is a fast-paced roguelite shooter where you can carry unlimited weapons at once, face endless enemies ever stronger and build your perfect custom loadout. OBLITERATE tens of thousands of enemies who dared to challenge you and MAKE THEM REGRET STANDING AGAINST YOU.
items.description_ja: ECHOES OF REDは、無限に武器を同時装備できるハイテンポなローグライトシューター。次々と強くなる無数の敵に挑み、完璧なカスタムロードアウトを構築せよ。挑んだ数万もの敵を殲滅し、逆らったことを後悔させろ。
items.title: Echoes of Red

items.description: Stray Cat Crossing is an indie pixel horror game about an encounter with a mysterious little girl named Cat. Explore a surreal world filled with colorful characters, challenging riddles, and dark secrets.
items.description_ja: Stray Cat Crossing is an indie pixel horror game about an encounter with a mysterious little girl named Cat. Explore a surreal world filled with colorful characters, challenging riddles, and dark secrets.
items.title: Stray Cat Crossing

items.description: Discover the source of dreadful evil!
items.description_ja: 恐るべき悪の根源を暴きましょう！
items.title: Vampire Legends: The True Story of Kisilova

items.description: 2-4 Sneaky and squeaky low-poly mice face off against a lone cat in the battlefield of a human house. Mice use proximity chat to communicate with other players, while the cat hunts their noises. Will the mice perform enough tasks to destroy the house, or will the cat defeat enough mice to save it?
items.description_ja: 2-4 Sneaky and squeaky low-poly mice face off against a lone cat in the battlefield of a human house. Mice use proximity chat to communicate with other players, while the cat hunts their noises. Will the mice perform enough tasks to destroy the house, or will the cat defeat enough mice to save it?
items.title: Low Poly Mouse Game

items.description:
Let's show〈Yuu〉, the new student, around school.
A short psycho-horror visual novel depicting
a mysterious relationship with her,
unfolding without context like a dream.

The Steam version of an experimental retro game
designed to fit on a single 3.5-inch floppy disk.
items.description_ja:
転校生の〈ユウ〉に学校を案内しよう。夢のように脈絡なく展開する物語の中で、彼女との奇妙な関係を描く短編サイコホラーノベル。
3.5インチフロッピーディスク1枚に収録された、実験的なレトロゲームのSteam版。
items.title: DISK-Y

items.description: The original 5 Monkey GO Happy games have been compiled into one great app.
items.description_ja: The original 5 Monkey GO Happy games have been compiled into one great app.
items.title: Monkey GO Happy

items.description: Shrine is a retro FPS game about a skinless dude killing eldritch monstrosities with his nightmarish arsenal.
items.description_ja: Shrine is a retro FPS game about a skinless dude killing eldritch monstrosities with his nightmarish arsenal.
items.title: Shrine

items.description: What Comes After is a side-scrolling adventure and a short heartwarming story about learning how to love yourself. Help Vivi in her journey on the train to the afterlife and back.
items.description_ja: What Comes After is a side-scrolling adventure and a short heartwarming story about learning how to love yourself. Help Vivi in her journey on the train to the afterlife and back.
items.title: What Comes After

items.description: A 10 minute horror experience of a girl walking home alone at night.
items.description_ja: A 10 minute horror experience of a girl walking home alone at night.
items.title: Almost Home Now

items.description:
An unusual horror-themed Visual Novel about waking up in a carriage with a stranger…
Whatever could go wrong?
items.description_ja:
An unusual horror-themed Visual Novel about waking up in a carriage with a stranger…
Whatever could go wrong?
items.title: Trapped with Jester

items.description: The platformer without a jump button! Master the art of potion propulsion in this fast-paced adventure where strategy, precision, and creativity meet explosive fun.
items.description_ja: ジャンプなしの横スクロールアクションゲーム！？戦略、正確さ、創造力と爆発を組み合わせたスピード感あふれるアドベンチャーで、爆発ポーションのテクニックをマスターしよう。
items.title: Splodey

items.description: Short atmospheric first person horror game with elements of quest and shooter about being lost in the middle of nowhere, surrounded by weird mist.
items.description_ja: Short atmospheric first person horror game with elements of quest and shooter about being lost in the middle of nowhere, surrounded by weird mist.
items.title: Mist

items.description: Water Delivery is a first person, horror experience where you play as a water delivery boy. Ride along in the delivery truck from house to house. Deliver filled water jugs, find and return empty jugs, and collect all the payments. Will you be able to finish your final route of the evening?
items.description_ja: 「Water Delivery」は、水の配達員としてプレイする一人称視点のホラーゲームです。配達トラックに乗って家から家へと移動します。水が詰まったジャグを配達し、空のジャグを見つけて返し、すべての支払いを集めます。あなたは夜の最後のルートを終えることができるでしょうか？
items.title: Water Delivery

items.description: Destroy your friendships with adorable chaos. Roombattle is a fast-paced party battler for up to 6 players where you play as customizable vacuum cleaners, battling friends in frantic arenas and wildly unpredictable minigames across multiple game modes.
items.description_ja: かわいいカオスで、友情をぶち壊せ！『Roombattle（ルームバトル）』は、最大6人まで遊べるハイスピードなパーティ対戦アクション。自分好みにカスタマイズした「お掃除ロボ」を操作して、友達や家族と大バトル！ハチャメチャで予測不能なミニゲームや多彩なモードをたくさん楽しめます！
items.title: Roombattle

items.description:
Dark PGT – A Souls-like game in an alternate universe of future USSR on Unreal Engine 5.
You will play the role of  alcoholic-schizophrenic experiencing psychological disorders and hallucinations. Travel to a village in 2030 to unravel all its secrets and solve all its problems.
items.description_ja:
Dark PGT – A Souls-like game in an alternate universe of future USSR on Unreal Engine 5.
You will play the role of  alcoholic-schizophrenic experiencing psychological disorders and hallucinations. Travel to a village in 2030 to unravel all its secrets and solve all its problems.
items.title: Dark PGT

items.description: A collection of dozens of Aether-flavored microgames! Dive into the Dreams of Aether, where everyone is trapped in a never-ending nightmare! Meet some of the strangest characters Aether has to offer!
items.description_ja: 「Aether」シリーズを題材としたミニゲームが大集合！ 終わらない悪夢に捕らわれてしまったエーテル大陸のライバルたち。どこかヘンなキャラクターたちと共に、悪夢から抜け出そう！
items.title: Dreams of Aether

items.description: The Doll Shop is a hand-drawn narrative game – part romance, part horror – set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a young dollmaker who reunites with his childhood friend in an eerie snowbound village. Will you dare confess your secret?
items.description_ja: 「ドールショップ」は手描きで描かれたビジュアルノベルで、日本の田舎を舞台に、ロマンスとホラーが織り交ぜられています。雪に閉ざされた不気味な村で幼なじみと再会する若い人形職人としてプレイします。自分の秘密を告白する勇気がありますか？
items.title: The Doll Shop

items.description: A pure terror with a twisted backstory; jumping straight into the horrors surrounding Suite 776.
items.description_ja: A pure terror with a twisted backstory; jumping straight into the horrors surrounding Suite 776.
items.title: Suite 776

items.description: A deckbuilding card game where it's always your turn. Play as the master hackers of Quantum and take on the most dangerous malware in the world. Every action matters. Make plays, upgrade your deck, and break the enemy board!
items.description_ja: 爽快なプレイフィール、一手が運命を左右する歯ごたえ、ずっと自分のターン――まったく新しいデッキ構築カードゲームがここに誕生。≪女王≫率いる「クアンタム」の名のもとに、都市を襲うマルウェアをハックせよ！
items.title: Quantum Protocol

items.description: Deep inside a research base, waking up from a cryogenic pod, you find yourself trapped in a living hell, surrounded by zombies. Heaven Dust 2 is a love letter to classic survival horror games featuring exploration, action, puzzles, and resource management.
items.description_ja: 実験基地の奥にある冷凍休眠室で、防護服を着てる主役は突然目覚めました。自分がまた機関が溢れた危険な場所に閉じこまれた事を気付き、周りに獲物を探してるゾンビが大勢いる事が解りました。遊び方は定番の本格生存ホラープラス謎解き：探索、戦闘、謎解き、情報収集、資源管理などの要素を融合しました。
items.title: Heaven Dust 2

items.description: Born Into Fear is a first-person horror game set in an evacuated neighborhood. You'll have to complete task and avoid enemies to destroy the evil Buffer.
items.description_ja: Born Into Fear is a first-person horror game set in an evacuated neighborhood. You'll have to complete task and avoid enemies to destroy the evil Buffer.
items.title: Born Into Fear

items.description:
You're gonna get yourself killed out here... There's monsters, bandits, and much, much worse roaming these lands...
Do you really think you've got what it takes to survive? Or do you think you're cut out for much more than that...
There's only one way to find out, and time is of the essence!
items.description_ja:
You're gonna get yourself killed out here... There's monsters, bandits, and much, much worse roaming these lands...
Do you really think you've got what it takes to survive? Or do you think you're cut out for much more than that...
There's only one way to find out, and time is of the essence!
items.title: Medieval Fantasy Survival Simulator

items.description:
"I can't sleep."

A cute and possibly just a little bit scary puzzle platformer game.
Move stickers to the right positions in order to get rid of the monsters and complete the sticker book.
items.description_ja:
「眠れない。」
可愛らしくてちょっとだけ怖い、絵本のような幻想的な世界で、ステッカーを使ってお化け退治をしましょう。
items.title: My Sticker Book

items.description: Pleh! is a short psychological horror walking simulator that tells the story of a depressed game developer, his intrusive thoughts and his dark mysterious secrets.
items.description_ja: Pleh! is a short psychological horror walking simulator that tells the story of a depressed game developer, his intrusive thoughts and his dark mysterious secrets.
items.title: Pleh!

items.description: You've got a new babysitting job, and things are taking a turn for the weird.  Feed him, read him a bedtime story, and try not to fall into his dreams. How long can you stay in control?
items.description_ja: 新しいベビーシッターの仕事が決まり、事態は奇妙な方向へ向かっている。食事を与え、寝かしつける絵本を読み、夢には入り込まないようにする。いつまでコントロールできるかな？
items.title: The Baby In Yellow

items.description: When the power goes out while working  night shift in the hospital, the emergency lights come on with an eerie glow...
items.description_ja: When the power goes out while working  night shift in the hospital, the emergency lights come on with an eerie glow...
items.title: Blackout Hospital

items.description: This story is one of the rare accounts we've managed to document a tale from the few who have encountered UFOs and lived to tell the tale. Dave considers himself lucky, and maybe you will be too, if you dare to face the unknown and survive.
items.description_ja: This story is one of the rare accounts we've managed to document a tale from the few who have encountered UFOs and lived to tell the tale. Dave considers himself lucky, and maybe you will be too, if you dare to face the unknown and survive.
items.title: Fear The Unknown - Dave Story

items.description: Homicipher is a female-targeted language deciphering and exploration ADV based on the concept of "romance with horror men." The protagonist, who has wandered into another world, interacts with non-human beings to decipher their language while striving to escape.
items.description_ja: 『文字化化（Homicipher）』は、ホラー男子との恋愛と言語解読を組み合わせた女性向けADVです。異界に迷い込んだ主人公が、不思議な言語を話す人外たちと交流しながら脱出を目指す探索型ホラーゲーム。開発元は八名木Games
items.title: Homicipher: Demo

items.description: An immersive, first-person survival shooter where you step into the boots of Special Agent Aiden Clark. Dive deep into a hazardous underground laboratory, tasked with the perilous mission of neutralizing a biological menace and securing a pathogen sample.
items.description_ja: あなたは特別なエージェントエイデン*クラークの役割を取ると、生物学的脅威を破壊し、病原体のサンプルを抽出するために地下の実験室に致命的なミ
items.title: PATHOGEN X

items.description: In this 2D Survival-Horror, you switch between two protagonists as you advance through the story: Neo, a man lost in his own mind, trying to survive an endless nightmare, and Lavina, a loyal friend who will do anything to try to save him.
items.description_ja: In this 2D Survival-Horror, you switch between two protagonists as you advance through the story: Neo, a man lost in his own mind, trying to survive an endless nightmare, and Lavina, a loyal friend who will do anything to try to save him.
items.title: Touch of Madness

items.description: "Mitsume" is a two-player cooperative horror game. Wander together through a dimly lit university campus and communicate to find "anomalies" that appear from only one player's perspective.
items.description_ja: 『みつめ』は二人プレイの協力型ホラーゲームです。薄暗い大学内をさまよう二人。話し合いながら、片方の視点にしか現れない「異変」を探しましょう。
items.title: みつめ

items.description: Vasily Ivanovich Chapaev and his fellow aide Petka realize that someone has stolen the Red banner from the HQ. Although it's not the end of the story yet! Somewhere on the moon, legions of alien invaders prepare to conquer Earth. But could such a little thing really give a scare to the Red Army heroes?
items.description_ja: Vasily Ivanovich Chapaev and his fellow aide Petka realize that someone has stolen the Red banner from the HQ. Although it's not the end of the story yet! Somewhere on the moon, legions of alien invaders prepare to conquer Earth. But could such a little thing really give a scare to the Red Army heroes?
items.title: Red Comrades Save the Galaxy: Reloaded

items.description:
It’s Jess’s Birthday! Explore a labyrinth of DVD menus to find her the perfect birthday gift. Just don’t get distracted. 
Play as a standalone PC game or burn it to DVD yourself! What could go wrong…?
items.description_ja:
It’s Jess’s Birthday! Explore a labyrinth of DVD menus to find her the perfect birthday gift. Just don’t get distracted. 
Play as a standalone PC game or burn it to DVD yourself! What could go wrong…?
items.title: Buitopia DVD

items.description: An honest comedy about anxiety and feeling awkward, played through painfully relatable mini games.
items.description_ja: An honest comedy about anxiety and feeling awkward, played through painfully relatable mini games.
items.title: Just, Bearly

items.description: A unique platformer where an evil AI predicts your movement. Dodge AI-spawned traps, solve optional puzzles and uncover the dark secrets of the simulation. Now with a level editor and infinite community-made content!
items.description_ja: 邪悪なAIがあなたの動きを予測する、ユニークなプラットフォーマー。AIが生み出すトラップをかわし、オプションのパズルを解いて、シミュレーションの暗い秘密を解明しよう。
items.title: Will You Snail?

items.description:
A Place, Forbidden is a first-person, lo-fi horror-puzzle game set in the Library of Ouroboros, a seemingly innocuous library that, rumor has it, contains knowledge not meant for the eyes of mortal man. 

We hope you enjoy your visit.
items.description_ja:
A Place, Forbidden is a first-person, lo-fi horror-puzzle game set in the Library of Ouroboros, a seemingly innocuous library that, rumor has it, contains knowledge not meant for the eyes of mortal man.

items.description:
Mayo is back, and it’s all about kicking butts and having an existential crisis.
This is a clicker game about a mayonnaise jar.
items.description_ja:
Mayo is back, and it’s all about kicking butts and having an existential crisis.

items.description: A short horror experience rendered with a real-time VHS filter (grain, scan lines). Freely explore the spaces of a strange yellow maze. Independently created by a 12-year-old developer using UE5, it immerses you in a purely liminal space atmosphere.
items.description_ja: 短いホラー体験で、リアルタイムVHSフィルター（粒状感、走査線）でレンダリングされています。奇妙な黄色の迷宮空間を自由に探索できます。12歳の開発者がUE5を使って独立して制作したもので、純粋なエッジスペースの雰囲気にあなたを没入させます。
items.title: The Backrooms: Liminal Space

items.description:
Lilith has returned from the fantasy world to become your desktop companion.
Watch her wander freely across your screen with lively animations and dynamic real-time behaviors.
Spend cozy everyday moments together as she keeps you company and eases the stress of daily life.
items.description_ja:
かわいい少女リリスが、あの幻想世界からあなたのデスクトップへ！
リリスとの心温まる交流を気軽に楽しむことができます。
生き生きとしたモーションや表情、そして時間とリンクした振舞いは、まるで本当にそこにいるかのよう。
デスクトップ上を自由に動き回るリリスは、お好みの場所に配置することもできます。
リリスと過ごす何気ないひとときが、あなたに小さな癒やしを届けてくれるでしょう。
items.title: The NOexistenceN of Lilith

items.description: Floppy Heroes is a ragdoll physics brawler with dismemberment, a wide range of weapons and armor, very simple controls, and custom battles playable with up to 6 local players.
items.description_ja: Floppy Heroes is a ragdoll physics brawler with dismemberment, a wide range of weapons and armor, very simple controls, and custom battles playable with up to 6 local players.
items.title: Floppy Heroes

items.description:
Just keep walking left. The latest Tsugunohi returns to the series’ roots with its early visual style and atmosphere.
On a sweltering summer day, a girl walks home past “righteous” people, a thread of salvation, and her mother beneath a white umbrella.
Is that hand salvation—or a curse?
items.description_ja:
操作は左に歩くだけ。日常侵食ホラー「つぐのひ」シリーズ最新作。本作は、初期の絵柄と空気感に立ち返った“原点回帰”の一作。
うだる夏の住宅街で、落書きだらけの家に住む少女は、今日も学校から家へ帰る。毎日現れる“正しい”人たち、空から垂れる救いの糸、白い傘の母。その手は、救いか、呪いか。
items.title: Tsugunohi -The Thread That Beckons to Heaven-

items.description: Underhero is an RPG-platformer where the chosen hero has failed, and an underling of the evil king takes his place as the new hero. Use timing-based combat to defeat enemies as you venture across the land, face off against quirky bosses, and save the kingdom from your own evil boss, Mr Stitches!

items.description: Hello and welcome to Backfirewall_, a first-person tragicomic adventure set inside a smartphone. You are the update assistant. Solve wacky puzzles to counter the update and save the previous operating system from deletion. The fate of the System is in your hands!
items.description_ja: Backfirewallにようこそ。スマートフォンの中に、コミカルかつ心揺さぶる一人称視点の世界を広げよう。不可解なパズルを解いてデータの刷り込みを乗り越えろ！キミの役割は、オペレーティングシステムの破壊を防ぐ管理アシスタントだ。システムの運命はその手の中に握られている！

items.description: Westerado: Double Barreled. When your family is murdered by a mysterious desperado, you set out into the world to take revenge. Take control of your own fate and that of others, all using your trusty shooting iron.

items.description: Skill-based gunplay meets turn-based tactics in SteamWorld Heist 2! Aim carefully, bounce bullets, and pull off trick shots in high-stakes heists. Choose your crew and utilize 150+ items to navigate real-time naval battles and daring missions in this 30+ hour adventure to stop a deadly water crisis.
items.description_ja: 迫りくる水難からボット族を救うため、Captain Leeway（キャプテン・リーウェイ）と共に史上最大のHeist（略奪劇）に挑め！特徴的な跳弾アクションを特徴とするターン制ストラテジーバトル、150種類以上の武器やアイテム、新たなジョブシステム、リアルタイム海戦、30時間以上のゲームプレイを楽しめる、壮大なスチームワールドの冒険に備えよう！

items.description_ja: 『凶寓』は、一人称視点の中国風ホラーゲーム。プレイヤーは凶楼へ赴き、猟奇事件の真相を解明し、失踪者を探す旅に挑む…

items.description: We are recruiting a large number of testers from around the world to participate in an unprecedented secret experiment.. Join us and embark on this journey of exploration that is crucial to survival. In this unknown experiment, your choices will determine the fate of the Earth.
items.description_ja: 私たちは世界中から試験員を大量に募集し、これまでにない秘密の試験に参加しています。私たちに参加して、この存亡にかかわる探索の旅に出て、あなたの選択は、地球の運命を決定します。この未知の実験の中で、あなたは、変化の力です！

items.description: A co-op horror comedy game for you and your friends about burglarizing a nightmarish neighborhood full of mutated pets. No one said this would be easy, but maybe you can make it out of there with a sweet wood paneled video cassette recorder.
items.description_ja: 変異ペットの巣窟と化した悪夢の住宅街で、みんな一緒にドロボーだ。1人でもフレンドでも楽しめる、協力型ホラー・コメディゲーム。楽勝だなんて一言も言ってない。でももしかすると、イケてるウッドパネルのビデオデッキを持って家から脱出できるかもしれない。

items.description: You are locked inside a cinema. Your only way to escape is to follow the instructions of your task: Watch the same film clip repeatedly and search for flaws to break free. But this may sound easier than it is, every wrong decision or death will set you back. So be careful!
items.description_ja: あなたは映画館に閉じ込められた。脱出する唯一の方法は、与えられた任務の指示に従うことだ：同じ映像を繰り返し見て、矛盾点を探し出せ。しかし、これは思ったより難しい。間違った判断や死は、あなたを後退させる。気をつけろ！

items.description: The hottest bird lawyering game to come out of 1840s France! Join Jayjay Falcon and his witty apprentice, Sparrowson, as the two take on clients, interview witnesses, collect evidence, and deliver justice to the guilty.

items.description:
This is a pixel style puzzle  game, including a certain micro-horror elements.
Truth is blind love. Retrieve your memory and escape from this horrible hospital.

このゲームは、ドット絵パズルゲームです。ホラー的な要素を含んでいます。
真実は盲目の愛。記憶を取り戻し、この恐ろしい病院から脱出せよ。

items.description: It`s impossible to refuse to help Odin when he asks to find his pet, Fenris, the hound of Hell. A mix of cinematic adventure and a colony building strategy that will take you deep down to the underground world of dwarfs.

items.description: Explore a beautiful and Enigmatic Victorian Manor with a dark secret, In this gothic horror story first person exploration puzzle game filled with fine art, secret passages and mysterious mechanical puzzles playing as the executor of the last will from the enigmatic Railroad Magnate Hadley Strange.
items.description_ja: 謎めいた鉄道王ハドレー・ストレンジの遺言執行人となり、美術品や秘密の通路、ミステリアスなメカニカルパズルなどが満載のホラーストーリー一人称視点探索パズルゲームで、暗い秘密を抱えた美しく謎めいたヴィクトリア朝の荘園を探索しましょう。

items.description: You have to escape Granny and Grandpa...You have five days...
items.description_ja: You have to escape Granny and Grandpa...You have five days...

items.description: A Roguelite monster killing satisfaction galore without any exploration elements. The game is filled to the brim with exotic enemies and stages with a collection of deep and robust boons, weapons, and items plus an abundance of pointless features and useless details. (CONTROLLER SUPPORTED)
items.description_ja: ステージクリア型のローグライクアクションゲーム、怪物退治だけで満足！色々な敵とステージ、多様な武器と装備、独特のお尻アタックがプレイヤーにかつてない面白いゲーム体験がお届けします。（コントロール対応！）

items.description:
Simple and easy game!
Just chill out and simulate eating yakiniku!
items.description_ja:
【ゲーム紹介】
お腹が空いた？焼肉食べたい？でもカロリーが気になる？
そんな時には「焼肉シミュレーター」！牛タン、ハラミ、上カルビ、カルビがアナタを待っています！
「焼肉シミュレーター」ならいくら焼いてもカロリーゼロ！思う存分焼いちゃいましょう！
※ライス、ビールは必要に応じて各々ご用意ください。

He begins to search for answers to uncover the secrets, and whether they are painful truths or terrifying illusions.

地獄銭湯リメイクは、銭湯で働くことをテーマにした和風ホラーゲームです。

Enjoy stylish pixel-art action while testing your flexible thinking and precise strategy!

items.description: Explore quiet liminal spaces that feel familiar, yet strangely wrong. Walk, climb, and swim through five handcrafted stages, then build worlds of your own in a powerful sandbox. Publish them through LIMSCAPERS, visit other creators’ spaces, and explore together in Multiplay Beta.
items.description_ja: 見覚えがあるのに、どこかおかしい――静かで不気味なリミナルスペースを歩き、登り、泳いで、5つの公式ステージに隠された出口と物語を探す一人称探索ゲーム。旅の先では、サンドボックスで自分だけの空間をつくり、LIMSCAPERSで公開・共有。誰かの世界を訪れ、Multiplay Betaで一緒に探索することもできます。

items.description: The first live-action visual novel with an anime flair! Gamer 'Eggy' turns into a girl. Join bro Monkey and his gf to uncover why the school belle hides a tough guy soul. Seek a cure or embrace your new life. Your choice drives this adventure!
items.description_ja: The first live-action visual novel with an anime flair! Gamer 'Eggy' turns into a girl. Join bro Monkey and his gf to uncover why the school belle hides a tough guy soul. Seek a cure or embrace your new life. Your choice drives this adventure!

'One last try' Violet is determined to save her broken marriage - at any cost!
Wandering through a dark forest in search of lost mementos, she finds the world around her shifting with every step.

「最後の試み」ヴァイオレットは壊れた結婚を、どんな犠牲を払ってでも救おうと決意している！
失われた記念品を探して暗い森をさまよいながら、彼女の周りの世界は一歩ごとに変化していく。

items.description:
Sit tight: a coronation for the annals of the Hao realm. I’m Jiahao, your desktop pet—its absolute strongest, stock investing’s uncrowned king and fashion’s highest peak. What has this loneliness taught you to love?

“You misunderstand. Let me enlighten you.”
“You are the challenger.”
items.description_ja:
まったく、しょうがないな。座って。これは豪界の歴史に刻まれる戴冠だ。君のデスクトップペット、嘉豪。豪界の絶対的強者、株式投資界の無冠の王、ファッション界の最高峰。そこから生まれた孤独は、君に何を愛せと教えた？

「何か勘違いしているようだから、一応教えておこう」

items.description:
You wake up with an aching head and the world out of focus. In front of you is a man accusing you of being “fake”. He looks exactly like you, down to the last scar and pimple, has the same memories, the same voice and the same personality. 

But who is lying and who is telling the truth? Who is fake and who is real? 

With over nine different possibilities, you can either end up as the tragic hero, the sly villain, or an innocent victim. Will you keep your cool or pick a fight? Play through all the endings and take a peek at the truth of your demise. 

Whatever action you take, ultimately, you must answer the question: “Who is Mike?”

items.description:
Over 13M downloads! The pinnacle of physics puzzles.

A challenge to humanity: Can you get the ball out of the cup?

What to do is simple: Just draw on screen.
Yet, it is surprisingly hard. Infinite solutions—even devs can't solve every Q.

Sound confusing? Try it out! How will you solve it?
items.description_ja:
世界累計1300万ダウンロード突破。
物理演算パズルの金字塔。
解き方、無限大。

ゲームデザイナーから、全人類への挑戦状。

あなたは、コップに入ったボールを外へ出せますか？

お願いすることは、とても単純。
やり方は画面に何かを描くだけ。

しかし、その「単純」は驚くほど難しい。

解き方は人それぞれ。正解は１つではない。
数秒で解ける人もいれば、永久に解けない人もいる。
作者ですら解けないQが存在する。

「何を言っているのかわからない」

そう思ったら、まずは遊んでみて下さい。

考えて、試して、ひらめく。
気づけば時間を忘れて夢中になっているはずです。

あなたなら、どう解きますか？
items.title: Q REMASTERED

items.description_ja: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online is a clicker game where progression is replaced with gambling, where the goal is simply to collect the rarest silly linguine cats.
items.title: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online

items.description: Zueirama is a fun action adventure game packed with references to memes. Inspired by the games of the 90s, with cartoon characters that reflect the essence and Brazilian swinging like you have never seen.
items.description_ja: Zueirama is a fun action adventure game packed with references to memes. Inspired by the games of the 90s, with cartoon characters that reflect the essence and Brazilian swinging like you have never seen.
items.title: Zueirama

items.description: A bullet hell roguelike game. Players can utilize characters with different abilities, collect and assemble powerful items. Dance through an unending barrage of bullets to save both yourself and Touhou Gensokyo from the darkness that is engulfing everything.
items.description_ja: 東方夜光幻夢は、ローグライク要素を含む2Dトップダウン弾幕シューティングゲームです。 プレイヤーはさまざまな能力を持つキャラクターを使用し、強力なアイテムを集めて組み合わせることができます。 すべてを飲み込む闇からあなたと幻想郷を救うために、終わりのない弾幕と踊りましょう。
items.title: Touhou Endless Dream

items.description: A text-based incremental idle game with a ridiculous amount of unique content. Automate old stuff as you unlock new stuff to keep things interesting for hours and hours, no spam clicking necessary! Trimps is everything you love about your favorite games, distilled to their purest form.
items.description_ja: A text-based incremental idle game with a ridiculous amount of unique content. Automate old stuff as you unlock new stuff to keep things interesting for hours and hours, no spam clicking necessary! Trimps is everything you love about your favorite games, distilled to their purest form.
items.title: Trimps

items.description: Prepare a meal for the Vietnamese Lunar New Year dinner. But hurry, your guests are arriving soon! A short hand-drawn experience full of delicious surprises.
items.description_ja: Prepare a meal for the Vietnamese Lunar New Year dinner. But hurry, your guests are arriving soon! A short hand-drawn experience full of delicious surprises.
items.title: TET

items.description: A 3D linear collect-a-thon platformer about a frog. Collect golden flies, unlock new worlds, and interact with a variety of mechanics and powerups. Finally, discover what lies behind the great gate.
items.description_ja: カエルを主人公にした3Dリニアコレクト・ア・ソン・プラットフォームゲーム。金色のハエを集め、新たな世界をアンロックし、様々なメカニクスやパワーアップを駆使して、ついに大門の向こうに何があるのかを解き明かしましょう。
items.title: Sapo 3D

items.description:
The Count of Monte Clicker is an incremental game about breaking out of prison and finding treasure. 

With the help of fellow prisoner Abbe Faria, you, Edmond Dantes must escape the notorious Chateau d'Idle and claim your destiny.
items.description_ja:
The Count of Monte Clicker is an incremental game about breaking out of prison and finding treasure. 

With the help of fellow prisoner Abbe Faria, you, Edmond Dantes must escape the notorious Chateau d'Idle and claim your destiny.
items.title: The Count of Monte Clicker

items.description: "Consumption Line" is a short, fully free, experimental indie game about the food industry, deceptive advertising and the downsides of modern life. A sarcastic 30‑minute experience designed to make you reflect, not grind.
items.description_ja: "Consumption Line" is a short, fully free, experimental indie game about the food industry, deceptive advertising and the downsides of modern life. A sarcastic 30‑minute experience designed to make you reflect, not grind.
items.title: Consumption Line

items.description: Armed to the teeth, players begin as Neptune in an unworldly 8-bit space dimension ravaged by creatures who burst endless waves of bullets. Shoot, dodge, and defeat the boss in six unique bullet-hell worlds. After defeating each boss, they will join your mission, allowing you to switch characters and utilize their unique shooting abilities. Neptune and her friends must traverse through this shmup space dimension and defeat the last boss once and for all!
items.description_ja:
手軽にプレイ出来て、気が付くとドップリハマってしまうシューティングゲーム、ネプシューター。自機であるネプテューヌを操作し、迫りくる敵を撃ち落せ！
ネプシューターは爽快な8bit風シューティングゲームで全6ステージ構成。さまざまな敵がネプテューヌの行く手を遮ります。中にはかつての仲間たちも・・・
items.title: Neptunia Shooter

items.description: Welcome home to Sun Villa! After a long summer at grandpa's ranch, it's time to finish school, get a job and move into your own place. Let the adventure of life begin!
items.description_ja: Welcome home to Sun Villa! After a long summer at grandpa's ranch, it's time to finish school, get a job and move into your own place. Let the adventure of life begin!
items.title: Super Life (RPG)

items.description: Trapped in a public restroom. You’re not alone. You make bad decisions. Horror-comedy with multiple endings.
items.description_ja: 公衆トイレに閉じ込められた。ひとりじゃない。怪しい選択をする。マルチエンディングのホラーコメディ。
items.title: Toilet Chronicles

items.description: You are Simon, a lover of hotdogs. Can you guide him and his friends to collect the most hotdogs EVER?
items.description_ja: You are Simon, a lover of hotdogs. Can you guide him and his friends to collect the most hotdogs EVER?
items.title: Hotdog Runner

items.description: Maize is a first-person adventure game about what happens when two scientists misinterpret a memo from the U.S. Government and create sentient corn. And that last sentence is pretty much the least ridiculous thing about the game.
items.description_ja: Maize is a first-person adventure game about what happens when two scientists misinterpret a memo from the U.S. Government and create sentient corn. And that last sentence is pretty much the least ridiculous thing about the game.
items.title: Maize

items.description:
Bursting with hilarious dialogue and comical encounters!
The second installment of the super-exhilarating Metroidvania series is here!!
items.description_ja:
爆笑必至の会話とコミカルな出会い！
スリル満点、爽快アクション満載！
超爽快メトロイドヴァニアシリーズ第2弾!!
items.title: ROLLING STAR

items.description: Show off your skills & reflexes in this frantic gallery shooter action arcade, filled with bullets, bots and explosions! You play as Erin Saver, carrying out her personal vendetta against the criminal Wildbots.
items.description_ja: このいかれた射撃場型シューティングアクションアーケードで自分のスキルと反射神経を発揮し、弾丸・ロボット・爆発で埋め尽くせ。エリン・セイバーとなってプレイし、凶悪なワイルドボッツへの復讐を果たせ。
items.title: Bot Vice

items.description: pla_toon is an action-packed, first-and-third-person, multiplayer, light-hearted, cartoon-style shooter where you as play a soldier. Join the multiplayer battle and be the first to a para-crate drop to equip your player with powerful weapons! Or get on an ostrich and ride off into the sunset...
items.description_ja: pla_toon is an action-packed, first-and-third-person, multiplayer, light-hearted, cartoon-style shooter where you as play a soldier. Join the multiplayer battle and be the first to a para-crate drop to equip your player with powerful weapons! Or get on an ostrich and ride off into the sunset...
items.title: pla_toon

items.description: Embark on a quest of epic importance in Pesterquest, a grimsical episodic visual novel adventure set in the darkly funny Homestuck / Hiveswap universe, created by American author and artist Andrew Hussie.
items.description_ja: Embark on a quest of epic importance in Pesterquest, a grimsical episodic visual novel adventure set in the darkly funny Homestuck / Hiveswap universe, created by American author and artist Andrew Hussie.
items.title: Pesterquest

items.description: BalanCity is a city building / balance physics game. It's a mixture between old school SimCity and Jenga. You must build the tallest towering city over a balancing platform while keeping your citizens happy.
items.description_ja: BalanCity is a city building / balance physics game. It's a mixture between old school SimCity and Jenga. You must build the tallest towering city over a balancing platform while keeping your citizens happy.
items.title: BalanCity

items.description:
Hello Comrades ! You think you got what it takes to be tru slav? 
Then we have game for you ! Prove to all your gopnik friends 
that you are the superior alpha slav your babushka always wanted you to be.
items.description_ja:
Hello Comrades ! You think you got what it takes to be tru slav? 
Then we have game for you ! Prove to all your gopnik friends 
that you are the superior alpha slav your babushka always wanted you to be.

items.description: MEANDERS is a sparkling adventure through a series of funny and relaxing challenges in a colourful setting.
items.description_ja: MEANDERSは、カラフルな雰囲気の中で、面白くてリラックスした一連の課題を通して、驚くべき冒険です。
items.title: MEANDERS

items.description: You're a retired paleontologist. Collect fossils and solve puzzles in the calm of your old garage!
items.description_ja: You're a retired paleontologist. Collect fossils and solve puzzles in the calm of your old garage!
items.title: Fossil Corner

items.description: The loveable birds of Hatoful Boyfriend are back in the remastered holiday-themed sequel Hatoful Boyfriend: Holiday Star!
items.description_ja: 「ハートフル彼氏」の愛らしいハト達と過ごす、ステキな休日「ハートフル彼氏 Holiday Star」！
items.title: Hatoful Boyfriend: Holiday Star

items.description: Play a Zen game! Rediscover the famous traditional Chinese game. Find all the matching pairs of tiles, being careful not to become blocked in, to get to the end of each level. Concentration and perceptiveness are needed to finish the gorgeous boards that we have produced for you.
items.description_ja: Play a Zen game! Rediscover the famous traditional Chinese game. Find all the matching pairs of tiles, being careful not to become blocked in, to get to the end of each level. Concentration and perceptiveness are needed to finish the gorgeous boards that we have produced for you.
items.title: Mahjong

items.description: Grab your shiny helmet and trusty sword, gather all the valor and honor you have, and show everyone, what being the true knight actually means!
items.description_ja: Grab your shiny helmet and trusty sword, gather all the valor and honor you have, and show everyone, what being the true knight actually means!
items.title: OH MY GOD, LOOK AT THIS KNIGHT

items.description: Talk to Strangers is a game of everyday survival. Survive door to door conversations ranging from bizarre to mundane (in this order) while trying to sell products to strangers. But beware: nothing is what it seems in this neighborhood.
items.description_ja: Talk to Strangers is a game of everyday survival. Survive door to door conversations ranging from bizarre to mundane (in this order) while trying to sell products to strangers. But beware: nothing is what it seems in this neighborhood.
items.title: Talk to Strangers

items.description: For the first time on steam. The greatest dictator of all time is now dancing on your desktop!
items.description_ja: Steamで初めて。 すべての時間の最大の独裁者は今、あなたのデスクトップ上で踊っている！
items.title: My Friend Stalin

items.description: Travel the kingdom as Jester with his best friend Sok to improvise theatre shows and perform on stages far and wide. Sing your hearts out, crack jokes and impress audiences to become the stars of the famous Royal Theatrical Spectacle!
items.description_ja: Travel the kingdom as Jester with his best friend Sok to improvise theatre shows and perform on stages far and wide. Sing your hearts out, crack jokes and impress audiences to become the stars of the famous Royal Theatrical Spectacle!
items.title: Once Upon a Jester

items.description: Fire up your ray guns, crystal swords, and laser whips, and get ready for thrills and chills! With three incredible movie stars playing out decidedly B-level sci-fi exploits, Dick Starspeed, Scarlet Nova, and Robot will have you ready to jump off the side of the tower—right into adventure!
items.description_ja: Fire up your ray guns, crystal swords, and laser whips, and get ready for thrills and chills! With three incredible movie stars playing out decidedly B-level sci-fi exploits, Dick Starspeed, Scarlet Nova, and Robot will have you ready to jump off the side of the tower—right into adventure!
items.title: The Deadly Tower of Monsters

items.description: Flip fake trading cards for real profit in FeeBay Simulator, a comedic marketplace tycoon game. Snipe underpriced cards from clueless and scammy sellers, grade your best pulls, open mystery lots, rip packs and run your own storefront to build a reselling empire.
items.description_ja: Flip fake trading cards for real profit in FeeBay Simulator, a comedic marketplace tycoon game. Snipe underpriced cards from clueless and scammy sellers, grade your best pulls, open mystery lots, rip packs and run your own storefront to build a reselling empire.
items.title: FeeBay Simulator

items.description: Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game! Become a sushi chef, craft unique toppings, and enter your trained sushi into races. Don't forget to cheer on your sushi during the race. Win the prestigious S1 Cup championship, and become a top-tier sushi chef!
items.description_ja: かわいいお寿司たちが育成×レースで大疾走！あなたは寿司職人となって個性豊かなネタを握り、鍛えた寿司でレースに出走します。レース中はお寿司を応援することも忘れずに。栄光ある寿司レースの頂・「S1」カップ優勝を勝ち獲り、一流の寿司職人となれ！
items.title: Wabisabi SushiDerby

items.description: Gizmo is a Saturday-morning 3D platformer inspired by 90s classics of the genre.
items.description_ja: Gizmo is a Saturday-morning 3D platformer inspired by 90s classics of the genre.
items.title: Gizmo

items.description: Fast paced, first person adventure aboard Noah's ark!
items.description_ja: Fast paced, first person adventure aboard Noah's ark!
items.title: Super 3-D Noah's Ark

items.description:
Catch falling allies and dominate the battlefield!
Control your flying platform to catch characters and auto-attack enemies.
Build your team, link skills, and shape your own strategy in this evolving arcade action game.
items.description_ja:
空から降ってくる仲間をキャッチして、戦場を支配しよう。
飛行体を操作してキャラクターを受け止めると、自動で敵を攻撃します。
さまざまなキャラクターを組み合わせ、スキルを連携させて自分だけの戦略を完成させましょう。
強化と成長により、戦い方が進化していくアーケードアクションがあなたを待っています。
items.title: Maru Expedition: We can fly

items.description:
Corporations control the entire global government.
Injustice has inspired a revolution in Suits City.
Follow the journey of a businessman's descent into corruption...
items.description_ja:
Corporations control the entire global government.
Injustice has inspired a revolution in Suits City.
Follow the journey of a businessman's descent into corruption...
items.title: Suits: A Business RPG

items.description: Step into a fully 3D medieval world of deception. diffiCULT is a multiplayer social deduction game where you must uncover hidden cultists. Use proximity voice chat, investigate houses at night, survive daily votes, and reveal who is truly on your side.
items.description_ja: 欺瞞に満ちたフル3Dの中世世界へ。『diffiCULT』は、正体を隠したカルト信者を見破るマルチプレイヤー型ソーシャルディダクションゲーム。近接ボイスチャットで情報を集め、夜は家々を調査し、昼の投票を生き延びながら、本当の味方を見極めよう。
items.title: diffiCULT

items.description: You're Jack, a thief in the 80s. Steal VCRs, tapes, and other 80s items in this prologue of American Theft 80s! Newest game from THIEF SIMULATOR developers.
items.description_ja: あなたは80年代の泥棒、ジャックです。このAmerican Theft 80s のプロローグで、ビデオデッキやテープなど80年代のアイテムを盗みましょう! THIEF SIMULATOR の開発者による最新ゲームです。
items.title: American Theft 80s: Prologue

items.description:
Crush your friends in combat by embodying these adorable yet Gnaughty Gnomes!
Throw everything you find along the way, choose cards to upgrade your build, change the rules of the game... whatever it takes to win.
items.description_ja:
友だちと一緒にわんぱくノームが駆け回る、めまぐるしいアリーナバトルに挑もう！
目につくものを投げまくり、おかしなエフェクトやスキルでノームを強化。ゲームのルールを書き換えながら、勝利を手にしよう！
items.title: Gnaughty Gnomes

items.description: “Going against the grain is just another form of rebellion.” That's what high school student Yuta Nozaki believes, living by the principle of following the trend. Through his classmate Misaki Miyoshi, who constantly goes against the grain, Yuta begins to confront his true feelings.
items.description_ja: 「逆張りなんて反抗期の一種でしかない」そういって順張りで生きることを信条とする高校生の野崎優太は、それによって毎日平穏な日々を送っていた。しかし何に対しても逆張りばかりするクラスメイトの三好岬を通じて本当の自分の気持ちへと向き合っていく。
items.title: 片腕のザリガニ - one-armed crayfish

items.description: Model, paint, and mimic everything to hide from the Busters! Mimic Busters is an online multiplayer game where you are either a cube with a sentience or a hunter with no mercy. Mimics create their disguise using simple 3D modeling tools and Busters hunt the Mimics before the time runs out!
items.description_ja: 造形して、塗って、化けてハンターをやり過ごせ！Mimic Busters は、意思を持つキューブか容赦のないハンターになって戦うオンラインマルチプレイゲーム。ミミックは手軽な3Dモデリングツールで変装を作り、ハンターは時間切れ前にミミックを暴き出す！
items.title: Mimic Busters

items.description: A Book of Beasts and Buddies is an interactive beastiary of curious creatures.
items.description_ja: A Book of Beasts and Buddies is an interactive beastiary of curious creatures.
items.title: A Book of Beasts and Buddies

items.description: Divide By Sheep is a mind-bending math puzzler about friendship and slicing sheep in half with lasers. The Grim Reaper flooded the world, and it's up to you to save critters stranded on islands. Insane math skills required.
items.description_ja: Divide By Sheep is a mind-bending math puzzler about friendship and slicing sheep in half with lasers. The Grim Reaper flooded the world, and it's up to you to save critters stranded on islands. Insane math skills required.
items.title: Divide By Sheep

items.description: Relive your school days in 3D, where old school graphics bring back timeless fun! Create your own star student and attend a schedule full of classes in time to gather the knowledge you need to thrive, while an equally important popularity contest challenges you survive...
items.description_ja: Relive your school days in 3D, where old school graphics bring back timeless fun! Create your own star student and attend a schedule full of classes in time to gather the knowledge you need to thrive, while an equally important popularity contest challenges you survive...
items.title: Old School

items.description: Dooms Hair Salon is a comedy simulation game about running a hair salon in a chaotic town. Survive by operating the salon alone or with friends!
items.description_ja: ドゥームズ・ヘアサロンは、混沌とした町で美容室を経営するコメディシミュレーションゲームです。一人で、または友達と一緒に美容室を運営して生き残りましょう！
items.title: Dooms Hair Salon

items.description: In the seas of the distant future, humans have all but disappeared. In your current, newly-awakened state, you are no more than a piece of seafood. However, you have been blessed with the talent for leading your allies into battle. Do whatever it takes to become the Ace of Seafood.
items.description_ja: 遥かな未来の海、人は姿を消し、魚や蟹は光線を放ち、戦っていた。今、目覚めた貴方もまた海産物だ。ただし仲間を率い、戦う才能に溢れている。やがて海を探索し、世界を知り、仲間を増やし、勝利を重ねていくだろう。その姿はまさに海産物のエース。エース・オブ・シーフードだ。
items.title: Ace of Seafood

items.description: An infuriating platformer themed around Monty Python and the Holy Grail starring Pipkin Pippa in her search for the holy grail. Climb through 5 levels to reach the end, be careful not to fall and lose all your progress!
items.description_ja: An infuriating platformer themed around Monty Python and the Holy Grail starring Pipkin Pippa in her search for the holy grail. Climb through 5 levels to reach the end, be careful not to fall and lose all your progress!
items.title: Pippa of Caerbannog

items.description: RoboCo is a sandbox game about designing and building robots to serve the needs of squishy, hapless humans in the world of tomorrow!
items.description_ja: 『RoboCo』は、未来の世界のフニャフニャで不運な人間のニーズに応える、健全なロボット設計&構築サンドボックスゲームです！
items.title: RoboCo

items.description: Become what you have always imagined, a rock with no responsibilities, no debt, and no worries. The only thing on your checklist is to exist and watch as time fades away...also to become the golden rock.
items.description_ja: あなたがずっと思い描いていた、責任も借金も心配もない岩になりましょう。 あなたがやるべきことはただ存在し、時間が消えていくのを見ることだけ…。
items.title: Rock Simulator

items.description: You're just a simple inhabitant of the endless Gigastructure. The best you'll get is seven shifts at a machine and a bowl of feed concentrate, and that for good service to the party.... Is that it? Or do you have a choice?
items.description_ja: あなたは、果てしなく続くギガフルシチョフカの、ごく普通の住人です。あなたに待っている最高の未来といえば、機械の前で7交代勤務をこなし、党への忠誠に対する褒美として、食糧濃縮物の器を一杯もらうこと。それで全部？　それとも、あなたには選択する自由があるのでしょう？
items.title: Choice of Life: Samosbor

items.description: Babble Royale is an intense multiplayer free-for-all that combines word-making skill with fast-paced tactical and strategic action. Earn money and collect loot to upgrade your abilities, outrun the deadly hot zone, and outwit or outlast all your opponents to have the Last Word!
items.description_ja: Babble Royale is an intense multiplayer free-for-all that combines word-making skill with fast-paced tactical and strategic action. Earn money and collect loot to upgrade your abilities, outrun the deadly hot zone, and outwit or outlast all your opponents to have the Last Word!
items.title: Babble Royale

items.description: An interactive story about a painfully introverted college student who must find a way to make some oatmeal in the communal kitchen of her dorm. One simple task, can you help her complete it?
items.description_ja: An interactive story about a painfully introverted college student who must find a way to make some oatmeal in the communal kitchen of her dorm. One simple task, can you help her complete it?

items.description_ja: Dodge! Shoot! Go faster! Break the sound barrier in this unbelievably fast game and go straight for the first place in the leaderboard of BARRIER X!
items.title: BARRIER X

items.description: One day, Ciarán starts receiving enigmatic emails from a mysterious sender, turning his everyday life into a mess of a romantic comedy with psychological themes mixed in. What lies beyond the mystery he's been presented with? In the words of Harry H.: "If you want to know the truth, go find it".
items.description_ja: One day, Ciarán starts receiving enigmatic emails from a mysterious sender, turning his everyday life into a mess of a romantic comedy with psychological themes mixed in. What lies beyond the mystery he's been presented with? In the words of Harry H.: "If you want to know the truth, go find it".

items.description: In this 3D physics based "fighter", take control of Aniki, Kazuya, Obama, and the rest of the cast as you duke it out in famous gachimuchi locations to see who's really the boss of the gym!
items.description_ja: In this 3D physics based "fighter", take control of Aniki, Kazuya, Obama, and the rest of the cast as you duke it out in famous gachimuchi locations to see who's really the boss of the gym!
