items.description: A Camping Story starring: Uncle Brad, Aunt Cloanne, Mord (and Ben)
items.description_ja: A Camping Story starring: Uncle Brad, Aunt Cloanne, Mord (and Ben)
items.title: Wide Ocean Big Jacket

items.description: Hell Architect is a hell colony sim. Build and manage your hell. Take care of the sinners with funny cartoon-style tortures, fill their needs, develop buildings, gather resources, grow your population. Prologue is a free standalone version of the game 'Hell Architect'.
items.description_ja: Hell Architect Prologueは、ゲーム「HellArchitect」の無料スタンドアローンバージョンです。これはあなたが地獄の新米管理者になる始まりの物語。あなたの役目は、地獄の管理者となり、ルシファーを王座から引きずり下ろす程に冥界を発展させる事。さあ地獄の始まりだ！
items.title: Hell Architect: Prologue

items.description: Pixel Art Coloring Book easily removes your stress! A huge range of colorful pixel art images in this coloring book is for ALL AGES! Relax while coloring awesome pixel art coloring pages. Start color by number today & feel better. It’s simple. It’s good. It’s fun.
items.description_ja: Pixel Art -ドット絵 塗り絵で手軽にストレス発散！数字で塗り絵を楽しめる、このたくさんのカラフルなピクセルアート画像コレクションは、全年齢対象！素敵なPixel Artの塗り絵を堪能しながら、リラックスしましょう。今日から数字で塗り絵をスタートして気分爽快！ぜひお楽しみください。
items.title: Pixel Art Coloring Book

items.description: Exactly what it says on the tin. Sewer Rave is a game about exploring a rat infested Rave in a Sewer. There are creatures to talk to, items to collect, fights to get into, and jams to listen to. Explore, discover secrets, and writhe.
items.description_ja: Exactly what it says on the tin. Sewer Rave is a game about exploring a rat infested Rave in a Sewer. There are creatures to talk to, items to collect, fights to get into, and jams to listen to. Explore, discover secrets, and writhe.

items.description: Share thoughts and hot food with your last ever clients, as you wait for the world to end.
items.description_ja: 世界の終わりを待ちながら、人生最後のお客さんに温かい食事を提供し、思いを共有しよう。

items.description: Experience death from the comfort of your seat.
items.description_ja: Experience death from the comfort of your seat.

items.description_ja: Your new favorite Werewolf game! Seat around the fire with friends, play a villager, a werewolf or another type of character and use strategy to win!

items.description: In this free 2D puzzle game, you must reassemble broken objects that your cat has knocked over.
items.description_ja: 猫が壊してしまったオブジェクトを組み立て直す無料2Dパズルゲームです。

items.description: Solo or up to 8 players. Get rid of your employer's failed experiments in abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, avoid abyssal terrors, and remove all corpses.
items.description_ja: ソロまたは最大8人のプレイヤー。放棄された水中研究所から、雇い主の失敗した実験の痕跡を消去しなければならない。潜水艦を操縦し、深淵の恐ろしいものを避けつつ、全ての死体を排除しよう。
items.title: Murky Divers

items.description: Pic-Me! is a card game about deception, where players use wonderous images to spark creativity and imagination. Each round becomes an intricate mindgame against the other players at the table. Will you be able to outsmart your friends or will you be tricked by them? 4-8 players only.
items.description_ja: Pic-Meは騙しのゲームで、プレイヤーは素晴らしい絵を使って創造性や想像力を存分に発揮することができます。一つひとつのラウンドが他のプレイヤーたちとの繊細な知略の争いとなります。友達に頭脳で打ち勝つことができるでしょうか。それとも友達に騙されてしまうでしょうか。
items.title: Pic-Me!

items.description: Explore a world without your eyes and ears to guide you.  Uncover the secrets this world has to offer, hoard all the items you can find or get lost trying.
items.description_ja: Explore a world without your eyes and ears to guide you.  Uncover the secrets this world has to offer, hoard all the items you can find or get lost trying.

items.description_ja: Serious Sam Classic: The Second Encounter is a high-adrenaline single-play and 16-player co-operative arcade-action FPS and Gamespot's Game of the Month February 2002!

items.description_ja: Bear With Me is an episodic noir adventure game. Amber is trying to find her missing brother while being aided by her trusty teddy, Ted E. Bear.
items.title: Bear With Me - Episode One

items.description: Weed Shop 2 is a first person recreational Marijuana dispensary simulator where you'll get to grow the hottest strains, expand your business, hire employees and much more!
items.description_ja: Weed Shop 2 is a first person recreational Marijuana dispensary simulator where you'll get to grow the hottest strains, expand your business, hire employees and much more!
items.title: Weed Shop 2

items.description: Shark Simulator is a WTF physics sandbox. Play as Ed the shark, and give those tourists a vacation they will remember!
items.description_ja: Shark Simulator is a WTF physics sandbox. Play as Ed the shark, and give those tourists a vacation they will remember!
items.title: Shark Simulator

items.description: Wintermoor Tactics Club is a story about surviving high school, with gameplay inspired by tactics RPGs and visual novels.
items.description_ja: Wintermoor Tactics Club is a story about surviving high school, with gameplay inspired by tactics RPGs and visual novels.
items.title: Wintermoor Tactics Club

items.description: Moving Out is a ridiculous physics-based moving simulator that brings new meaning to "couch co-op"! Are you ready for an exciting career in furniture? As a newly certified Furniture Arrangement & Relocation Technician, you’ll take on moving jobs all across the busy town of Packmore.
items.description_ja: Moving Outは物理学に基づいた、おかしな引っ越しシミュレーターだ！ソファで協力プレイ？違う、協力プレイでソファを運べ！家具を扱う楽しいお仕事はいかがかな？認定されたての家具配置&移動の専門家として、忙しい町Packmoreでの引っ越し案件をたくさん引き受けよう。
items.title: Moving Out

items.description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Enter the world of steam and sugar and become a master chocolatier in Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue. Craft gourmet chocolate for your customers in your steampunk workshop with the help of Nougat.
items.description_ja: プロローグは、ゲームの完全版であなたを待っているゲームプレイの一部にすぎません。 Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologueで、蒸気や砂糖がいっぱいの世界に飛び込み、マスターショコラティエとなりましょう。スチームパンクの工房で、ロボット助手ヌガーの助けを借り、お客が喜ぶグルメチョコを作りましょう。
items.title: Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue

items.description: You're the world's softest criminals in an island prison with mandatory nap rooms. Your escape plan? Eat bread, poop until the gates open, and pee on the robots chasing you. Break out with three friends, or play the robots tucking them back in. A wacky 4v2 prison break in quick 10-minute matches.
items.description_ja: 【Ver.2.0大型アップデート配信中！】かわいい見た目で超カオス！動物と看守ロボットに分かれて戦う4対2の非対称アクションパーティーゲーム。新ステージ3つ、新キャラクター4体、一発逆転のスペシャルアイテムが登場！動物は「うんぴ」や「おぴっこ」、個性豊かなスキルを駆使して脱獄！ロボットはカスタマイズしたパーツとガジェットで捕まえよう！シンプル操作で誰でも楽しめて、極めるほどに笑える――世界初(!?)の排泄型脱出アクションパーティーゲーム、さらに進化！
items.title: PRITTO PRISONER

items.description: ECCHI / EROTIC (Single route/linear) Visual Novel about a bizarre GIANT WOMAN. Discover all the mysteries behind her and enjoy her company, if you can.
items.description_ja: ECCHI / EROTIC (Single route/linear) Visual Novel about a bizarre GIANT WOMAN. Discover all the mysteries behind her and enjoy her company, if you can.
items.title: Beneath Her Gaze

items.description: An online 1-6 player co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends share one bank account and one massive debt. Gamble, buy sketchy items, make terrible decisions, and climb an ominous casino tower to hit your loan shark’s daily quota in 5 minutes - or face the consequences.
items.description_ja: 最大6人の仲間と、銀行口座と莫大な借金を共有しながらギャンブルに挑む、オンライン協力型「カジノクローラー」。怪しげなアイテムを買い、最悪の選択を重ね、不吉なカジノタワーを登れ。5分以内に課されたノルマを達成しなければ――そのツケを払うことになる。
items.title: Gamble With Your Friends

items.description:
My Voice Zoo is a unique idle zoo game brought to life with your own voice.
Record your sounds through the microphone and turn them into animal calls, creating a one-of-a-kind zoo found nowhere else.
Start building your very own zoo, complete only with your voice!
items.description_ja:
My Voice Zoo は、あなたの声で完成する放置型動物園ゲームです。
マイクで録音した声が動物たちの鳴き声になり、
世界にひとつだけの動物園を作り上げましょう！
items.title: MyVoiceZoo

items.description: Horror game where you need to do different tasks from horror creature received by your phone. And remember: Don't chat with MOMO!
items.description_ja: このゲームでは、化け物からあなたの携帯に送られてくる様々な仕事をしなければなりません。それと、覚えておくこと。MOMOとチャットをしないこと。
items.title: MOMO.EXE

items.description: Rubber Bandits is a criminally fun multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. With 8 action-packed game modes, players steal, brawl, and dash to the finish line with the most loot to win!
items.description_ja: 「Rubber Bandits」は、最大4人で遊べるマルチプレイ・怪盗パーティゲームだ！アクション性の高い3つのゲームモードで、乱闘を交わしながらフィニッシュラインを超えろ！一番多くお宝を盗み出しずらかったワルが勝利となるぞ。
items.title: Rubber Bandits

items.description: A legend returns! The beloved classic Swords and Sandals 3 is back, re-forged in glory! Step back into the Gladiae Ultratus once more and prepare to take on the greatest gladiators in all Brandor. It's the hardest, most metal gladiator game ever made.
items.description_ja: A legend returns! The beloved classic Swords and Sandals 3 is back, re-forged in glory! Step back into the Gladiae Ultratus once more and prepare to take on the greatest gladiators in all Brandor. It's the hardest, most metal gladiator game ever made.
items.title: Swords and Sandals 3 Redux

items.description: Play solo or with up to 16 friends in a chaotic grocery store showdown! Manage, grow, and compete against rival stores in a fun, lighthearted battle of wits and strategy. Who will be the ultimate grocery tycoon? Sabotage, upgrade, and outwit your friends in this unpredictable simulator!
items.description_ja: ソロまたは最大16人の友達と一緒に、混乱したスーパーマーケットの対決を楽しもう！管理、成長、そしてライバル店舗と競い合う、ユーモアと戦略が詰まった楽しいバトル。誰が究極のスーパー大富豪になるのか？妨害、アップグレード、そして友達を出し抜こう！予測不可能なこのシミュレーターで勝利を掴もう！
items.title: Store Wars: Multiplayer Shop Simulator

items.description: Door Game Deluxe is a (very) short, satirical RPG. An expansion of the original and the pinnacle of human artistic expression, this version offers original art and music on top of new endings.
items.description_ja: Door Game Deluxe is a (very) short, satirical RPG. An expansion of the original and the pinnacle of human artistic expression, this version offers original art and music on top of new endings.

items.description_ja: A visual novel about a memory that a boy named Mark tries very hard to forget, and a girl named Myra who unearths it.

items.description_ja:
Crazy fun rocket simulator game with countryballs theme.

items.description_ja: BOXING SCHOOL! Take control of a boxing gym in the 80s. You’ll hire the boxers, teach them to fight and climb the ranks. Management game made by the developers of Gladiator School.

items.description: A co-op group climbing game for 1-8 friends! Head out on a chill but challenging climb with regular checkpoints. Use axes, ropes, pogo sticks, item delivery drones and more to reach the summit. Just remember to watch your step!
items.description_ja: 1～8人で遊べる協力型グループクライミングゲーム！定期的にチェックポイントが設置された、まったりながらも険しいクライミングに挑戦。斧やロープ、ホッピングステッキ、アイテム配達ドローンなどを駆使して頂上を目指せ。くれぐれも足元には注意！

items.description:
A semi-idle dice clicker where the odds rarely favor you. 
Risky offers, mysterious phone calls, unexpected debts.
What are you willing to sacrifice to land nine sixes in a row?
items.description_ja:
運はほとんど味方してくれない、半放置型ダイスクリックゲーム。
危険な取引、謎の電話、突然降ってくる借金。
9回連続で「6」を出すために、あなたは何を失う覚悟がありますか？
items.title: One More 6ix

items.description_ja: ダイナミックなスペルクラフトシステムで自分だけの魔法を作り、組み合わせる一人称視点のアクション・ファンタジーRPG。敵対する王国で戦い、イベントを妨害し、魔力を高め、最終的に王を討ち倒そう。
items.title: SpellChain

items.description:
Trick or treating in a vampire's house.
Trick & Treat is a light-hearted Halloween adventure. It's about exploring and solving puzzles in a spooky atmosphere. There will be some horror elements, romance, many bad ends and a happy ending of true love.
items.description_ja:
ハロウィーンの夜、吸血鬼のお家にキャンディを貰いに行くという、小さな謎解きゲーム。
ホラー要素、ロマンス、たくさんのバッドエンドと真実の愛のハッピーエンドが含まれます。
items.title: Trick & Treat

items.description: Live your wildest dreams by splurging on insane amounts of cash you wouldn't have in real life. Play for random number generated loot that is a reflection of the meaningless nature of this game and everything surrounding it.
items.description_ja: Live your wildest dreams by splurging on insane amounts of cash you wouldn't have in real life. Play for random number generated loot that is a reflection of the meaningless nature of this game and everything surrounding it.

items.description_ja: As an Ethereal Estate agent, your job is to make a mess out of a mansion and its helpless inhabitants. Never before has a ghost unleashed such devastating chaos... until now!

items.description: A 4-player co-op horror comedy where you drop in as couriers delivering packages in a dystopian world ruled by grotesque monsters. You share 99 lives - deliver, don’t die, and make it count!
items.description_ja: 最大4人でプレイ可能な協力型ホラーコメディ。異形のモンスターが支配するディストピアで、配達員として荷物を届けろ。共有される命は99。荷物を届け、死を回避し、その命を無駄にするな！
items.title: Panic Delivery

items.description: Can Luna navigate this funky world to find Halloween? - Talk to strange and compelling characters! Freeze obstacles and activate the fast Chili Pepper Mode, but beware - it also makes you uncontrollably jumpy!
items.description_ja: Can Luna navigate this funky world to find Halloween? - Talk to strange and compelling characters! Freeze obstacles and activate the fast Chili Pepper Mode, but beware - it also makes you uncontrollably jumpy!
items.title: Funky Panic Attack

items.description:
No matter how long you’re gone, there will always be a girl waiting for you in the same place.
This is a story about forgetting, and about waiting.

After countless restarts and countless memories lost…
how long will you stay with her this time?
items.description_ja:
どれだけ長い時間、あなたが離れていても、
少女はいつも同じ場所であなたを待ち続ける。
これは、忘却と待ち続ける想いの物語。

幾度となく繰り返されるやり直しと喪失。
今度こそ――あなたは彼女のそばに、どれほどいてあげられるだろうか。
items.title: Denpa Nightmares

items.description: Gun Done - it's a timekiller arcade game about brave heroes
items.description_ja: Gun Done - it's a timekiller arcade game about brave heroes
items.title: Gun Done

items.description:
The creators of Crossy Road present Shooty Skies! 
Shoot, dodge, duck, goose and weave. 
Take to the skies!
items.description_ja:
「クロッシーロード」の製作者が贈る新作「シューティースカイズ」登場！ 
攻撃・回避・突撃・旋回を楽しもう！ 
大空に舞い上がれ！
items.title: Shooty Skies

items.description: You are a guard whose job is to post bounties. Try your best to deal with various matters and make money to raise your family. But remember, when various factions come to you, you will have to make choices!
items.description_ja: You are a guard whose job is to post bounties. Try your best to deal with various matters and make money to raise your family. But remember, when various factions come to you, you will have to make choices!

items.description_ja: Heavy headed blocky guys sumo wrestle and tumble around.

items.description: It's Christmas time! The Santa's Icy Realm is in full steam!! Join the fun and search for all the Hidden Cats one by one among the elves to reveal the final colored art. More than 970 hidden objects! This time with an extra bonus level, SNOWBALL FIGHT!
items.description_ja: クリスマスがやってきた！サンタさんが住む氷の世界はフル稼働！エルフたちと一緒に隠れたネコを1匹ずつ見つけて、最後に色のついた絵を明らかにしよう。隠されたオブジェクトは970個以上！追加のボーナスステージ、雪合戦も登場！

items.description: A great game about a Great man!
items.description_ja: A great game about a Great man!

items.description_ja: Draw your robot, play as your drawing! Face your friends in Scribble Bots, a 2D, physics based sandbox party game. Will your robot be a mechanical masterpiece, or a dysfunctional abomination?

items.title: Wink Out

items.description: ♂ Unique Furry Horror with Muscular Mister Furries, Deep Plot, Great Sound Effects and Creepy Atmosphere of Furry Dungeon. Hot Milk, Dungeon Items, Gym, Gay-Bar, Pool, Locker Room, Atmospheric Music and much more! Will you be able to escape punishment from Mister Furry? ♂
items.description_ja: 筋肉質のミスター・ファーリー、深い陰謀、毛皮のようなダンジョンの不気味な雰囲気を備えたユニークな毛皮の恐怖。ホットミルク、ジム、ゲイバーなど！ミスター・ファーリーからの罰を逃れることができますか？
items.title: Mister Furry: Hot Muscles

items.description: The world needs you Adventurer! Embark on an RPG pixel adventure where you’ll play as Baelin the humble fisherman, who must rise-up to become the hero of Honeywood. Battle fish with precision timing and magic spells, upgrade your abilities, defeat evil and rebuild Honeywood.
items.description_ja: 世界は冒険者を必要としている！ ハニーウッドの英雄として立ち上がるため、しがない漁師のベイリンとなってRPGピクセルアドベンチャーへ出発しよう。正確なタイミングと魔法で魚と戦い、能力を強化し、悪を倒してハニーウッドを再建するのだ！

items.description: Be My Horde is a roguelite survivor where your minions fight for you. Become a formidable necromancer and turn your enemies into a resource! Raise fallen foes, build massive undead hordes, enhance your skills with devoured souls, and conquer the world – you’re the villain in this story.
items.description_ja: しもべに戦わせるローグライトサバイバル、『Be My Horde』。恐ろしいネクロマンサーとなって、敵をリソースに変えるのだ！死んだ敵を蘇らせて強大な不死の軍団を作り上げ、魂喰いの力を強化し、この世界を支配せよ。君はこの物語のヴィランなのだから！

items.description_ja: A fast-paced action platformer doubling as the most realistic chair simulator money can buy! Have you ever wondered what your chair thinks? What it believes? What it desires? Learn the answers and destroy some dimensions along the way!

items.description_ja: You've almost died, you lost your body. Gladly, you were saved by your old friend Xena, a genius engineer who lives on a desolate planet. Now it's time to recover and find a new goal in your life!

items.description_ja: Return to the soccer field with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Soccer 1998 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids. Kick, pass, and score in this classic game that made soccer fun for everyone!

items.description_ja: 霧の町グリムショアで自分のホットドッグ店を経営しよう。昼は調理と接客、夜は肉不足の解決に奔走し、あまり多くを詮索しないように。グリルの火を絶やさないために、あなたはどこまでやれる？

items.description: Simplistic top-down shooter that will put a smile on your face. Fulfill your inner sociopath as you mow down enemies with guns and cars alike, in a bid to pull off the world's largest heist!
items.description_ja: State of Anarchyは無心に敵を屠る楽しさが味わえる、シンプルなトップダウン視点のシューターゲーム！
items.title: State of Anarchy

items.description: 『Who's Next?』  is a free-for-all Tail Tag social deduction game set in the traditional Korean hell, featuring a massacre of ghosts and spirits, with individual survival competition rather than team battles,.
items.description_ja: 『Who's Next?』 は個人戦のソーシャルディダクションゲームです。卑劣な手を使って最後まで生き残り、転生を手に入れるのです！ ここでは過程はどうでもいいんです。生き残ったら勝です。全プレイヤーは狙う向きで円を描くように繋がっています。順番に全ての獲物を殺し、最後の一人になれば勝利です！
items.title: Who's Next?

items.description: Join your favorite YouTubers on an Epic Quest in PewDiePie: Legend of the Brofist.
items.description_ja:
PewDiePie: Legend of the Brofist. エピックなクエストでお気に入りのユーチューバーに会おう！
この超面白い2Dのプラットフォーマーをハンディーに楽しもう！
items.title: PewDiePie: Legend of the Brofist

items.description: A cozy online multiplayer sandbox where you live as a customizable penguin. Slide, fish, swim underwater, decorate your home, complete quests, and hang out with friends in a snowy world full of minigames and social fun.
items.description_ja: Un sandbox multijugador online acogedor en el que vives la vida de un pingüino, totalmente personalizable. Deslízate por el hielo, pesca, nada bajo el agua, decora tu hogar, completa misiones y disfruta con amigos en un mundo nevado lleno de minijuegos.
items.title: A Game About Penguins

items.description: Survive an endless horde of Boykissers. Hold out as long as you can and make it onto the leaderboard.
items.description_ja: Survive an endless horde of Boykissers. Hold out as long as you can and make it onto the leaderboard.
items.title: BONK THE BOYKISSER

items.description: Phobies is a tactical card collecting strategy game where players battle one another in the surreal realm of the subconscious, where fears manifest. Use devious tactics and unleash a dazzling array of attacks and abilities to achieve victory!
items.description_ja: 『フォビーズ：PVP戦略バトル』は、戦略的なカード収集ゲームです。プレイヤーは潜在意識の中に広がる幻想的な世界で、恐怖が具現化する中で戦いを繰り広げます。巧妙な戦術を駆使し、多彩な攻撃や能力を解き放ち、勝利をつかみ取りましょう！
items.title: Phobies

items.description:
Lovely find hidden items game!
Investigate strange hidden objects to prevent nyambaba's illusion from succeeding.
Please find all hidden points within the time, otherwise the villain nyanbaba will jump out and frighten the players with a very cute Chinese voice!
items.description_ja:
これはとても恐ろしい(かわいい?)アイテムの種類を隠すクリックゲームを探しています!

様々なスタイルのシーンで不審な隠し物を調べ、ニャンコ覇の幻術を強がらせない。

隠しポイントは論理的に合わないものやおかしいもの、古霊精怪の大きな怪獣(かわいい?)かもしれません。

時間内にすべての隠し点を見つけてください。そうしないと、大反派のニャンコ覇が飛び出して、とても怖い(甘えん坊)中国語の音声でプレイヤーを脅かします。
items.title: 怕不怕趴喵霸霸 Ghost Party Nyanbaba

items.description:
A non-linear first-person action adventure in a pirate setting. A single player time travel simulation game. Unusual gaming experience.
Moving in space and time, the player must understand what is happening on the island and how the main character can move away from there.
items.description_ja: 一人称視点の海賊設定の非線形アクションアドベンチャー。一人プレイヤー向けの時間旅行シミュレーションゲーム。探索し、理解し、脱出を試みるユニークなゲーム体験。
items.title: Timeloop: Sink Again Beach

items.description:
Time to fight back against the spirits!
Play as an exorcist with firearms and purge unlawful spirits to solve the mystery of the Saiga village invasion in Nara!
items.description_ja:
幽霊に思いっきりやり返せるホラーゲーム登場！
公認除霊師として違法幽霊を銃火器で駆逐しながら、
悪霊に占拠された集落、奈良県賽河村の謎を追え！
items.title: 近畿霊務局 - Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau

items.description: An online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.
items.description_ja: 最大3人でオンライン協力プレイを楽しめる、探偵ホラーゲーム。ランダムに生成されたシフトで力を合わせて客を調査し、誰が人間になりすましているかを突き止めよう。一つでもミスをすれば、建物に立てこもって罠を仕掛け、身を隠さなければならない。
items.title: Shift At Midnight

items.description: A simple tower defense game where you need to protect your house from Boykissers
items.description_ja: A simple tower defense game where you need to protect your house from Boykissers
items.title: BOYKISSER IS COMING

items.description: In this puzzle game combining action and stealth, your memory will be your best tool! Remember the location of the lasers, they disappear as soon as you move. Avoid deadly lasers with style, steal from the richest and save your cat 🐱 Prepare for a MEMORABLE heist
items.description_ja: In this puzzle game combining action and stealth, your memory will be your best tool! Remember the location of the lasers, they disappear as soon as you move. Avoid deadly lasers with style, steal from the richest and save your cat 🐱 Prepare for a MEMORABLE heist

items.description: "Mayhemers" is a multiplayer chaos creation game for up to 8 players with a procedurally generated map. Choose your side: Will you be a Mayhemer or a Guardian? Mayhemers' task is to create chaos. Guardians' task is to stop them.
items.description_ja: Mayhemers は、最大8人のプレイヤーがプロシージャルに生成されたマップで混乱を作り出すマルチプレイヤーゲームです。あなたはどちらの側を選びますか？混沌なかガーディアンか？混沌なの任務は混乱を作り出すことです。ガーディアンの任務はそれを阻止することです。

items.description: Turnip Mountain is a physics-based climbing adventure in which you control each hand independently using two mice or two analogue sticks. Grab, swing and launch yourself to the summit your own way.
items.description_ja: この両スティック操作のクライミングプラットフォーマーで、自分だけの道を切り開きながら、手を伸ばし、揺れ、舞い上がってTurnip Mountainの頂上を目指そう!

items.description_ja: 『モンスターミール』は、フードトラックでモンスターシェフを操作し、珍しい生き物を調理してモンスター客に提供するスピーディーなクッキングゲーム。ソロプレイ、ローカル協力プレイ、オンライン協力プレイに対応。でも急いで提供しないと、君が食材にされるかも!?

items.description_ja: BOMJMAN is a hardcore indie shooter, based on the author’s cartoon of the same name, about a hobo-superhero, who punishes evil in the futuristic city, ridden with crime. Evil must be defeated but our hero must answer one question – what for?

items.description_ja: Smithworks is a first-person 3D cooperative multiplayer game where players play as fledgling blacksmiths. It is a humorous and chaotic experience where players will need to communicate effectively in order to craft these weapons quickly before the customers get angry.

items.description: Control your hands and destroy friendships in this physics-based couch/online fighting game. Use your elastic arms to swing, slingshot, and parkour around the highly dynamic maps. Wield powerful weapons or use your bare fists to bonk your opponents!
items.description_ja: 物理ベースのオフライン/オンライン格闘ゲームで、両手をコントロールし、友情を破壊しましょう。伸縮自在の腕を使って、ぶら下がり、パチンコみたいに飛び、パルクールして、最高にダイナミックなマップを駆け回ることができます。強力な武器を振り回したり、拳を使ったりして対戦相手をやっつけましょう！

Delve into the diverse world of horror movies in this 2D action puzzler. 
Nothing can prepare you for the R-rated challenges you will face!

items.description_ja: 素早く学べるが挑戦しがいのあるリアルタイム戦略ゲーム。宇宙虫の軍隊を生み出し、彼らは自律的に行動します。

A super exhilarating Metroidvania action game!!

メトロイドヴァニア型 超爽快アクションゲーム！！

items.description: Maiden Cops is a Beat'em Up full of classic, arcade-style action and ass kicking. Choose among the gorgeous Maiden Cops policewomen, tackle crime in Maiden City and enjoy premium-level pixel art and a breathtaking soundtrack.
items.description_ja: 『Maiden Cops』は、クラシックなアーケードスタイルのアクションと強烈なパンチが満載の格闘アクションゲームです。ゴージャスな女性警官《メイデンコップ》のチームから1人を選び、メイデンシティで犯罪に立ち向かい、プレミアムレベルのピクセルアートや息を呑むようなサウンドトラックをお楽しみください。
items.title: Maiden Cops

items.description: Tired of political exploitation? Join me and let's rebuild our thieving business together! Let's steal cars, radios, and TVs - anything that catches your eye can be yours!  Recall what it's like to be a thief in Thief Simulator 2: Prologue!
items.description_ja: Tired of political exploitation? Join me and let's rebuild our thieving business together! Let's steal cars, radios, and TVs - anything that catches your eye can be yours!  Recall what it's like to be a thief in Thief Simulator 2: Prologue!

items.description_ja: Over 9000 Zombies! is top-down arcade action blown out of all reasonable proportions. An endless horde of zombies is coming your way, how long can you survive?

items.description:
Ancient Planet is classic tower defense game. The stronghold of an ancient civilization has been invaded by hordes of alien raiders.
Use powerful technologies of the Ancient and repel the attack of the enemy's armies!
items.description_ja: エンシェントプラネットはクラシックスタイルのタワーディフェンスゲームです。古代文明の拠点がエイリアンの群れによって侵略されました。強力な古代技術を使用し、敵の軍勢を撃退してください！
items.title: Ancient Planet Tower Defense

items.description: Loser Named Hana is a friendship-building visual novel. You respond to an ad advertising $100 a week to be the lonely college student, Hana, friend.
items.description_ja: Loser Named Hana is a friendship-building visual novel. You respond to an ad advertising $100 a week to be the lonely college student, Hana, friend.

items.description: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!
items.description_ja: ポルカを探す小さな冒険。旅のなかで出会う困っている人を助け、ともだちになろう。ともだちは、きっとあなたを助けてくれる。
items.title: Finding Polka

items.description: The long-awaited draft notice has arrived, and besides the window, you have only one way out - to RUN. The main thing is to get out of the apartment before the draft notice page fully loads.
items.description_ja: 待ちに待った徴集通知が届き、窓以外には逃げる唯一の方法があります - 逃げること。重要なのは、徴集の告知ページが完全に読み込まれる前にアパートを出ることです。
items.title: Escape from Grustovia

items.description:
Dusty Derby is a large online multiplayer party royal game with 32 players. 
Cute Dusts Compete to be King of Dusts in various places in the house!
items.description_ja:
ダスティーダービーは、32人という大規模のマルチプレイヤー・パーティー・ロイヤルゲームです。
家の中のいろんな場所で、可愛いホコリの王になるために競争しましょう！
items.title: Dusty Derby

items.description: Play with the most celebrated flying cat in human history. Drink milk, eat ice-cream, collect coins, buy gorgeous boosts, fly like a superhero (sorry... supercat), jump onto platforms made of cake, avoid angry dogs, and discover the infinite space. And that's not all, you can choose from multiple game modes, where you can play with Nyan Cat's evil foe Tac Nayn, learn to fly on different planets with Nyan Wings or visit parallel universes. If you're tired, you can even train and feed your own Nyanagotchi. Oh, and last but not least: you can enjoy the wonderful Nyan-song as many times as you want! All this funky stuff can't be missed.
items.description_ja: Play with the most celebrated flying cat in human history. "I Have an Item" is a multiplayer game with a set of different game modes about risk, reward, and item manipulation.
This IS NOT about getting the most loot — it's about SURVIVAL.

「I Have an Item」は、リスク、報酬、アイテム操作をテーマにした様々なゲームモードを備えたマルチプレイヤーゲームです。
これは、最も多くの戦利品を手に入れることが目的ではありません。生き残ることが目的なのです。

items.description: Kiosk is a horror cooking game where you prepare orders for late-night customers who visit your cozy, rain-soaked kiosk. The eerie atmosphere clashes with the mounting tension as you serve your mysterious visitors.
items.description_ja: 『Kiosk』は、雨に濡れた居心地の良いキオスクで深夜に訪れるお客様の注文を調理・提供するホラークッキングゲームです。不気味な雰囲気と緊張感が高まる中、謎めいた訪問者たちに応対します。
items.title: Kiosk

items.description: Brick Breaker Maker is a rich, element-based Arkanoid game in which you need to flexibly control the baffle to bounce the ball and break the bricks to win. The game provides  level editor that can be shared in the workshop to interact with other players, which is full of fun and competition.
items.description_ja: Brick Breaker Makerは、ボールを弾き返してレンガを壊し、勝利を収めるためにバッフルを柔軟に制御する必要がある、要素ベースの豊富なアルカノイドゲームです。このゲームには、他のプレーヤーと交流できるワークショップで共有可能なレベルエディターが用意されており、楽しみと競争に満ちています。
items.title: Brick Breaker Maker

items.description: The greatest rock-racing, tower defense, art history game is back! Like the title says, Bigger & Boulder cranks up the surrealism and gameplay with chaotic 4P multiplayer, new time periods, and improved graphics, physics, and destructibility powered by UE4 to be, well… BIGGER AND BOULDER.
items.description_ja: Developed by ACE Team, the greatest rock-racing, tower defense, art history game is back! Bigger and Boulder cranks up the surrealism and gameplay with chaotic 2-vs-2 multiplayer, new time periods, and improved graphics, physics, and destructibility powered by UE4 to be BIGGER AND BOULDER.
items.title: Rock of Ages 2: Bigger & Boulder™

items.description: 360 No Scope Arena is an online multiplayer shooter with a twist: you have to spin around before you can shoot your gun.  Every kill is a "360 No Scope" in this arena.  Every shot is a trick shot. This game rewards pure aiming skill above all else.
items.description_ja: 360 No Scope Arena is an online multiplayer shooter with a twist: you have to spin around before you can shoot your gun.  Every kill is a "360 No Scope" in this arena.  Every shot is a trick shot. This game rewards pure aiming skill above all else.

items.description:
A cozy puzzler with story. 
Recreate paintings by applying lines & colors in a specific order. Explore beautiful mazes & collect letters of a poem. Help two sweethearts find a path towards each other. 
Three games in one. Hints when stuck. 160+ paintings, 3~4 hours, set to a chill soundtrack.
items.description_ja: もしあなたが作品に手を触れてもいいとしたら？禅の要素を持つパズルのようでもあり、物語のようでもあるこのゲームは、160以上のパズルを通して現在に受け継がれた抽象画に隠された世界の秘密を探求することができます。心地のよい、ジャジーなサウンドトラックを聴きながら、モダンアートの起源を探る旅に出かけましょう。
items.title: Please, Touch The Artwork

items.description: A different game every 10 seconds! Collect marbles and spend them in a pachinko machine to unlock new minigames, skins and music.
items.description_ja: 10秒ごとにゲームが変わる！
items.title: pureya

items.description: Design, maintain and manage a hi-tech hospital facility, making the most of limited resources and turning cures into cash. Can you balance the books and the bedpans?
items.description_ja: ハイテク病院施設を設計、維持、管理し、限られた資源を最大限に活用し、治療を現金に変えましょう。収支のやりくりと便器の世話、両方こなせますか？
items.title: Theme Hospital™

items.description: 🐸👑 Jump, climb, push others with your tongue, and reach the top to win the princess’s kiss! 🏰 (Up to 8 Players)
items.description_ja: 🐸👑 ジャンプして、登って、舌を出して、頂上を目指してプリンセスのキスをゲット！🏰 (最大8人プレイ)
items.title: Frog Jump

items.description: DAWG GAME is a comedy adventure about what Maksim does off-stream. Step into the life of a streamer: handle important tasks, take care of yourself, and try to finally go live!
items.description_ja: DAWG GAME is a comedy adventure about what Maksim does off-stream. Step into the life of a streamer: handle important tasks, take care of yourself, and try to finally go live!
items.title: Dawg Game

items.description: A fast-paced online arena FPS with jetpacks, hang gliders, fast respawns, 6-minute rounds and instant matches
items.description_ja: ジェットパック、ハンググライダー、速いリスポーン、6分間のラウンド、そしてインスタントマッチを持つ、高速ペースのオンラインアリーナFPS。
items.title: Paint Warfare

items.description: Mean Beans is a FREE Battle Royale FPS where being the last bean alive isn't the only way to win! Play multiple rounds and collect points by not only being the last player standing, but killing other players as well! The bean with the most points at the end wins!
items.description_ja: Mean Beans is a FREE Battle Royale FPS where being the last bean alive isn't the only way to win! Play multiple rounds and collect points by not only being the last player standing, but killing other players as well! The bean with the most points at the end wins!
items.title: Mean Beans

items.description: Pursue diamond thieves and a trail of cryptic puzzles in this short ‘60s spy adventure. As Agent Epsilon you’ll choose your path as you chat with (or chat up!) suspicious contacts. Deduce the puzzle rules, decode cryptograms and decipher clues as you solve wordplay & logic puzzles across the globe!
items.description_ja: Pursue diamond thieves and a trail of cryptic puzzles in this short ‘60s spy adventure. As Agent Epsilon you’ll choose your path as you chat with (or chat up!) suspicious contacts. Deduce the puzzle rules, decode cryptograms and decipher clues as you solve wordplay & logic puzzles across the globe!
items.title: Puzzle Spy International

items.description: STICKER/BALL is a pool game roguelike from the future. Fire balls. Hit dice. Earn points. Add stickers. Trigger crazy combos. Enjoy the chaos, it’s on purpose.
items.description_ja: 「ステッカー/ボール」は、未来からやってきたビリヤード風ローグライクゲーム。ボールを放ち、ダイスに当て、ポイントを稼ぎ、ステッカーを追加し、ド派手なコンボを決めよう。そして、意図的に仕組まれたカオスを楽しもう。
items.title: STICKER/BALL

items.description: Bounce, blast, and out-magic your friends! Control a bubble-riding wizzo in this chaotic 4-player top-down arena shooter. Combine spells on the fly, unleash high-knockback combos, and launch your rivals off the map in fast-paced couch and online battles.
items.description_ja: 跳ねて、ぶっ放して、魔法で友達を圧倒しろ！バブルに乗ったWizzoを操る、4人対戦カオスアリーナシューター。バトル中に呪文を組み合わせ、強烈なノックバックコンボでライバルをマップ外へ吹き飛ばせ！ローカル＆オンラインで大暴れしよう！
items.title: Wizzo PopOut

items.description: You are a Delivery Agent. Your goal is to deliver packages  save & sound to our bases, taking care of our people's needs. Dont' worry, you'll be awarded accordingly.
items.description_ja: あなたは配送業者です。 あなたの目標は、私たちの人々のニーズに配慮しながら、パッケージを保存して健全なベースに届けることです。 心配しないでください、それに応じて授与されます。
items.title: ANIME STANDING

items.description: Dive into a fantastical autobattler where fairytales and legends collide! Choose your hero and assemble your team of characters, items and treasures to outwit opponents in strategic battles where positioning matters. Will you be the last one standing in this enchanted PvP arena?
items.description_ja: ファンタジー溢れるオートバトラーに飛び込もう！童話と伝説がぶつかる世界で、ヒーローを選んでキャラクター、アイテム、宝物を組み合わせ、戦略的に相手を出smartしてバトルで勝利をつかめ。最後に立っているのはあなたかな？この魔法のPvPアリーナで！
items.title: Fairytale Fables

items.description: ITS VALENTINES SEASON AND EVERYONE'S FACES GOT BLOWN OFF!
items.description_ja: ITS VALENTINES SEASON AND EVERYONE'S FACES GOT BLOWN OFF!
items.title: FACE LOVE: Face Designer

items.description: A magic-themed co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends are minions summoned by a wizard to break into their rival's towers to cause mayhem. Try to fufill your vandalism target with an assortment of spells while avoiding magical beasts and monsters that protect the tower.
items.description_ja: YapYapとは、魔導師となり、ライバルの塔を荒らすために最大5人の友だちを手下として召喚する魔法協力型ホラーゲームだ。様々な呪文を唱え、塔を守る魔獣やモンスターを避けつつ破壊目標を達成せよ。
items.title: YAPYAP

items.description: Dive into a sunny beach in this cozy hidden object game! Rotate the endless scene, watch funny elves go about their day, and find over 130 hidden objects to the soothing beats of a lo-fi soundtrack. The perfect way to unwind and relax!
items.description_ja: 居心地よい隠しアイテム探しゲームで、陽光あふれるビーチへ飛び込もう！エンドレスに回転するシーンを眺め、愉快なエルフたちの日常を見守りながら、130以上の隠されたアイテムをlo-fiサウンドトラックに癒されつつ探し出そう。のんびりくつろぐのにぴったりのゲームです！
items.title: Hidden Things Beach Elves

items.description: Get ready to have your intellect enriched, your emotions manipulated and your mayonnaise expanded; as you unveil the stories and learn from mistakes. Our lives are too short not to be enhanced with meaningful stories like this one!
items.description_ja: Get ready to have your intellect enriched, your emotions manipulated and your mayonnaise expanded; as you unveil the stories and learn from mistakes. Our lives are too short not to be enhanced with meaningful stories like this one!
items.title: My Name is Mayo 3

items.description: Get ready to massacre monsters, race your rivals, and combat corpses of your fellow guards as you race to escape Black Iron Prison in the critically acclaimed roguelike, [REDACTED].
items.description_ja: モンスターとの乱戦。ライバルとのレース。そして同僚の遺体と戦う覚悟は出来たか。ブラックアイアン刑務所からの逃走経路を奪い合う、絶大なる支持を受けたローグライクゲーム、 [REDACTED]に参加せよ。
items.title: [REDACTED]

items.description: An interactive anime story! Save a beloved local sushi bar from dastardly landsharks, get distracted in countless mini games and make unforgettable friends in this larger-than-life narrative adventure. Written by Moa (Hatoful Boyfriend) and featuring a fully voiced cast!
items.description_ja: インタラクティブなアニメ物語！ 悪徳地上げ屋から愛される寿司屋を守り、数え切れないミニゲームに寄り道し、忘れられない友だちに出会う——スケール大のナラティブアドベンチャー。Moa（Hatoful Boyfriend）脚本、フルボイス対応！
items.title: Sushi Ben

items.description: Build and run your own waterpark solo or with friends. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!
items.description_ja: Build and run your own waterpark solo or with friends. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!
items.title: Waterpark Simulator

items.description: The (mis)adventures of Vinty, a nobody who thinks she's somebody!
items.description_ja: The (mis)adventures of Vinty, a nobody who thinks she's somebody!
items.title: Without Within

items.description: Wealthy, handsome, and... dead? Samuel strikes a deal with Death for one last shot at life, but only if he can survive a day doing everything manually. Blink, breathe, walk, and work - Guide Sam in this darkly humorous and brutally difficult adventure!
items.description_ja: Wealthy, handsome, and... dead? Samuel strikes a deal with Death for one last shot at life, but only if he can survive a day doing everything manually. Blink, breathe, walk, and work - Guide Sam in this darkly humorous and brutally difficult adventure!
items.title: Manual Samuel - Last Tuesday Edition

items.description: JJBoom is a pixel platformer for 2–4 players (local/online). Use gamepad or keyboard! 16+ free levels with spikes, traps—and your kids—to keep you on your toes!
items.description_ja: A party game that makes you laugh out loud, in the local or online games, raise everything up, throw them out, use your wisdom to blow your enemies up!
items.title: JJBoom

items.description: You are entrusted with training five "troubled" influencers from Mountain & Sea Media, and gain the “Heart Probe” ability which allows you to uncover girls’ inner thoughts. Use your wisdom and ability to help them meet their training KPIs, while discovering their real selves beneath their facades.
items.description_ja: 山海メディア社で5人の 「問題児 」女性キャスターの育成を任され、彼女たちの心を探る能力を身につけたあなたは、その知恵と能力を使って、キャスターが育成KPIを達成するのを助けると同時に、表側とは異なる彼女たちの心を探ることもできる。 あなたは、自分の知恵と能力を使って、キャスターがトレーニングのKPIを達成するのを助けることができ、同時に、彼女たちの表側とは異なる心を探ることもできる。
items.title: The Heart of Influencer

items.description: Painting PC is a relaxing painting game where you take on commissions, earn money, gain fans, unlock new tools, and work your way towards becoming a famous artist.
items.description_ja: Painting PC is a relaxing painting game where you take on commissions, earn money, gain fans, unlock new tools, and work your way towards becoming a famous artist.
items.title: Painting PC

items.description: MagiCat is a side-scrolling platformer inspired by the retro games from 16-bit era. The game features a cute magical cat adventuring 63 levels, each with their own unique boss battle spread across 7 worlds.
items.description_ja: 「ＭａｇｉＣａｔ」とは、16ビット時代のレトロゲームに触発されたサイドスクローラゲームです。このゲームでは、7つの世界を巡るかわいい魔法の猫が登場して、各世界にオリジナルなボスバトルがあります。最大63まで設定されたレベルデザインで、飽きることなく楽しめます。
items.title: MagiCat

items.description: A card game in a Medieval setting where you make decisions on which not only your life will depend, but also the future of the kingdom!
items.description_ja: あなたの人生だけでなく、王国の未来も左右するほどの決定を下す中世のカードゲームです！
items.title: Choice of Life: Middle Ages

items.description: You are a lowly egg cell on a journey through a swollen sea of strange and humanoid fish. Prey on smaller life and growing larger and stronger to perhaps someday be born.
items.description_ja: You are a lowly egg cell on a journey through a swollen sea of strange and humanoid fish. Prey on smaller life and growing larger and stronger to perhaps someday be born.
items.title: Swallow the Sea
